prs.title: perf(memory): retain unchanged legacy catalog snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keep an unchanged legacy memory catalog at a stable position in conversation history. A loaded update appends a full snapshot that supersedes older catalogs, including removed entries. Resume restores the snapshots, repeated unchanged Retry records reconstruct as one snapshot, and requests with legacy memory suppressed omit catalog snapshots. Compression and output budgets include visible pending and retained snapshots, including after failure, replay and history restoration.

## Why it's needed

#15020 protects the DashScope cache anchor by skipping the volatile catalog-bearing message, but the request-only catalog still moves behind new turns and tool results. Stable snapshots let later requests reuse that part of the prefix without moving mutable catalog data into the system prompt. Catalog context also stays separate from real user intent in permissions, titles and summaries.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable legacy memory with indexed project and user topics. Send consecutive prompts and trigger a real file read. The unchanged catalog should remain once at its original history position, including during tool continuation.
2. Load a changed catalog and resume the session. The old snapshot should remain unchanged; the new full snapshot should append once. A later return to an earlier catalog version must still append when it differs from the latest retained version.
3. Disable legacy memory or switch to structured recall. Main and compression requests should omit marked catalogs while retaining ordinary user text and pending tool results. Re-enable memory: input budgets must include the now-visible catalogs.
4. Interrupt and retry the original prompt, then resume the same session. Live and restored model history should each contain one unchanged snapshot. The append-only journal may retain two records; user records and parent lineage must remain intact. Fresh plan reminders should still appear when required.
5. Trigger compression and a reply without usage, then continue. A reseeded catalog must contribute to the next budget gate exactly once, including after startup-context restoration; compaction removing the latest snapshot must permit reseeding. Automatic titles should retain real dialogue while excluding hook context and resident-catalog headings.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Final affected-suite validation records **2,462 passes and one existing skip**, with build, bundle, typecheck, scoped lint/format and the normal pre-commit hook passing. Two independent source audits are reconciled to the final candidate. A separate complete bilingual runtime comment records exact identities, retained failures, native Retry/compression observations and historical live measurements. In one live comparison with one warmup and two measured main turns, cached/input rose from **90.797% to 99.591%**, and measured-main uncached input fell **3,276 → 146**. Including warmup and auxiliaries, uncached input rose **41,672 → 48,084**: no overall cost improvement is established. Candidate ran before the completed baseline; cache heat and draining canceled auxiliary responses limit interpretation. Offline native TUI Retry/resume now records **[1,1,1]** snapshots versus **[1,1,2]** before, with both normal exits; provider-backed Retry remains untested. A third clean local pass by the Qwen Code `/review` engine was still running when this PR was opened; Critical claims it returned so far were traced and not substantiated, and its final result will be posted here.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | Local build and affected suites; bounded native witnesses and historical CLI/TUI runs, with limits in the runtime comment |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested locally |

### Environment

macOS arm64. The matched comparison and historical live runs used `qwen3.8-max` through the DashScope-compatible token-plan endpoint; mechanism witnesses use controlled model responses and make no live API calls. Local project-memory fixtures require `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1`.

## Risk & Scope

- Old catalog contents remain in model history until normal compression and in stored transcript records afterward. The latest full snapshot takes precedence. History can grow after updates; this is not a global memory budget or pruning mechanism.
- Refresh timing is unchanged. Re-enabling retained catalogs invalidates older usage counts and temporarily falls back to local estimates. CJK fixtures verify local estimated coverage, not provider-tokenizer accuracy; synthetic usage is not provider telemetry.
- Native compression-filtering evidence covers cold compression only. Shared-path native execution, a final provider-backed Retry pair, independent disk-deletion refresh, other providers and a large-catalog performance matrix remain unvalidated. Historical measurements are not final-candidate measurements.
- No configuration migration is required. Backward resume into older releases was not tested. Non-blocking review notes remain in a separate follow-up comment.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #15027 and #11550. This addresses the moving unchanged catalog; broader provider-aware cost and benchmark work in #15027 remains open. Historical measurement corrections: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15027#issuecomment-6320584483.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

将未变化的旧版记忆目录保留在对话历史的固定位置。加载更新后追加一份完整快照，替代旧目录，包括已删除条目。恢复会话时还原快照，Retry 重复记录中的未变快照重建为一份；禁止访问旧版记忆的请求排除目录快照。压缩和输出预算计入可见的待追加及保留快照，包括失败、重放及历史恢复之后。

## 为什么需要

#15020 在选择 DashScope 缓存锚点时跳过带目录的可变消息，但仅供请求使用的目录仍会移动到新轮次和工具结果之后。稳定快照让后续请求能够复用这部分前缀，无需将可变目录放进系统提示词。权限、标题和摘要中的目录上下文也与真实用户意图区分。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 开启旧版记忆，准备已建立索引的项目和用户主题。连续发送提示词并触发真实文件读取。未变化目录应只在原历史位置出现一次，工具续轮也应如此。
2. 加载更新目录并恢复会话。旧快照保持不变，新完整快照只追加一次。之后回到早期目录版本时，只要与最新保留版本不同，仍应追加。
3. 关闭旧版记忆或切换至结构化召回。主请求和压缩请求应排除标记目录，保留普通用户文本及待处理工具结果。重新启用记忆后，输入预算必须包含现已可见的目录。
4. 中断后重试原始 prompt，再恢复同一会话。Live 和恢复后的模型历史均应包含一份未变快照。仅追加日志可保留两条记录；用户记录和父链必须保持完整。需要时仍应出现新的计划提醒。
5. 触发压缩并收到不含 usage 的回复，再继续。重新注入的目录必须恰好计入下一次预算门槛一次，包括启动上下文恢复之后；压缩移除最新快照后必须允许重新注入。自动标题应保留真实对话，排除 hook 上下文及驻留目录标题。

### 修改前后证据

最终受影响套件记录为 **2,462 项通过、一项既有 skip**，构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint/format 及正常 pre-commit 钩子均通过。两份独立源码审计已核对至最终候选。另附完整双语运行评论，记录精确身份、保留的失败、原生 Retry/压缩观测及历史线上测量。一次线上比较包含一轮预热和两轮测量主请求，缓存/输入比例从 **90.797% 升至 99.591%**，测量主请求未缓存输入由 **3,276 降至 146**。含预热和辅助请求的未缓存输入反而由 **41,672 增至 48,084**，不能证明整体费用改善。候选先于完整基线执行；缓存热度及取消后继续读取辅助响应限制了结论。离线原生 TUI Retry/恢复快照序列为 **[1,1,1]**，before 为 **[1,1,2]**，两次均正常退出；真实提供商 Retry 仍未验证。开启本 PR 时，本地 Qwen Code `/review` 引擎的完整评审仍在运行；其已返回的 Critical 候选经调用链核查均未成立，最终结果将补充在本 PR 中。

### 本地测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | 本地构建和受影响套件；有边界的原生用例及历史 CLI/TUI 运行，限制详见运行评论 |
| 🪟 Windows | 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

macOS arm64。配对比较及历史线上运行通过 DashScope 兼容 token-plan 端点调用 `qwen3.8-max`；机制原生用例使用受控模型响应，没有真实 API 调用。本地项目记忆夹具要求 `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1`。

## 风险与范围

- 旧目录内容会留在模型历史中直到常规压缩，之后仍保存在会话记录中；以最新完整快照为准。更新后历史可能增长，这不是全局记忆预算或自动清理机制。
- 刷新时机不变。重新启用保留目录时，会清除旧用量计数并暂时改用本地估算。CJK 夹具验证本地估算覆盖，不验证提供商 tokenizer 准确性；合成 usage 不是提供商遥测。
- 原生压缩过滤证据仅覆盖冷压缩。共享分支原生执行、最终提供商 Retry 配对、独立磁盘删除刷新、其他提供商及大目录性能矩阵仍未验证。历史测量不是最终候选测量。
- 无需配置迁移。未测试用旧版本恢复新会话。非阻塞评审事项保留在单独的后续评论中。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/perf/15027-stable-memory-catalog/docs/design/stable-memory-catalog-snapshots.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15027 和 #11550。本 PR 处理未变化目录的位置移动问题；#15027 中更广泛的跨提供商成本和基准测试工作保持开放。历史测量更正见 https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/15027#issuecomment-6320584483。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): base web terminal backpressure on pending input
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This fixes web terminal input admission that treats output as acknowledgement of previously submitted input. A program can consume input silently, and a program can print output while its input remains queued. Admission now follows the backend’s pending input instead: silent drain makes the next command writable, while unrelated output cannot grant capacity. Reconnecting attaches to the same session and does not reset or fabricate input capacity.

The policy has three distinct bounds. Ordinary frames are limited to **1 MiB of UTF-8 input on every backend**, before a buffer is copied or forwarded. The **256 KiB soft queue threshold** blocks additional ordinary input while the measured queue is non-empty and the new frame would exceed it. An idle queue may accept one complete frame above 256 KiB, up to the 1 MiB frame ceiling. POSIX node-pty additionally stops ordinary admission at **1,024 pending write tasks**; at that boundary it inspects the task count without traversing the queue. Below the boundary it validates every task and sums its remaining bytes, with at most 1,023 task entries inspected per attempt.

Bun admission also observes the backend’s existing **1 MiB per-PTY hard queue budget** and its **process-wide shared budget**. Before forwarding Web input, it reads the actual shared queued-byte count and leaves one default native queue budget available to other PTYs in the process. With the current 8 MiB process budget, ordinary Web input will not push shared queued bytes past 7 MiB. Recovery controls may borrow from the reserved space while staying within the actual 8 MiB process hard limit and their own terminal’s 1 MiB hard limit. Seven stalled Web terminals can therefore each retain a 1 MiB frame; another Web frame receives retryable backpressure while a separate PTY can still use the remaining 1 MiB. Existing bytes from other Bun PTYs contribute to the same measurement. Capacity becomes available again when actual writes complete. Equality at each applicable ceiling is allowed; exceeding it is refused before invoking the backend.

Single-character recovery controls bypass the ordinary frame and soft queue admission checks. Bun controls bypass the shared soft reservation but still respect the per-PTY and process-wide hard limits, so a recovery attempt cannot itself invoke the backend’s resource-failure path when the applicable budget has no room. This is a Web input admission guarantee; it does not change the underlying Bun backend’s limits or every internal producer that can write directly to a PTY.

The backend adapter covers the pinned POSIX node-pty write tasks, Windows input sockets, Windows startup deferrals, older socket-based POSIX implementations, and Bun’s public queued/in-flight byte statistics. Bun retains the entire head buffer in its counter until that task completes, so its measurement is conservative during a partial native write. Windows input measurement never substitutes the output socket for a missing input socket. Input is forwarded as UTF-8 buffers so queue lengths are compared in bytes consistently; the external input interface remains string-based.

Unknown or malformed queue layouts make ordinary input unavailable. The default serve daemon emits a once-per-terminal stderr warning identifying the terminal, backend, and expected queue fields. A separate diagnostic remains available once both debug-file logging and a debug session are enabled, including when enabled later. Retries and reconnecting do not repeat each warning, terminal identifiers are JSON-quoted, and neither diagnostic includes input or output contents.

The branch includes main through **32b4234b**, including the Bun backend and its existing resource-failure lifecycle. Failure snapshots and listeners, backend error subscription and disposal, process-tree cleanup, mutually exclusive failure/exit states, and once-only resource release are preserved. The PR remains focused on input admission, compatibility with the supported queues, bounded inspection, and regression coverage.

## Why it’s needed

The previous accumulator increased on ordinary input and decreased on output. That makes two independent streams appear coupled. A raw or no-echo application can consume every input byte while leaving artificial debt in the accumulator, causing subsequent commands to receive backpressure. Output from a process that is not consuming input has the reverse effect: it can erase the accumulator and permit more writes into a transport that remains blocked. The WebSocket route closes with code 1013 on backpressure and retains the session, so reconnecting cannot correct that accounting error.

There are two different baselines to distinguish. The original issue was reproduced against **e612bbf23**, which accepted an idle oversized frame; a 300 KiB paste then left stale input debt after silent consumption. Since that report, main at **b69a0f581** (retained in synchronized **32b4234b**) removed the idle exemption and rejects even an idle 300 KiB frame. Relative to current main, this PR deliberately adds a **bounded idle-frame allowance**, rather than claiming to preserve main’s current per-frame policy. It accepts an intact paste up to 1 MiB, then blocks further ordinary input while the real queue is occupied. Frames above 1 MiB are refused on an idle queue as well.

The Bun protections matter because the same process-wide budget is shared with other PTY users, including the shell tool. Mirroring only the per-PTY limit permits eight exact-1-MiB Web frames to occupy the entire 8 MiB shared budget. The Web admission check reserves one native queue’s worth of capacity instead of allowing Web traffic to fill that shared total. The reservation is an admission-time bound on Web input, not a promise that arbitrary other producers can never exhaust their own remaining capacity.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- On each supported backend, submit an idle UTF-8 frame of exactly 1 MiB. It should be forwarded intact. A frame exceeding 1 MiB should return backpressure before the backend write is called, even when the queue is empty. A 300 KiB frame and the existing 256 KiB + 1-byte paste should remain accepted on an idle queue.
- Leave 256 KiB pending and try another ordinary byte. It should be blocked. Emit unrelated output and reconnect listeners; neither action should change the result. Complete the actual backend write without producing output, then retry: input should be accepted immediately.
- For Bun, retain a full 1 MiB queue in one terminal and send Ctrl-C. It should receive backpressure without failing the terminal; after drain the same recovery input should work. Recovery controls bypass both the 256 KiB soft threshold and the shared soft reservation when both native hard budgets have room.
- Create eight Bun Web terminals. With each attempting an idle 1 MiB frame, seven should be accepted and the eighth should receive backpressure at the current default budgets. A separate PTY should still accept its full 1 MiB queue allowance without a resource failure. Completing queued writes should return shared capacity and let Web input retry successfully.
- Repeat the shared-budget boundary with a reduced process total: a Web write landing exactly at the shared total minus one default native queue should be accepted; the next ordinary byte should receive backpressure, while Ctrl-C should reach the backend as one byte. After another PTY fills the remaining reserved space, a control that would exceed the actual process hard total must receive backpressure without calling the backend; a control landing exactly at that total must still be accepted. Restore the mutable test budget afterward. This verifies a live budget check rather than an assumption about today’s terminal count or constants.
- On POSIX node-pty, queue one-byte tasks until 1,024 are pending. Further ordinary input should receive backpressure without visiting task entries; output and reconnecting should not change that. Below the task ceiling, invalid task buffers or offsets must make input unavailable, including a malformed tail behind a large valid head.
- On Windows, verify startup deferrals before readiness and the input-socket measurement after the deferred flush. An empty output socket must not hide pending input. Multibyte data must occupy its UTF-8 byte count. Natural exit and release must preserve the existing cleanup behavior.
- For unknown layouts, repeated ordinary writes should remain unavailable and each diagnostic channel should log only once per terminal. Test terminal IDs containing a newline and a forged prefix: stderr and the actual debug-file sink should each produce one physical line containing the JSON-quoted identifier. Enabling the two debug prerequisites in either order should preserve this behavior and exclude terminal input/output.
- On a POSIX host, the committed native queue integration case measures the userspace queue synchronously immediately after a write and cleans up its child. It does not assert that this queue remains occupied until the child consumes input; the kernel can accept the bytes independently.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The original issue’s controlled-registry checks compare against **e612bbf23**. The policy comparison against current main is different and is stated separately below; results are not combined across those baselines.

| Condition | Original issue baseline e612bbf23 | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Idle 300 KiB frame | Accepted, then counted as artificial input debt | Accepted intact within the new 1 MiB frame bound |
| Another ordinary write while that input is pending | Backpressure | Backpressure |
| Ordinary write after silent queue drain | Still blocked by the accumulator | Written |
| Reconnect after silent drain | Preserves artificial debt | Preserves the live, drained queue state |
| Unrelated output while input remains queued | Can incorrectly grant capacity | Does not grant capacity |

Synchronized main **32b4234b**, like **b69a0f581**, rejects an idle 300 KiB frame before forwarding it. This PR changes that policy to accept one complete idle frame up to 1 MiB. A frame above 1 MiB receives backpressure with no backend write. The separate named frame ceiling bounds this allowance independently of queue state and the WebSocket transport’s larger payload ceiling.

Current local core results are **118 passed and 3 skipped**: **82 registry tests**, **31 adapter tests**, and **5 ConPTY compatibility tests** pass. The three skipped cases require POSIX. The new registry cases cover both node-pty backend names, UTF-8 boundaries, rejection before backend writes, the retained 300 KiB allowance, eight Bun-shaped sessions under a reduced shared budget, exact-boundary admission, ordinary-input backpressure at the soft reservation, delivery of a recovery byte through that reservation, exact process-hard-total admission, rejection of the next control byte, capacity for another PTY, and recovery after drain. Existing lifecycle and diagnostic regressions remain included.

Independent verification loads the actual production registry, adapter, and Bun backend class with controlled native I/O. Before this follow-up, an idle 9 MiB node-pty-shaped frame was forwarded, and eight real backend instances retained the full 8 MiB process total. With the new admission checks, 9 MiB and 1 MiB + 1-byte frames are refused before forwarding, exact-1-MiB UTF-8 and 300 KiB frames are accepted, the eighth full Bun frame receives backpressure, and a separate backend instance writes the remaining 1 MiB without resource failure. Invoking captured native completion callbacks returns the actual shared counter to zero and restores admission. These checks execute the real backend class with simulated native I/O; they are not native Bun POSIX runs.

The terminal WebSocket route suite also passes **37 tests** using the CLI package’s own configuration. The affected core package builds, repository-wide typechecking passes, focused ESLint/Prettier/whitespace checks pass, and the repository bundle completes. The bundled CLI starts and reports version `0.26.0`. These results do not constitute a complete repository preflight.

Independent recovery-control verification also queues 7 MiB using unrelated instances of the actual Bun backend class and checks an idle Web terminal against that real shared counter. Ctrl-C, Ctrl-D, Ctrl-Z and Ctrl-\ each reach the captured native write intact; ordinary input stays blocked. A control landing exactly at 8 MiB is accepted, the next control is refused without backend failure, and a control at the target terminal’s own full 1 MiB queue is also refused. Completing native writes restores ordinary admission.

Mutation checks distinguish these requirements: removing the soft-reservation exemption makes the recovery-control assertion fail; removing the hard-total check causes the actual backend to emit its process write-limit error. The earlier frame-bound and shared-reservation mutation evidence remains associated with its recorded head. All probes use controlled native I/O and leave tracked sources untouched.

### Tested on

| OS | Current verification scope |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | Package-local registry, adapter and ConPTY compatibility tests; production-registry/Bun-backend-class checks with controlled native I/O |
| Linux | Native POSIX case is committed; earlier Ubuntu runs exercised it. New CI will validate this head separately. |
| macOS | Native execution not performed locally |

### Environment

Local checks use Node 24.11.1 and the pinned pnpm dependency tree. Backend pins and existing dependency-upgrade checks are retained. Native Bun PTY execution requires a supported POSIX host; Windows fixture results do not establish native Bun behavior. Earlier native ConPTY evidence belongs to its named historical heads and is not presented as a rerun of this follow-up.

## Risk & Scope

- **Input policy:** relative to current main, the idle allowance is an intentional behavior change. The 256 KiB soft threshold controls pending ordinary input; a separate 1 MiB ceiling bounds every ordinary Web input frame. Frames are accepted intact or refused, without truncation or hidden splitting.
- **Bun shared budget:** Web input reads the same module-global queued-byte counter as other Bun PTYs. It leaves one default native queue below the configured process total, for ordinary input. Recovery controls may use that reserved space, but cannot exceed either the actual process total or their own per-PTY hard queue limit. This can return retryable backpressure before the backend’s absolute process ceiling. Other PTY producers and their failure behavior are unchanged.
- **Compatibility:** node-pty queue inspection uses private layouts, with malformed or unknown shapes failing closed. Bun uses its public retained-byte count. The POSIX task ceiling keeps inspection bounded; Windows startup and input-socket behavior remain dependency-upgrade checks.
- **Diagnostics and lifecycle:** warning latches, terminal ownership, output buffering, error listeners, failure snapshots, exit handling and resource cleanup retain their existing roles. No new configuration, protocol fields or migration is required.
- **Verification scope:** local package and controlled-I/O checks cover admission and the registry/backend boundary. Native Bun POSIX behavior and the complete browser flow require the corresponding upstream checks. This report does not claim a complete repository preflight.

## Linked Issues

Fixes QwenLM/qwen-code#14312

prs.title: feat(runtime-broker): add HTTP-backed external scratch workers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in `external-scratch` Runtime provider that delegates Session worker placement to an operator-run HTTP service. The Broker persists a deterministic request handle before provisioning, retains its existing attestation and ownership checks, and can retry the same original resource after a lost provision response or transient confirmation failure. Infrastructure SDKs remain outside this repository.

This is a draft of the scratch-only increment. It does not enable Hosted Workspace tools on external workers.

## Why it's needed

Deployments with an existing sandbox or container platform currently need vendor-specific Broker changes, SSH hosts, or Kubernetes to allocate isolated tool workers. A small HTTP boundary lets the operator own allocation while the Broker continues to own runtime identity and execution fencing.

The protocol has two endpoints: provision and read-only observe. There is deliberately no release-to-kill mapping: release can be invoked by an operation that has lost ownership. Actual physical resource IDs stay in the provider's durable journal, bound to the logical request handle.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Verify that external scratch configuration is opt-in, uses session isolation, accepts a worker-local cwd without requiring it to exist on the Java host, and rejects managed Workspace features.
- Lose the first provision response after the provider records the original resource. Retry must use the same request identity and logical handle; it must not allocate a replacement.
- Make an existing provider temporarily unavailable, then restore it. The original READY binding must remain eligible for confirmation and independently re-attest. A changed endpoint or identity must still be rejected.
- Restart the Broker and observe the original handle. Observation must never allocate a missing resource. A provider journal without a known allocation outcome remains unavailable.
- Compile and run the focused module checks (results below). `main` currently fails `testCompile` for an unrelated reason fixed in #15305, so these ran in a temporary tree with that one-line fix cherry-picked; the PR branch itself is rebased once #15305 lands.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI screenshots. Source review found and repaired two first-draft recovery defects: missing persisted handle after first response loss, and READY becoming LOST after transient confirmation uncertainty.

After the repairs, on macOS with JDK 21 and the sibling SDK installed (`packages/managed-agent-server`, offline Maven, temporary tree with #15305 cherry-picked):

```text
mvn -o -DskipTests test-compile   # 349 main + 555 test sources
BUILD SUCCESS, 14.5 s

mvn -o -Dtest=ExternalRuntimeProvisionerTest,ExternalHttpRuntimeClientTest,ExternalRuntimeConfigurationTest test
Tests run: 11, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
BUILD SUCCESS

mvn -o checkstyle:check checkstyle:check@runtime-broker-checkstyle
BUILD SUCCESS
```

That includes the two Broker lifecycle regressions: a lost first provision reply leaves a retryable `PROVISIONING` binding with the persisted logical handle and the retry converges on the same seed/handle with no second resource, and a confirmation timeout/UNKNOWN keeps the binding `READY` and the original lease eligible while endpoint drift still turns it `LOST`.

An operator-side Aone reference adapter in a separate private workspace passed syntax checks and 9 offline Node tests, including an actual loopback HTTP lost-response/retry test. That is not evidence that this Java candidate compiles, that Java and the adapter interoperate, or that an actual remote worker executes tools. No remote deployment or external Hosted Workspace E2E was performed for this implementation.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ `test-compile`, 11 focused tests and Checkstyle pass (JDK 21, offline Maven) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested; the required MySQL/Hosted/fault profiles run only in CI |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21. The commands above are the module's focused local gates; the full suites and profiles remain CI's job. The temporary tree existed only because `main`'s unrelated `testCompile` break (#15305) would otherwise mask these results.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this adds a trusted operator service and durable idempotency contract. UNKNOWN never authorizes replacement or execution replay; ambiguous create/start outcomes require intervention. The scratch placement cache and provider retirement lifecycle remain deliberately limited.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full Java suite on Linux, the required MySQL/Hosted/fault profiles, real remote image/ingress/process lifetime, and Java-to-provider E2E. Managed Workspace storage registration, boot-v2, public tools, shell capture/publication, automatic stopped-writer recovery, and vendor-specific allocation are outside this increment.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: opt-in, no schema migration; existing provisioner defaults stay unchanged. External protocol version 1 uses `{requestId: provisionRequestId}` logical handles and requires provider-side durable binding to the original physical resource.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.zh-CN.md). Both describe the implemented scratch boundary and the unimplemented Hosted Workspace extension.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15247. Kept open because real-worker validation and the wider Hosted Workspace goal are not complete. This revises the initial proposal to use `external-scratch`, persist the logical handle before HTTP, and omit a generic release endpoint.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的变更

增加可选的 `external-scratch` Runtime provider，通过运营方 HTTP 服务分配 Session worker。Broker 在远程创建之前保存确定性的请求 handle，保留现有身份认证与所有权检查，并允许首次响应丢失或短暂确认失败后重试原资源。基础设施 SDK 不进入本仓库。

这是 scratch 增量的草稿，不支持在外部 worker 上使用 Hosted Workspace 工具。

## 为什么需要

已有沙箱或容器平台的部署目前需要修改 Broker、准备 SSH 主机或使用 Kubernetes，才能分配隔离工具 worker。HTTP 接口让运营方负责资源分配，Broker 继续负责 Runtime 身份与执行隔离。

协议仅包含 provision 和只读 observe。release 可能由已失去所有权的操作调用，因此不能直接映射为销毁资源。实际物理资源 ID 保存在 provider 的持久日志中，与逻辑请求 handle 绑定。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

- 确认配置为可选启用、使用 session 隔离，worker 内 cwd 不要求存在于 Java 主机，并拒绝 managed Workspace 功能。
- provider 保存原资源后丢弃首次响应；重试必须使用同一请求身份与逻辑 handle，不得创建替代资源。
- 临时中断已就绪 provider，再恢复连接；原 READY 绑定应保持可确认状态，并重新独立认证。endpoint 或身份变化仍须拒绝。
- 重启 Broker 后观察原 handle；observe 不得创建缺失资源。无法确定分配结果的 provider 日志继续保持不可用。
- 执行必要的 Java CI 门禁。最终修改后的 Java 源码和新增 Broker 生命周期测试尚未在本地编译或执行，验收仍待 CI 与真实进程证据。

### 前后证据

无 UI 截图。源码审阅发现并修复了初稿的两个恢复缺陷：首次响应丢失后没有已保存 handle，以及短暂确认失败导致 READY 误转 LOST。新增回归测试针对这些状态变化，但尚未执行。

独立私有工作区中的 Aone 参考适配器已通过语法检查和 9 个离线 Node 测试，包括真实回环 HTTP 的丢响应重试。这不能证明当前 Java 候选版本可编译、Java 与适配器可互通，或真实远程 worker 可以执行工具。本实现尚未进行远程部署或外部 Hosted Workspace 端到端验证。

### 验证平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 当前 Java 候选未验证；早期初始类曾编译，之后有修改 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

早期编译使用 JDK 21。Maven 依赖解析耗尽模块共享的十分钟本地验证预算，按模块规范将后续 Java 检查交给 CI。不宣称最终 Java revision 的任何检查已通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：新增受信的运营方服务与持久幂等协议。UNKNOWN 不授权替换或执行重放，创建或启动结果不确定时需要人工介入。scratch placement 缓存和资源回收生命周期仍有明确限制。
- 未验证或不在范围：最终 Java 编译、Checkstyle、聚焦与完整测试、必要的 MySQL/Hosted/fault profiles、真实远程镜像/入口/进程寿命，以及 Java/provider 端到端。Workspace 存储注册、boot-v2、公开工具、shell capture/publication、自动 stopped-writer 恢复、厂商资源分配不属于本增量。
- 兼容性与迁移：可选启用，无数据库迁移，现有 provider 默认值不变。外部协议 v1 使用 `{requestId: provisionRequestId}` 逻辑 handle，要求 provider 持久绑定原物理资源。

[英文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.md)与[中文设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/external-runtime-provisioner/docs/design/2026-10-23-external-runtime-provider.zh-CN.md)均描述已实现的 scratch 边界和待实现的 Hosted Workspace 扩展。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15247，暂不关闭：真实 worker 验证及更完整的 Hosted Workspace 目标尚未完成。相对最初提案，当前明确使用 `external-scratch`、在 HTTP 前保存逻辑 handle，并移除了通用 release 接口。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): share the Hosted gate attachment lookup
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the lookup of Spring's private Harness attachment for a Session into `HostedGateTestSupport.attachment(connector, sessionId)` and puts every carrier on it. Before this, five Hosted gate classes reflected over the connector's `attachments` map by hand: the three FG13 hook gates (byte-identical, comment included), `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT`, and the FG12e Runtime connection replacement cell. The FG13 gates also drop their private `HarnessAttach` record and read the client id and boot id from the `HarnessSessionRef` itself. That ref's fields are final, so it is the same snapshot the record held. No assertion or behavior changes.

`HostedGateTestSupportTest` pins the lookup in the default surefire lane. That includes the connector field's name, so renaming the field turns a fast unit test red instead of five classes in the slowest CI job.

## Why it's needed

This is R1-2 from the #15198 review, deferred to a follow-up so that PR stayed scoped to its one FG12e cell. The review counted 12 sites that name the field `attachments` as a string, in two reflection spellings. Each new letter copied whichever variant it opened first, which is the drift #14147 and #14921 exist to stop. With five carriers the lookup is past #14147's extraction bar.

The per-class request builders stay local. Their timeouts (10 s, 30 s, 60 s, 90 s) and where they take the client id from differ per letter, so they don't meet the byte-identical rule. The `harness/` package unit tests that check the map's size or clear it are not by-session lookups and stay as they are.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `mvn -o test-compile checkstyle:check` in `packages/managed-agent-server`. A missed call site fails to compile, and a leftover import fails `UnusedImports`.
2. `mvn -o surefire:test -Dtest=HostedGateTestSupportTest` gives 4/4.
3. Expected: `git grep -n '"attachments"' -- packages/managed-agent-server/src/test/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/Hosted*.java` lists only `HostedGateTestSupport`, its unit test, and the `clear()` in `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT`, which is not a lookup.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A, test-only change with no user-visible output. Results:

- **Local, Linux x86_64, JDK 21:**
  - `test-compile checkstyle:check` exits 0.
  - `HostedGateTestSupportTest` is 4/4.
  - Each of three helper mutants turns it red: reading the field under another name (error), dropping the Session filter (failure), and always returning `null` (failure). After restoring, it is 4/4 again.
- **Rig, Linux aarch64:**
  - Shape of the CI Verify step: `-Phosted-harness-mysql`, MySQL 8.4.6, a delegated cgroup v2 hook root, and the Harness bundle built from this tree.
  - **This tree:** the five carriers run 44 tests with 0 failures and 2 skipped. The skips are the two `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` cells disabled on Linux, the same as in CI. No hook cgroup is left behind.

    | Class | Result | Time |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `HostedHookFaultGatesIT` | 3/3 | 70.3 s |
    | `HostedHookReplyLossFaultGatesIT` | 13/13 | 137.3 s |
    | `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT` | 5/5 | 92.4 s |
    | `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` | 17 passed, 2 skipped | 638.9 s |
    | `HostedMcpStreamGapIT` | 4/4 | 126.2 s |

  - **Shared lookup mutated to always return `null`:** 13 cells go red, all at their attachment check. These are exactly the cells that call the lookup; the other 29 stay green.
    - 6 in `HostedHookReplyLossFaultGatesIT`, at `Session attachment`.
    - 3 in `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT`, at `Session attachment before cancel`.
    - 2 in `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` and 1 in `HostedMcpStreamGapIT`, at `Spring's attachment to …`.
    - 1 in `HostedHookFaultGatesIT`, at `no attachment is serving the Hook status route yet`.
  - **After restoring:** the rig's tree hash matches this commit (`74a70938c4`).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux aarch64 (12 cores) for the rig; Linux x86_64 with JDK 21 for compile, checkstyle and the unit test.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk:** this moves settled gate classes onto a shared helper. If the transplant slipped, the hook status and cancel assertions and the FG12e `202 settled` command would go red. Running the five carriers on the rig covers that.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - The rest of the full `hosted-harness-mysql` lane. It doesn't call the helper and is untouched.
  - The request builders, which are left per letter on purpose.
  - The other #14921 items.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. No production code, workflow, ledger or budget line moves.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15198 (review R1-2). Part of #14921.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把"按 Session 查找 Spring 持有的 Harness 私有 attachment"移进 `HostedGateTestSupport.attachment(connector, sessionId)`，并让所有载体改用它。此前有五个 Hosted 门禁类各自通过反射遍历 connector 的 `attachments` map：三个 FG13 hook 门禁（连注释都逐字节相同）、`HostedPublicWorkspaceIT`，以及 FG12e 的 Runtime 连接替换格。三个 FG13 门禁同时去掉了私有的 `HarnessAttach` record，直接从 `HarnessSessionRef` 读取 client id 和 boot id。该 ref 的字段都是 final，所以和原 record 持有的是同一份快照。断言和行为都没有变化。

`HostedGateTestSupportTest` 在默认 surefire 车道中钉住了这个查找，包括 connector 字段的名称。因此字段一旦改名，变红的是一个快速单测，而不是最慢的 CI 作业里的五个类。

## 为什么需要

这是 #15198 评审中的 R1-2。当时延后到 follow-up，是为了让那个 PR 只覆盖它的一个 FG12e 格。评审统计出 12 处以字符串引用 `attachments` 字段名，分属两种反射写法。每个新的 letter 都会照抄它最先打开的那个变体，这正是 #14147 和 #14921 要阻止的漂移。现在已有五个载体，超过了 #14147 定的抽取门槛。

各类自己的请求构建器仍留在本地。它们的超时（10 s、30 s、60 s、90 s）以及 client id 的来源因 letter 而异，不满足"逐字节相同"的规则。`harness/` 包里那些检查 map 大小或清空 map 的单测不是按 Session 查找，保持不动。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 `packages/managed-agent-server` 下执行 `mvn -o test-compile checkstyle:check`。漏改的调用点会编译失败，残留的 import 会触发 `UnusedImports`。
2. `mvn -o surefire:test -Dtest=HostedGateTestSupportTest` 结果为 4/4。
3. 期望：`git grep -n '"attachments"' -- packages/managed-agent-server/src/test/java/com/alibaba/qwen/code/managedagent/Hosted*.java` 只列出 `HostedGateTestSupport`、它的单测，以及 `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 中的 `clear()`（它不是查找）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A，纯测试改动，没有用户可见的输出。结果如下：

- **本机，Linux x86_64，JDK 21：**
  - `test-compile checkstyle:check` 退出码为 0。
  - `HostedGateTestSupportTest` 为 4/4。
  - 三个 helper 变异各自都让它变红：用另一个名字读取字段（error）、去掉 Session 过滤（failure）、总是返回 `null`（failure）。还原后恢复 4/4。
- **Rig，Linux aarch64：**
  - 与 CI Verify 步同形：`-Phosted-harness-mysql`、MySQL 8.4.6、委托的 cgroup v2 hook 根目录，Harness bundle 由本树构建。
  - **本树：** 五个载体共 44 项，0 失败，2 跳过。跳过的是 `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 中两个在 Linux 上禁用的格，与 CI 相同。没有遗留 hook cgroup。

    | 类 | 结果 | 耗时 |
    | --- | --- | --- |
    | `HostedHookFaultGatesIT` | 3/3 | 70.3 s |
    | `HostedHookReplyLossFaultGatesIT` | 13/13 | 137.3 s |
    | `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT` | 5/5 | 92.4 s |
    | `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` | 17 通过，2 跳过 | 638.9 s |
    | `HostedMcpStreamGapIT` | 4/4 | 126.2 s |

  - **把共享查找变异为总是返回 `null`：** 13 个格变红，全部红在各自的 attachment 检查处。它们正好是调用这个查找的格，其余 29 项保持绿色。
    - `HostedHookReplyLossFaultGatesIT` 6 个，红在 `Session attachment`。
    - `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT` 3 个，红在 `Session attachment before cancel`。
    - `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 2 个、`HostedMcpStreamGapIT` 1 个，红在 `Spring's attachment to …`。
    - `HostedHookFaultGatesIT` 1 个，红在 `no attachment is serving the Hook status route yet`。
  - **还原后：** rig 的树哈希与本提交一致（`74a70938c4`）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险：** 本 PR 把已定型的门禁类迁到共享 helper 上。如果迁移出了差错，hook status、cancel 断言以及 FG12e 的 `202 settled` 命令会变红。在 rig 上跑这五个载体就是为了覆盖这一点。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：**
  - 完整 `hosted-harness-mysql` 车道的其余部分。它们不调用这个 helper，也没有改动。
  - 请求构建器，按设计留在各 letter 本地。
  - #14921 的其他条目。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。没有改动生产代码、workflow、账本或预算行。

## 关联 Issue

#15198 评审 R1-2 的 follow-up。属于 #14921 的一部分。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Removes the stale seventh argument from the `ToolPublicationStore` constructor call in `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT`. The constructor lost its `journalHeadAuthorization` boolean when pre-release compatibility paths were removed, but this integration test kept passing it.

## Why it's needed

`main` cannot compile this module's test sources, so every Managed Agent Java gate fails at `testCompile`:

```text
HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT.java:[225,81] constructor ToolPublicationStore ... cannot be applied to given types
  required: JdbcTemplate, PlatformTransactionManager, ManagedSessionStore, ToolExecutionRepository, RuntimeBindingRepository, Capacity
  found:    ... , Capacity, boolean
```

Found while pushing an unrelated PR. The break slipped through because the gate skipped its Java job for the merge commit (`SDK Java (none)`).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the module's test compilation, which is the exact command that failed in CI:

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server && mvn -o test-compile
```

Expected: `BUILD SUCCESS`. Before the change, `testCompile` fails with the error above. To confirm the test still exercises what it did, note the argument removed is the one the constructor no longer accepts; no behavior is being selected here.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the `Build and verify reference distribution` job on PR #15261 failed at `[ERROR] COMPILATION ERROR` with the message above. After: CI on this PR. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local Maven runs were not executed for this one-line test-only fix; CI owns the compile gate. That is a deliberate gap, not a passing local check.

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none beyond restoring compilation; the change deletes an argument the callee no longer declares.
- Not validated / out of scope: The `mysql-integration` and Hosted profiles for this IT are not run locally; CI covers them.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15261 (discovered while running its gate). No issue traces to this compile break, so no closing keyword.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的变更

删除 `HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT` 中 `ToolPublicationStore` 构造调用里已不存在的第七个参数。移除预发布兼容路径时，构造函数去掉了 `journalHeadAuthorization` 布尔参数，但这个集成测试仍在传入它。

## 为什么需要

prs.title: feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen update --target-version <version>` for standalone installations. An explicit target skips npm version discovery and installs that exact release through the existing download and verification flow, including `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`. Omitting the option preserves normal update discovery.

Concrete stable and prerelease versions accept an optional leading `v`. Explicit requests allow same-version reinstalls and downgrades. Invalid targets are rejected before downloading, and a downloaded executable reporting a different version is rejected before activation. Unsupported installation methods return an actionable error instead of suggesting an unpinned upgrade. Help and error text are localized.

## Why it's needed

Operators may already have selected a release while npm registry access is unavailable. Configuring a reachable artifact source alone does not help because the current update command performs registry discovery first. Explicit selection makes that dependency unnecessary and prevents discovery from choosing a different release.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an explicit-version update with a custom HTTPS release root while npm registry access is unavailable. It should install exactly the selected version without invoking npm or contacting a registry.
- Try a concrete prerelease, a same-version reinstall and an explicit downgrade. Each should use the specified version and retain the previous installation for rollback.
- Try a mutable tag, malformed version, missing argument, unavailable archive, incorrect checksum or an archive whose executable reports a different version. Failures must preserve the original installation and clean up update locks and temporary files.
- For a non-standalone installation, expect a nonzero exit and instructions to install the selected version manually, without an unpinned package-manager command.
- Omit the target option and confirm that normal version discovery remains in use.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI's update help has no target-version option; source always runs version discovery before downloading.

After: focused unit tests pass, and isolated CLI tests use a local HTTPS release source with registry access unavailable to verify exact installation and failure preservation. Detailed E2E evidence is posted separately.

Validation: full build, workspace typecheck, bundle, 170 focused tests, changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The npm lockfile was used for final validation; the optional pnpm layout exceeded an unrelated document-export asset budget, while the npm build passed that gate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Tested: build, typecheck, unit tests and isolated CLI E2E |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Baseline update help only; new implementation not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.1. E2E runs use isolated home directories and disposable installations, a local HTTPS server with a temporary trusted CA, and network/subprocess guards. Downloaded fixtures contain a real Node runtime and a small version-reporting CLI; this verifies updater behavior, not the functionality of a complete new release. No real installation was updated.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: explicit requests intentionally permit reinstalls and downgrades. Version equality is now checked before activation for all standalone update entrypoints.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows deferred replacement, full release-package acceptance, daemon/UI upgrade orchestration and release approval policies.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing calls without the option retain version discovery; malformed versions are rejected more strictly.

## Linked Issues

Closes #11484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为独立安装新增 `qwen update --target-version <version>`。指定目标时跳过 npm 版本查询，通过现有下载与校验流程安装该精确版本，并继续支持 `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`。不指定参数时保留原有版本查询行为。

支持具体稳定版和预发布版本，以及可选的 `v` 前缀。显式请求允许同版本重装和降级。非法目标在下载前拒绝；下载后若程序报告的版本与目标不一致，则在激活前拒绝。不支持的安装方式返回可操作的错误提示，避免建议一个未固定版本的升级命令。帮助与错误文案已本地化。

## 需求背景

用户可能已经确定要安装的版本，但无法访问 npm registry。仅配置可访问的制品源仍然不够，因为当前升级命令会先查询 registry。指定版本可以移除这个依赖，并避免版本发现选择另一个版本。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方法

- 在 npm registry 不可用时，结合自定义 HTTPS 下载源执行指定版本升级。应准确安装目标版本，不调用 npm，也不访问 registry。
- 验证具体预发布版本、同版本重装和显式降级。每种情况均应使用指定版本，并保留旧安装以供回退。
- 验证可变标签、非法版本、缺少参数、制品不存在、校验不匹配和包内程序版本不匹配。失败必须保留旧安装，并清理锁与临时文件。
- 非独立安装应返回非零退出码，提示手动安装指定版本，不输出未固定版本的包管理器升级命令。
- 不提供目标参数时，应继续执行原有版本查询。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：已安装 CLI 的升级帮助中没有指定版本参数；源码在下载前始终查询版本。

修改后：相关单测通过；隔离 CLI 测试使用本地 HTTPS 制品源，在 registry 不可用的条件下验证准确安装及失败保护。详细 E2E 证据单独评论发布。

验证通过：完整构建、工作区类型检查、bundle、170 项相关测试，以及改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查。最终验证使用 npm 锁文件；可选 pnpm 布局触发了无关的文档导出体积限制，npm 构建通过了同一门禁。

### 测试平台

- macOS：构建、类型检查、单测和隔离 CLI E2E 已验证。
- Windows：未在本地验证。
- Linux：仅检查基线升级帮助，未在本地验证新实现。

### 验证环境

Node.js 22.23.1。E2E 使用隔离 HOME、临时安装、本地 HTTPS 服务、临时受信 CA，以及网络和子进程监测。下载制品由真实 Node 运行时和精简的版本输出 CLI 组成，证明的是升级器行为，而非完整新版本的功能验收。未升级任何真实安装。

## 风险与范围

- 显式指定版本允许重装和降级；所有独立升级入口都会在激活前核对版本一致性。
- 未覆盖 Windows 延迟替换、完整发布包验收、daemon/UI 升级编排或版本审核策略。
- 未指定参数时保留现有行为；非法版本校验更加严格。

关联并关闭 #11484。

</details>

## What this PR does

Keeps artifact filenames and metadata within their available space. On cards no wider than 420 px, Download and Open move below the file information; wider cards retain their single-row layout.

## Why it's needed

On small screens, long artifact metadata forces the file information beyond its grid column and paints text over the action buttons. English button labels can also leave almost no room for the filename.

1. Open a conversation with a Markdown artifact, including a long filename and a “modified since recorded” status. Check Chinese and English at narrow phone widths and with the desktop sidebar visible.
2. Confirm filenames and metadata truncate within the card, both action labels remain readable, and wide cards keep actions beside the file information.
3. Confirm Download retains the filename and contents, and Open still displays the Markdown preview.

Actual Web Shell browser captures at a 320 px viewport, using simulated daemon responses. Before: file information crosses the buttons. After: actions occupy a separate row and long metadata ends with an ellipsis.

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): resume collection blockers at their own clearing instant
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A retired Session's collection had two retry hops that each slept a full claim interval even though the instant they could clear was already known. This PR resumes each hop at that instant, logs the publication-side blocker when it changes, and makes the Hosted gate's wait failure name the persisted blocker instead of only reporting `RETIRING`.

Specifically: a ledger held by an output reader now resumes at the last lease expiry, capped at the claim interval it replaces; a publication waiting on owner rows that the Session ledger deletes is rechecked every five seconds while that ledger is still collecting; and the publication collector emits one information line per blocker change, mirroring what the Session collector already does.

## Why it's needed

The `spring-kill` parameter of the Hosted shell lifecycle gate failed on 2026-10-21 because the delete-to-collection chain legitimately needed more than its 150 s window after a restart, and nothing recorded which blocker was holding the bytes.

The run's own artifacts show the chain. Spring was killed during resource preparation and restarted; the delete completed at 04:08:14 (UTC+8). The publication was then held by an output read lease, which retirement may not revoke, until the Session ledger also saw that lease expire at 04:09:13. Both ledgers parked for a minute. The publication's next attempt at 04:10:13 found the manifest still referenced by the journal, parked again, and the Session ledger finished removing that reference at 04:10:18 — five seconds too late for the publication, whose next attempt would have landed at 04:11:13. The wait expired at 04:10:44, and the failure said only that the capture was `RETIRING`.

So the timeout was not the defect, and neither was recovery protection: the Session ledger completed, which proves `recovery_protected` was false. The defect is that both hops ignored the instant they were waiting for. Resuming at the lease expiry and rechecking the cross-ledger handoff within seconds brings the worst observed case comfortably inside the existing budget without widening it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

There is no user-visible surface. A reviewer should confirm two things: that a reader-blocked ledger now schedules its next attempt at the exact lease expiry, and that a publication blocked by a reference owned by the Session ledger retries within seconds while that ledger is unfinished but drops back to a minute once it has completed, so permanently referenced publications do not poll.

### How to verify

Run the two collector unit test classes; the new cases pin both retry instants against the persisted `available_at` value, and one asserts the blocker log fires exactly once across a repeated blocker. Then run the module verification for Checkstyle and SpotBugs.

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -Dtest='ToolPublicationCollectorTest,SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest' test
mvn -DskipTests verify
```

Expected: 125 tests, 0 failures, 2 skipped; build success.

For the gate itself, trigger the `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` lane. Expected: all four fault cuts pass, and if a future wait expires, the failure message names the capture state, both ledger rows with their `failure_code` and `available_at`, the retirement flags, and the live read lease count.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, from the failing run's Spring log: the publication was observed as `reader_active`, then as `resource_referenced`, and the gate reported only `expected "COLLECTED" but was "RETIRING"`. After, the same blocker transition produces an information line naming the capture, publication and blocker, and a timeout additionally prints the persisted ledger state.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS covers the H2 unit tests, Checkstyle and SpotBugs. The Hosted gate itself is Linux-only and needs MySQL plus a built harness, so it is validated by CI rather than locally.

### Environment (optional)

Maven 3.9.11 with JDK 21.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: retry schedules change. A publication blocked by a reference that never clears waits a minute again once the Session ledger has settled; while that ledger is still collecting it is rechecked every five seconds. That recheck reuses the claim path, which examines at most 32 capture ledgers per tick in `available_at` order, so a larger population queues instead of widening per-tick work. The read-lease wake-up is capped at the claim interval, so a graceful close is no slower than before and only a sooner-expiring lease gains.
- Deliberately unchanged: the 60-second history-wide ledger scan. It runs once immediately after a restart; the latency removed here sits in the two parks after it, not in the scan.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Hosted gate was not run on this machine. A wider multi-node collection throughput measurement was not attempted.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No schema change, no new configuration, no change to which bytes are eligible for collection.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15191

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

退役 Session 的回收链上有两次重试，各睡满一个 claim 周期，而它们「能解除的时刻」本来就已经知道。本 PR 让两次重试都在该时刻恢复，在 publication 侧 blocker 变化时打一条日志，并让 Hosted 门禁的等待超时直接报出持久化的 blocker，而不是只说 `RETIRING`。

具体是：被输出读取者挡住的台账改为在该租约到期时恢复，并以它取代的 claim 周期为上限；等待由 Session 台账删除的属主行时，在 Session 台账尚未收尾期间每 5 秒重查一次；publication 采集器在 blocker 变化时输出一行 INFO，与 Session 采集器现有做法一致。

## 为什么需要

2026-10-21 的 Hosted shell 生命周期门禁中，`spring-kill` 参数失败：重启后「删除→回收」链路确实需要超过 150 秒窗口，而且没有任何记录说明是谁在挡着字节。

失败运行的产物给出了完整链路。Spring 在资源准备阶段被杀并重启，删除于 04:08:14（UTC+8）完成。此后 publication 被输出读租约挡住——退役不能撤销读租约——直到 04:09:13 Session 台账也看到该租约到期。两个台账各停一分钟。publication 在 04:10:13 重试时发现 manifest 仍被 journal 引用，再次顺延；Session 台账在 04:10:18 才删掉那条引用，比 publication 的下一次重试（04:11:13）早了五秒。等待在 04:10:44 到期，而失败信息只说 capture 仍是 `RETIRING`。

因此超时不是缺陷，recovery protection 也不是：Session 台账完成了，证明 `recovery_protected` 为 false。真正的缺陷是两跳都忽略了自己等待的那个时刻。改为在租约到期时恢复、并把跨台账交接缩短到秒级后，实测最坏情形已稳稳落在既有预算内，无需放宽窗口。

## 评审测试计划

没有用户可见界面。评审者需要确认两点：被读取者挡住的台账是否把下次尝试精确排在租约到期时刻；被 Session 台账属主引用挡住的 publication，是否在台账未收尾期间几秒内重试、而在台账完成后回到一分钟，从而避免永久被引用的发布物空转。

### 如何验证

运行两个采集器单测类。新增用例用持久化的 `available_at` 钉住两个重试时刻，其中一个断言 blocker 日志在 blocker 未变化时只输出一次。随后运行模块静态门禁。

```bash
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -Dtest='ToolPublicationCollectorTest,SessionResourceCollectionCollectorTest' test
mvn -DskipTests verify
```

预期：125 项测试，0 失败，2 跳过；构建成功。

门禁本身请触发 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21`。预期：四个故障切点全部通过；若将来再次超时，失败信息会给出 capture 状态、两条台账行的 `failure_code` 与 `available_at`、退役标志以及存活的读租约数。

### 证据（改前 / 改后）

改前，失败运行的 Spring 日志显示 publication 先被观测为 `reader_active`，随后为 `resource_referenced`，而门禁只报 `expected "COLLECTED" but was "RETIRING"`。改后，同样的 blocker 迁移会输出包含 capture、publication 与 blocker 的 INFO 行，超时信息还会附带持久化台账状态。

### 测试环境

macOS 覆盖 H2 单测、Checkstyle 与 SpotBugs。Hosted 门禁本身仅 Linux、需要 MySQL 与已构建 harness，因此由 CI 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：重试计划改变。Session 台账收尾后，被永不消失的引用挡住的 publication 回到一分钟重试；台账仍在收尾期间才每 5 秒重查。该重查复用 claim 路径，每 tick 最多检查 32 条 capture 台账并按 `available_at` 排序，因此数量增加只会排队，不会放大单 tick 工作量。读租约唤醒以 claim 周期为上限，正常关闭路径不再变慢，只有更早到期的租约获益。
- 有意不改：60 秒的整库台账扫描。重启后它立即跑一次；本 PR 去掉的延迟在扫描之后的两次停等里，不在扫描本身。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本机未运行 Hosted 门禁；未做跨多节点回收吞吐的量化测量。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。无 schema 变更、无新增配置、不改变哪些字节可被回收。

</details>

prs.title: fix(test): budget the standalone runtime suite for the release pool
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give the standalone Node/Bun regression suite more headroom on the shared release pool. Each worker has a 540-second cap; the outer spawn is derived as two worker caps plus 60 seconds of setup allowance, or 1,140 seconds. The same two workers, probes, assertions, and checksum verification remain in place.

The no-AK parity suites remain enrolled by #15142. Remove the three stale exemptions introduced during an earlier repair, which otherwise make the membership guard contradict that enrollment.

## Why it's needed

Release run [39621619809](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39621619809) hit the old 300-second per-worker cap. In attempt 2, the Node worker completed at about 294 seconds and the Bun worker received SIGTERM at about 301 seconds; the child then exited with failure. The old 600-second outer cap did not fire. The outer allowance is sized to contain the sequential workers and setup, not presented as an observed failure.

The release job has a separate 30-minute ceiling and also performs setup and script tests. The chosen 540/1,140-second limits leave room for those phases; the precise margin depends on runner load.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Verify both workers finish successfully on the release runner and retain their exit-code and signal diagnostics. Confirm the worker cap is 540 seconds, the outer cap is 1,140 seconds, and the no-AK membership guard accepts the three enrolled parity suites without exemptions.

### How to verify

Run `npm run test:standalone:runtimes:ci` for the real Node/Bun probes. Run the focused release-workflow and no-AK accounting meta-tests to check the existing budget assertions and enrollment contract. A loaded release-pool replay remains necessary to establish timing reliability there.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No UI change. The cited release logs demonstrate the worker-cap failure; this closeout corrects the accounting conflict and description. Fresh validation of this repair is recorded in the closeout comment rather than implying earlier test results were rerun.

## Risk & Scope

A genuinely hung worker can now run longer before failing. No production runtime behavior changes. The budget meta-tests use declaration parsing and upper bounds; they do not prove successful execution under load or a minimum budget. Broader budget-test hardening and runner policy changes are follow-ups.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15091

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

为共享发布池上的独立 Node/Bun 回归套件增加预算：每个 worker 540 秒，外层为两个 worker 预算加 60 秒，即 1,140 秒。探测、断言与校验和验证保持不变。保留 #15142 对三个 parity 套件的 no-AK 纳入，只删除此前修复留下的冲突豁免。

发布 run 39621619809 的证据只支持旧 300 秒 worker 上限被触发：第二次尝试中 Node 约 294 秒完成、Bun 约 301 秒收到 SIGTERM，随后子进程失败退出；旧 600 秒外层上限未触发。外层预算用于容纳顺序执行的 worker 与 setup，并非观测到的故障。30 分钟发布 job 还包含其他阶段，实际余量受 runner 负载影响。

验证真实 Node/Bun 探测及 release-workflow/no-AK 元测试；本次修复的实际验证在收尾评论记录。真实高负载发布池的时序可靠性仍需该环境验证。挂起的 worker 会更晚失败；不改变生产行为。预算元测试基于声明解析和上界，不证明高负载下能够完成，也不固定最小预算，进一步加固留作后续。

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): carry a scheduled-task gate through the daemon and Web Shell
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #15069 (PR 1b in the [scheduled-task gate design](docs/design/2026-10-21-scheduled-task-gate.md), [中文](docs/design/2026-10-21-scheduled-task-gate.zh-CN.md)). #15069 lets a scheduled task carry a gate: a shell command the owning session runs at each fire, outside the model, so a quiet fire costs no model turn. This PR carries that gate through every path a task takes in the daemon and shows it in the Web Shell.

- **REST.** `POST /scheduled-tasks` accepts an optional `gate`. A bad gate gets 400 `invalid_gate`, and a gate on a one-shot gets 400 `gate_requires_recurring`. `PATCH` sets, replaces or clears the gate (`null` or `''`) and resets the gate status when the command changes. A gate edit on a legacy guarded task gets 409 `task_legacy_unsupported`, because that task's `condition` is its own fail-closed marker, not the downgrade fuse. The daemon wraps a gated task with `withTaskGate`, so the downgrade fuse (`condition`) stays in step with the gate.
- **Current-session tasks.** `cron_create` now accepts a gate with `sessionMode: "current"`. #15069 refused that combination. The request reaches the daemon over the ACP bridge, which rejects a non-string or over-long gate with `invalidParams`.
- **Manual runs.** A manual run has no scheduler in the loop. So the run prompt asks the model to run the gate itself first, under the usual tool approval, and to stop if it prints nothing. Per-run manual runs and the Web Shell's "Run now" on a persistent task both use this prompt.
- **Capability and Web Shell.** The daemon advertises `scheduled_task_gate` (`{ since: 'v1' }`). When the daemon lists it, the Web Shell shows a "Gate command (optional)" field in the task form, a `Gate:` line on the card, the gate status, and `gate failed` / `gate blocked` run kinds.
- **One validation everywhere.** `gateCommandError` in core is the single shape check used by `cron_create`, the bridge and the routes. Its `&` check is `backgroundsAnyPart` from #15069, so the routes refuse a backgrounded wrapper script (`nohup bash -c './probe.sh &'`) exactly as the tool does.

## Why it's needed

After #15069, a gated task can only be created from the TUI. A daemon client has no way to send `gate`, and a `POST` that carries one silently creates an ungated task. A daemon session cannot create a gated task bound to itself. The Web Shell can neither show nor edit the gate. Issue #15056's reviewer and developer workflows run in the daemon and Managed Agents, so they need the gate there. Without the gate, every slot of a PR watch is a model turn even when nothing changed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start `qwen serve` on this branch. Expect the capabilities list to include `scheduled_task_gate`.
2. Create a task over REST: `POST /scheduled-tasks` with `{"cron":"* * * * *","prompt":"Summarize the events","gate":"./probe.sh"}`. Expect 201, with `gate: "./probe.sh"` and `gateStatus: null` on the view. Expect the task in `scheduled_tasks.json` to carry `gate` and a `condition` equal to it.
3. Send `gate` as `"nohup bash -c './probe.sh &'"`, then as `"   "`. Expect 400 `invalid_gate` both times. Send a gate with `recurring: false`. Expect 400 `gate_requires_recurring`. None of the three creates a task.
4. `PATCH` the task with a new gate. Expect the view to show it and `gateStatus` to reset. `PATCH` with `{"gate": null}`. Expect both `gate` and `condition` to be gone from the file.
5. In the Web Shell, open Scheduled tasks. Expect the "Gate command (optional)" field and the `Gate:` card line. Against a daemon without the capability, expect neither. Click "Run now" on a gated persistent task. Expect the prompt sent to the session to ask the model to run the gate first and to stop if it prints nothing.
6. In a daemon session, ask the model for a gated task bound to the current session (`sessionMode: "current"`). Expect the task to be created with the gate, not refused.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (main at `74c67c9e94`, with #15069): `cron_create` refuses `gate` with `sessionMode: "current"`. Task views already return `gate` and `gateStatus`, but `POST` and `PATCH` ignore `gate`. The Web Shell has no gate field.

After, on this branch:

```
tsc --noEmit: packages/core 0, packages/acp-bridge 0, packages/cli 0, packages/web-shell 0
eslint --max-warnings 0 on every changed .ts/.tsx → 0; prettier --check → ok
vitest core (cron services, cron tools, shell-utils)            → 10 files, 510 passed
vitest acp-bridge bridgeClient                                   → 162 passed
vitest cli (routes/scheduled-tasks, ACP Session, server,
            nonInteractiveCli, use-llm-stream)                   → 5 files, 3310 passed, 1 skipped
vitest web-shell ScheduledTasksDialog                            → 78 passed
```

Negative control: switching `gateCommandError`'s `&` check back to the check #15069 replaced fails 6 `cron_create` wrapper rejections (`bash -c './probe.sh &'`, `nohup …`, `sudo -u ci …`, `command …`, `env FOO=1 …`, nested) and the route test "rejects an invalid gate and a gate on a one-shot, creating nothing".

The Web Shell visuals lane captures the dialog on this PR. No manual screenshots are attached.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

macOS and Windows were not run locally. The gate runs through the same shell execution path as on Linux.

### Environment (optional)

Unit and route tests only. The steps above were not run against a live daemon for this PR.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:** the daemon now accepts, over REST, a shell command that the owning session runs unattended. It has the same trust as creating a task whose prompt runs with full tool access. A REST-created gate carries no in-process confirmation. At each fire the session applies #15069's verdict: deny rules first, then the approval mode, then saved `Monitor(...)`/`Bash(...)` rules or the read-only check. A gate none of these cover is blocked, and the notice names the rule to add. A manual run puts the gate in front of the model under the usual tool approval instead of running it outside the model.
- **Not validated / out of scope:** a live daemon plus Web Shell walk-through and real-model runs. Managed Agent automations get their own gate in a separate PR. The probes (#15057) and skills are steps 2 and 3.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. Tasks without a gate behave as before. Clients hide the gate field when the daemon does not list `scheduled_task_gate`. The design doc (EN + zh-CN) status, §4.3 capability name and the protocol capability table are updated.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15056, follow-up to #15069

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

#15069 的后续，对应[定时任务闸门设计](docs/design/2026-10-21-scheduled-task-gate.zh-CN.md)里的 PR 1b。#15069 让定时任务可以带一个闸门：每次触发时由所属会话在模型之外运行的 shell 命令，安静的触发不消耗模型轮次。本 PR 让闸门贯通 daemon 里任务的所有路径，并在 Web Shell 中展示。

- **REST。** `POST /scheduled-tasks` 接受可选的 `gate`。非法闸门返回 400 `invalid_gate`，一次性任务带闸门返回 400 `gate_requires_recurring`。`PATCH` 可以设置、替换或清除闸门（`null` 或 `''`），命令变化时重置闸门状态。对旧式带守卫任务修改闸门返回 409 `task_legacy_unsupported`，因为它的 `condition` 本身就是失败即关闭的标记，不是降级保险丝。daemon 用 `withTaskGate` 包装带闸门的任务，降级保险丝（`condition`）与闸门保持一致。
- **当前会话任务。** `cron_create` 现在接受带 `sessionMode: "current"` 的闸门，#15069 拒绝这种组合。请求经 ACP bridge 到达 daemon，bridge 对非字符串或超长的闸门返回 `invalidParams`。
- **手动运行。** 手动运行没有调度器参与，所以运行提示词让模型先自己运行闸门（走常规工具审批），没有输出就停止。按次运行的手动运行和 Web Shell 对持久任务的“立即运行”都用这个提示词。
- **能力与 Web Shell。** daemon 声明 `scheduled_task_gate`（`{ since: 'v1' }`）。daemon 列出该能力时，Web Shell 在任务表单里显示“闸门命令（可选）”字段，在卡片上显示 `闸门：` 行和闸门状态，并显示“闸门失败”“闸门被阻止”两种运行类型。
- **处处同一校验。** core 的 `gateCommandError` 是 `cron_create`、bridge 和路由共用的唯一形状检查。它的 `&` 检查用的是 #15069 的 `backgroundsAnyPart`，所以路由和工具一样拒绝放到后台的 wrapper 脚本（`nohup bash -c './probe.sh &'`）。

## 为什么需要

#15069 之后，带闸门的任务只能从 TUI 创建。daemon 客户端无法传 `gate`，带它的 `POST` 会静默创建一个不带闸门的任务。daemon 会话不能创建绑定到自身的带闸门任务。Web Shell 既不能展示也不能编辑闸门。Issue #15056 的评审者和开发者工作流运行在 daemon 和 Managed Agent 里，所以需要在那里用上闸门。没有闸门，PR 监视的每个时间槽都是一次模型轮次，即使什么都没变。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在本分支启动 `qwen serve`。能力列表应包含 `scheduled_task_gate`。
2. 通过 REST 创建任务：`POST /scheduled-tasks`，参数为 `{"cron":"* * * * *","prompt":"Summarize the events","gate":"./probe.sh"}`。应返回 201，视图里有 `gate: "./probe.sh"` 和 `gateStatus: null`。`scheduled_tasks.json` 中的任务应带 `gate`，以及与之相同的 `condition`。
3. 把 `gate` 设为 `"nohup bash -c './probe.sh &'"`，再设为 `"   "`，两次都应返回 400 `invalid_gate`。带闸门且 `recurring: false` 应返回 400 `gate_requires_recurring`。这三种情况都不创建任务。
4. 用新闸门 `PATCH` 该任务，视图应显示新闸门，`gateStatus` 被重置。用 `{"gate": null}` `PATCH`，文件中的 `gate` 和 `condition` 都应消失。
5. 在 Web Shell 打开定时任务，应看到“闸门命令（可选）”字段和卡片上的 `闸门：` 行。连接不带该能力的 daemon 时两者都不出现。对带闸门的持久任务点“立即运行”，发给会话的提示词应让模型先运行闸门，没有输出就停止。
6. 在 daemon 会话中让模型创建绑定当前会话（`sessionMode: "current"`）的带闸门任务，应创建成功并带上闸门，而不是被拒绝。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前（main `74c67c9e94`，含 #15069）：`cron_create` 拒绝带 `sessionMode: "current"` 的 `gate`。任务视图已经返回 `gate` 和 `gateStatus`，但 `POST` 和 `PATCH` 忽略 `gate`。Web Shell 没有闸门字段。

之后（本分支）：tsc 在 core、acp-bridge、cli、web-shell 均为 0。改动文件 eslint 为 0，prettier 通过。core 510 通过，acp-bridge 162 通过，cli 3310 通过、1 跳过，web-shell 78 通过（明细见英文部分）。

负向对照：把 `gateCommandError` 的 `&` 检查换回 #15069 之前的写法后，6 个 `cron_create` wrapper 拒绝用例和路由用例“rejects an invalid gate and a gate on a one-shot, creating nothing”都失败。

Web Shell visuals 车道会在本 PR 上截取对话框，未附手工截图。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅，macOS ⚠️，Windows ⚠️。本地未在 macOS 和 Windows 上运行，闸门走的是与 Linux 相同的 shell 执行路径。

### 环境（可选）

只跑了单元测试和路由测试，上面的步骤没有在真实 daemon 上为本 PR 执行。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：** daemon 现在通过 REST 接受一条由所属会话无人值守运行的 shell 命令。它的信任级别与创建一个提示词以完整工具权限运行的任务相同。REST 创建的闸门不带进程内确认。每次触发时，会话套用 #15069 的判定：先看拒绝规则，再看审批模式，再看已保存的 `Monitor(...)`/`Bash(...)` 规则或只读检查。都不覆盖的闸门会被阻止，并在通知中给出要添加的规则。手动运行则把闸门交给模型、走常规工具审批，而不是在模型之外运行。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内：** 真实 daemon 加 Web Shell 的完整走查和真实模型运行。Managed Agent 自动化的闸门在另一个 PR。探针（#15057）和 skill 是第 2、3 步。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：** 无。不带闸门的任务行为不变。daemon 未列出 `scheduled_task_gate` 时客户端隐藏闸门字段。设计文档（中英文）的状态、§4.3 的能力名和协议能力表已更新。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15056，#15069 的后续

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): preserve draft attachments through refresh and allocation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This follows up on merged PR #15025 and fixes two defects left by that change. Unsent attachments now survive a same-session Managed summary refresh. An accepted pending draft is also cleared after session allocation when the user only removed submitted attachments or touch reference normalization made no semantic change.

The fix retains the last confirmed attachment capability within the current session/provider and reuses the existing accepted-submission cleanup check for allocation. The continuation guard stays strict, and newer input remains protected. Regression coverage and both design translations are updated.

## Why it's needed

A temporary summary-loading gap was interpreted as attachment revocation, deleting an unsent archive. Separately, allocation could leave cleanup pointing at the pending draft after a submitted attachment was removed, or treat an unchanged touch draft as edited; accepting the submission then left its draft available to reappear.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a Managed session that supports attachments, enter text and attach an image and a text file. Refresh the session summary while its response is delayed. The same composer, text, attachments and archived payloads should survive the loading gap and the subsequent supported response. An explicit unsupported response should still remove attachments while retaining text.
2. Change the session or provider while summary loading is delayed. Attachment support must start disabled for the new owner, without deleting the previous owner's archive.
3. Submit a pending desktop draft containing text, an image and a file; delay allocation/acceptance, remove the submitted image, and allocate the session. Acceptance should clear the submitted draft and remaining file, including after navigation/unmount and remount. New text, edit-then-undo, or a newly added file must remain. Continuation matching must still reject the attachment-removal case.
4. Repeat pending allocation with the touch composer and persisted file references. An unchanged draft should clear on acceptance; newer input should survive.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The merged #15025 baseline reproduced both defects: the focused regressions had 8 failures and 6 passing controls before the production fix, then all 14 passed. On the current head, 559 related regression tests, the full build/typecheck/bundle, 9 production-hook Chromium cases and 3 actual Managed page/composer UI cases passed. Full source review and an independent review found no actionable issues.

The three screenshots below show the fixed version's actual Managed page/composer rendered from source with a controlled provider. The file chip and text survive Refresh/Loading; explicit capability revocation removes the chip and retains text. The 1px image fixture's bytes/count are asserted through native browser storage and DOM checks rather than a visually distinct thumbnail.

Before Refresh:

![Managed draft before Refresh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/cde428ffdae31bf5d2d91f0162424da6caf2b1de/composer-draft-followups/01-before-refresh.png)

During the held Refresh response:

![Managed draft retained while Loading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/cde428ffdae31bf5d2d91f0162424da6caf2b1de/composer-draft-followups/02-during-refresh.png)

After explicit capability revocation:

![Attachments removed and text retained after explicit revocation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/cde428ffdae31bf5d2d91f0162424da6caf2b1de/composer-draft-followups/03-explicit-revocation.png)

[Detailed E2E report](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/cde428ffdae31bf5d2d91f0162424da6caf2b1de/composer-draft-followups/e2e-report.md). Screenshots and the report are stored on a separate fork asset branch at a fixed commit; they are not part of the implementation diff.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local build/typecheck/bundle, regressions and Chromium verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Chromium 149.0.7827.55; Vite source imports of actual production components/hooks and native IndexedDB, File and FileReader. Provider responses, allocation and acceptance are controlled. The root bundle is checked separately.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: retaining a capability must never leak across owners or suppress a real revocation; cleanup must never erase newer input. Regression tests cover these boundaries; browser cases also exercise owner changes and pending-reader protection.
- Not validated / out of scope: real daemon/model/Git backends, compiled-bundle browser execution, native mobile Safari, and the previously deferred workspace-resolution issue. Allocation cleanup is verified through the production hook and DOM regressions; the extra standalone full-editor migration harness could not render without its workspace context and is not counted as a passing E2E case.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No protocol, schema, dependency or core changes.

Synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/c1c50c3177e79a809fc884a07eba53e9e0d70c56/docs/design/composer-draft-attachments.md) · [中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/c1c50c3177e79a809fc884a07eba53e9e0d70c56/docs/design/composer-draft-attachments.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to merged #15025. Addresses its [summary-refresh finding](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15025#discussion_r4350853915) and [allocation-cleanup finding](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15025#discussion_r4350853970).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 变更内容

这是已合入的 PR #15025 的后续修复，处理该变更遗留的两个问题：同一托管会话刷新摘要时保留未发送附件；待创建草稿分配会话后，若用户仅删除已提交附件，或触屏引用归一化没有产生语义变化，接受确认仍会清理该草稿。

修复在当前会话/provider 内保留最近一次已确认的附件能力，并在分配会话时复用现有的接受提交清理判定。继续提交守卫仍保持严格，新输入仍受保护。同步补充回归覆盖和中英文设计说明。

### 修复原因

原实现把摘要加载期间的暂缺状态当成能力撤销，删除未发送附件归档。另一个问题是删除已提交附件后，分配会话可能仍让清理指向待创建草稿，或将未修改的触屏草稿误判为已编辑；接受提交后草稿仍会残留并重新出现。

### 审阅验证

1. 在支持附件的托管会话中输入文字，并添加图片和文字文件。延迟摘要响应后点击刷新，加载期间和支持附件的响应返回后，同一输入框、文字、附件及归档载荷均应保留。明确不支持附件的响应仍应移除附件并保留文字。
2. 摘要响应延迟时切换会话或 provider。新归属的附件能力应从禁用开始，旧归属的归档不能被删除。
3. 提交包含文字、图片和文件的桌面待创建草稿，延迟分配和接受确认，删除已提交图片后分配会话。接受确认应清理已提交草稿和剩余文件，切走/卸载再挂载后也不应恢复。新文字、编辑后撤销、新增文件均应保留。继续提交匹配仍应拒绝附件删除场景。
4. 使用持久化文件引用的触屏输入框重复会话分配。未修改草稿应在接受后清理，新输入应保留。

### 修复前后证据

已合入 #15025 的基线复现了两个问题：生产修复前，聚焦回归有 8 项失败、6 项对照通过；修复后 14 项全部通过。当前提交的 559 项相关回归测试、完整 build/typecheck/bundle、9 项生产 hook Chromium 案例和 3 项实际托管页面/输入框 UI 案例均通过。完整源码复核和独立复核未发现需要处理的问题。

上方三张截图来自当前修复源码渲染的实际托管页面/输入框，使用受控 provider。刷新前及 Loading 期间文件卡片与文字保留；明确撤销能力后文件卡片消失、文字保留。图片夹具为 1px PNG，其字节和数量通过浏览器原生存储及 DOM 断言验证，不宣称截图展示了可辨认的图片缩略图。

[完整 E2E 报告](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/cde428ffdae31bf5d2d91f0162424da6caf2b1de/composer-draft-followups/e2e-report.md)。截图和报告存放在用户 fork 的独立素材分支，链接固定到 commit，不进入实现分支。

### 测试平台与环境

macOS 已执行构建、类型检查、打包、回归及 Chromium 验证；Windows 和 Linux 未在本地验证。Chromium 149.0.7827.55，通过 Vite 引入实际生产组件/hook，使用原生 IndexedDB、File 和 FileReader。provider 响应、会话分配及接受确认受控，根 bundle 单独检查。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险：保留的能力不能跨归属泄漏或掩盖真正撤销，清理不能删除新输入。回归测试覆盖这些边界；浏览器案例还验证归属切换和待读取保护。
- 未验证/不在范围内：真实 daemon/模型/Git 后端、编译后 bundle 的浏览器执行、原生移动 Safari，以及此前已延期的工作区解析问题。分配后的清理由生产 hook 和 DOM 回归验证；额外的独立完整输入框迁移 harness 缺少工作区上下文而未能渲染，不计为通过的 E2E。
- 无破坏性变更或迁移要求，无协议、schema、依赖或 core 变更。

中英文设计说明已同步，链接见上方设计引用。本次对应已合入 #15025 的摘要刷新和分配清理两条评论，链接见上方 Linked Issues。

</details>
