prs.title: test(cli): budget the hosted approval wait for loaded runners (#15093)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Budgets the hosted approval test helper's wait through the repository's existing slow-host policy instead of a fixed 10-second window. On the ecs-qwen pool the wait is 45 seconds, clamped to that pool's 60-second per-test ceiling; on a saturated non-ECS host it is 15 seconds, clamped to the 15-second ceiling; elsewhere it keeps the current 10 seconds. The polling assertions are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Main CI failed on commit `9efdca76d39a` in `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts > keeps who is asked in 'default' mode for call 1 (PreToolUse 'allow', PermissionRequest allow undefined)`. The helper waits for the turn's sequential fsynced durable writes (options publish, action request, durable-wait checkpoint) before answering the approval. On the shared, coverage-enabled ECS runner that chain can outlast a fixed budget even when nothing is wrong. This helper has already been widened twice for the same reason (#12915, #13399), and the failing case is one of the heaviest in its table: both admission passes run, both hooks fire, the tool input is published, and the action is awaited. The failing CI step ran for 48 minutes, which is consistent with the contention-based race.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the affected group on the fast path and on the slow-host path; both should report 11 passing cases:

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`
- `cd packages/cli && RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`

To reproduce the failure signature and confirm the budget, temporarily delay the `managed-action-options` publish by 11 seconds (install the delay before `turn.execute`). At the fast 10-second budget the failing case reports `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0` after about 10 seconds; with `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix` the same delay passes in about 11 seconds. The temporary probe is not part of the commit.

The full affected file also passes: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` reports 377 passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change with no user-visible behavior. The probe above shows the before (10 s budget times out on an 11 s durable publish) and after (slow-host budget passes the same delay).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox, Node 22, Vitest with v8 coverage. `npm run build` first failed before compiling because the sandbox denies writes to the default corepack cache; rerunning with `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` passed. `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on a saturated non-ECS host the wait can now reach the 15-second per-test ceiling; a genuine hang there may surface as a runner timeout rather than the assertion, which is the same tradeoff the hosted-harness suite already accepts. Production behavior is untouched.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact CI job log is not anonymously downloadable, so the diagnosis relies on the reproduced assertion signature, the two prior fixes, and the failing job's duration. macOS and Windows were not run locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15093

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将托管审批测试辅助函数的等待预算改为使用仓库既有的慢主机策略，而不是固定的 10 秒窗口。在 ecs-qwen 池上等待 45 秒，并受该池 60 秒单测上限约束；在饱和的非 ECS 主机上等待 15 秒，并受 15 秒上限约束；其他环境保持当前的 10 秒。轮询断言未改动。

## 为什么需要

主 CI 在提交 `9efdca76d39a` 上失败于 `hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts > keeps who is asked in 'default' mode for call 1 (PreToolUse 'allow', PermissionRequest allow undefined)`。该辅助函数会等待该轮次串行、已 fsync 的持久化写入（选项发布、动作请求、持久等待检查点）完成后才回答审批。在共享且启用覆盖率的 ECS runner 上，这条链路即使一切正常也可能超过固定预算。该辅助函数已经因为同样的原因被放宽过两次（#12915、#13399），而失败用例是其表格中最重的用例之一：两轮准入都会执行，两个 Hook 都会触发，工具输入会被发布，并且动作会被等待。失败的 CI 步骤运行了 48 分钟，这与基于争用的竞态相符。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

在快速路径和慢主机路径上运行受影响的用例组；两者都应报告 11 项通过：

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`
- `cd packages/cli && RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts -t "keeps who is asked"`

要复现失败签名并确认预算，可临时将 `managed-action-options` 发布延迟 11 秒（在 `turn.execute` 之前安装延迟）。在快速的 10 秒预算下，失败用例会在约 10 秒后报告 `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`；使用 `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-autofix` 时，同样的延迟会在约 11 秒内通过。临时探针不属于提交内容。

完整受影响文件也通过：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` 报告 377 项通过。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

不适用——仅测试变更，没有用户可见行为。上面的探针展示了修改前（10 秒预算在 11 秒持久化发布下超时）与修改后（慢主机预算在同样延迟下通过）。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 沙箱、Node 22、启用 v8 覆盖率的 Vitest。`npm run build` 首次在编译前失败，因为沙箱不允许写入默认的 corepack 缓存；使用 `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` 重跑后通过。`npm run typecheck` 与 `npm run lint` 均通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在饱和的非 ECS 主机上，等待现在可能达到 15 秒的单测上限；那里的真正挂起可能会以 runner 超时而不是断言的形式出现，这与 hosted-harness 套件已经接受的权衡相同。生产行为未受影响。
- 未验证 / 范围外：确切的 CI 作业日志无法匿名下载，因此诊断依赖复现出的断言签名、此前的两次修复以及失败作业的持续时间。本地未运行 macOS 和 Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15093

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): keep footer actions stable during inline rename
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the Session Overview title line at least as tall as its inline rename editor, so canceling a rename does not move the footer during a click. Adds a real-browser regression for clicks near both edges of the enabled Archive button and documents the existing cancel-and-confirm behavior.

## Why it's needed

While an unsaved inline rename has focus, clicking near the bottom of the footer Archive button can cancel the rename without opening confirmation. Blur shrinks the title line and moves the footer upward between pointer down and pointer up, leaving the release outside the button. Reserving the editor's height keeps the click target in place.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open **More → Session Overview**, select an idle session with its checkbox, start an inline rename, and type an unsaved draft. Keep the editor focused.
2. Click inside the enabled footer **Archive** button, approximately 1px above its bottom edge. The editor should close, its unsaved draft should be canceled, and the archive confirmation should open. The footer should stay in place. Choose **Cancel** so the session remains active.
3. Start another unsaved rename and repeat approximately 4px below the button's top edge. Expect the same confirmation and stable footer position.
4. Confirm that native caret positioning, text selection, and clicks on controls within the table still work. Existing draft retention, sorting, details popovers, and keyboard focus behavior should remain functional.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real Chrome 155.0.8059.85 at 1440×1000, using deterministic mock-daemon responses and the same four idle-session fixture:

| Observation | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Footer movement when rename loses focus | 8px upward | 0px |
| Click 1px above Archive's bottom edge | Rename canceled; no confirmation | Rename canceled; confirmation opens |
| Click 4px below Archive's top edge | Rename canceled; confirmation opens | Rename canceled; confirmation opens |

| Before: bottom-edge click misses confirmation | After: bottom-edge click opens confirmation |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: rename is canceled but archive confirmation is absent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jun516/qwen-code/db92fe7cd97e964dd3e13f89a9d3b36525a35fb5/before.png) | ![After: archive confirmation is open](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jun516/qwen-code/db92fe7cd97e964dd3e13f89a9d3b36525a35fb5/after.png) |

The original independent reproduction passed 1/1 after the fix. The complete Session Overview browser suite passed 13/13, with no skipped, unexpected, or flaky results. The new regression clicks fixed pre-blur coordinates through the real mouse path and cancels the confirmation; no session was actually archived.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ Tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 22.18.0, pnpm 11.24.0, and system Chrome 155.0.8059.85. The browser exercised the local Web Shell served by Vite after the workspace build, with deterministic mock-daemon responses. The global `qwen` command was unavailable. No model calls were made.

### Validation performed

- `npm run build`, `npm run bundle`, and `npm run typecheck`: passed.
- Session Overview component unit tests: 123/123 passed.
- Original real-browser reproduction: 1/1 passed after reproducing the baseline failure. Complete Session Overview browser suite: 13/13 passed, including the new Archive regression and existing overview interaction coverage.
- Changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks: passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: ordinary title lines reserve the existing editor height, so non-editing rows can be up to 8px taller. The minimum height still allows content to grow.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS, Linux, browsers other than Chrome, live daemon/model integration, and the full `npm run preflight` command were not tested. This addresses item 3 only; it does not decide the separate unsaved-rename navigation behavior or address the remaining coverage follow-ups.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Archive still cancels an unsaved rename and requires confirmation.
- AI assistance: AI assisted the investigation, implementation, tests, review, and this description. The results reported above were executed locally.

## Linked Issues

Refs #11390, item 3 (R4-2: footer Archive bottom-edge missed click).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

让会话概览中的标题行至少与行内重命名编辑器等高，从而避免取消重命名时在点击过程中移动页脚。补充真实浏览器回归测试，覆盖已启用 Archive 按钮上下边缘附近的点击，并记录现有的取消草稿并打开确认框行为。

## 为什么需要

当未保存的行内重命名编辑器拥有焦点时，点击页脚 Archive 按钮底缘附近可能只会取消重命名，而不打开确认框。失焦会使标题行收缩，并在鼠标按下和释放之间使页脚上移，导致释放位置落在按钮之外。预留编辑器高度可以让点击目标保持原位。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开 **More → Session Overview**，通过复选框选中一个空闲会话，开始行内重命名并输入未保存草稿。保持编辑器拥有焦点。
2. 在已启用的页脚 **Archive** 按钮内部、约距底缘 1px 的位置点击。编辑器应关闭，未保存草稿应取消，并打开归档确认框。页脚应保持原位。选择 **Cancel**，让会话保持活动状态。
3. 再次开始一个未保存的重命名，在约距按钮顶缘 4px 的位置重复点击。应同样打开确认框，且页脚位置稳定。
4. 确认原生光标定位、文本选择以及表格内控件点击仍然有效。现有的草稿保留、排序、详情浮窗和键盘焦点行为应继续正常工作。

### 证据（修改前后）

真实 Chrome 155.0.8059.85、1440×1000 视口，使用确定性的模拟守护进程响应和相同的四个空闲会话测试数据：

| 观察项 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 重命名失焦时的页脚位移 | 向上 8px | 0px |
| 距 Archive 底缘 1px 处点击 | 重命名取消；未打开确认框 | 重命名取消；打开确认框 |
| 距 Archive 顶缘 4px 处点击 | 重命名取消；打开确认框 | 重命名取消；打开确认框 |

| 修改前：底缘点击没有打开确认框 | 修改后：底缘点击打开确认框 |
| --- | --- |
| ![修改前：重命名已取消，但没有归档确认框](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jun516/qwen-code/db92fe7cd97e964dd3e13f89a9d3b36525a35fb5/before.png) | ![修改后：归档确认框已打开](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jun516/qwen-code/db92fe7cd97e964dd3e13f89a9d3b36525a35fb5/after.png) |

原始独立复现脚本在修复后 1/1 通过。完整的会话概览浏览器测试套件 13/13 通过，没有跳过、非预期或不稳定结果。新增回归测试通过真实鼠标交互点击失焦前记录的固定坐标，并取消确认框，没有实际归档任何会话。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Windows、Node.js 22.18.0、pnpm 11.24.0，以及系统 Chrome 155.0.8059.85。工作区构建完成后，浏览器通过 Vite 访问本地 Web Shell，并使用确定性的模拟守护进程响应。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用。没有调用模型。

### 已执行的验证

- `npm run build`、`npm run bundle` 和 `npm run typecheck`：通过。
- 会话概览组件单元测试：123/123 通过。
- 原始真实浏览器复现：先复现基线失败，修复后 1/1 通过。完整会话概览浏览器测试套件：13/13 通过，包含新增的 Archive 回归测试和现有概览交互覆盖。
- 改动文件的 ESLint 和 Prettier 检查：通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：普通标题行会预留现有编辑器的高度，因此非编辑状态下的行高最多可能增加 8px。最小高度仍允许内容继续增高。
- 未验证或范围外事项：未测试 macOS、Linux、Chrome 以外的浏览器、真实守护进程或模型集成，也未执行完整的 `npm run preflight` 命令。此 PR 仅处理第 3 项，不决定单独提出的未保存重命名时的导航行为，也不处理其余测试覆盖后续事项。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。Archive 仍然取消未保存的重命名，并要求确认。
- AI 辅助说明：调查、实现、测试、审阅及本说明使用了 AI 辅助。上述结果均在本地实际执行获得。

## 关联问题

关联 #11390 的第 3 项（R4-2：页脚 Archive 按钮底缘漏点击）。

</details>


### Follow-up verification — October 23

The regression now also verifies that canceling the unfinished rename sends no session metadata update at either Archive click position, including workspace-scoped requests. In real Chrome, a temporary save-on-blur mutation using the current rename callback passes the original regression in all three runs; the strengthened regression rejects it in all three runs specifically at the unexpected-request assertion. The complete Session Overview browser suite passes after restoring normal behavior. Focused ESLint, Prettier and Web Shell typechecking pass. This follow-up changes only the regression test; production behavior and documentation are unchanged.

<details>
<summary>本轮验证说明（10 月 23 日）</summary>

prs.title: feat(mods): send a Mod's own tool.check ask to the user
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a Mod answers `tool.check` with an `ask` that it made or reworded, the user now has to answer it. Before, such an ask was treated like Qwen Code's own ask: YOLO approved it, the AUTO classifier could approve it, and the dialog offered "always allow".

The Mod's ask now follows the existing rules for a classic PreToolUse ask:

- No approval mode, classifier, sibling approval or PermissionRequest allow can settle it.
- The dialog shows the Mod's name and reason and hides "always allow".
- A headless run that cannot ask anyone denies the call. The model receives the Mod's reason, and the stderr line reports that reason instead of suggesting `-y`, which could not help.

An ask that the Mod only passes up unchanged keeps the approval mode's current handling.

The event also gains two facts that the host sets and Mods cannot change:

- `isReadOnly: true` when the tool reports the call as read-only: read, search and fetch tools, MCP tools whose server marks them read-only, and shell commands that pass the existing read-only check.
- `approver`: `person` where a dialog can ask the user, `host` where a stream-json host answers permission requests, and absent where nobody can answer.

The host also stamps the asking plugin's name on the result as `plugin`. A Mod can read it from an inner plugin's answer but cannot write it.

This is the second change in the compatibility baseline proposed in #15270.

## Why it's needed

In Claude Code 2.1.308, an ask made by a Mod hook goes to a person. Only the dialog, the host's permission callback or a PermissionRequest hook can answer it, no classifier's allow settles it, and it is refused where nobody can be asked.

The 2.1.308 plugin API declarations spell this out. Claude Code writes them beside a loaded Mod as `.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts`:

- The engine sets `approver` and `isReadOnly` on the `tool.check` input.
- The engine sets `plugin` on an ask a hook answered.
- The `decider: "person"` answer field that 2.1.304 introduced is no longer accepted.

In Qwen Code a Mod that asks for confirmation is silently overridden in the modes where users most rely on it. A guard Mod that asks before a write, for example, gets no confirmation at all under YOLO.

Mods also had no way to tell a read from a write, or to know whether anyone could answer an ask.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Install a Mod whose `tool.check` hook passes read-only calls with `next(e)` and returns `{decision: 'ask', reason: 'Confirm this write'}` for other shell calls. Have the model issue `ls` and `touch <file>`, and check each case:
  - **Terminal, YOLO (Ink or OpenTUI).** `ls` should run without a prompt; the Mod's log line for it shows `isReadOnly=true approver=person`. `touch` should open a confirmation that shows `⚠ Mod <name>: Confirm this write` and offers only "Yes, allow once" and "No". Approving runs it.
  - **Headless, `-p --approval-mode yolo`.** `ls` should run. `touch` should not run. The model receives `Qwen Code could not ask the user to confirm "run_shell_command" in non-interactive mode, so it was not run. Mod <name>: Confirm this write`, and stderr shows the same reason.
  - **Same Mod returning `next(e)` for every call.** `touch` should still run automatically under YOLO, because an ask passed up unchanged keeps the native behavior.
- Under AUTO_EDIT and AUTO, a Mod's own ask should reach the dialog or the stream-json host, never auto-approve. A PermissionRequest hook that allows it should not run the tool on its own.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Linux, Node 24.21.0, Bun 1.3.13 for strict OpenTUI, tmux 3.4 PTYs. Before is the exact base `bf66a26c97`; After is this PR's head. Both bundles were built locally.

The setup for every run:

- isolated home, workspace and settings;
- YOLO;
- a loopback model that issues `ls` and `touch ran-<nonce>` in one turn and then answers;
- 3 model requests per run.

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headless text | The Mod sees no `isReadOnly`/`approver`; YOLO approves its ask and `touch` runs (file created) | `ls` arrives with `isReadOnly=true` and runs. `touch` is denied: the model gets the sentence above with `Mod a2-mod: Confirm this write`, stderr shows `Warning: Tool "run_shell_command" was not run: …` with the same reason, and no file is created |
| Headless, Mod passes Qwen's ask up | — | `touch` runs under YOLO as before |
| Ink PTY | No dialog; `touch` runs | `approver=person`. The dialog shows `⚠ Mod a2-mod: Confirm this write`, `Allow execution of: 'touch'?`, `1. Yes, allow once`, `2. No, suggest changes (esc)`; Enter runs it |
| Strict OpenTUI PTY | Same as base Ink | Same as head Ink |

Automated checks:

- Core suites: 862 passed, 1 skipped. They cover the scheduler (530), the permission flow, the non-interactive executor, the Mod tool check (35) and all Mod runtime suites.
- Fifteen new or updated cases fail on the base source and pass here:
  - approver and read-only facts across text, stream-json and terminal sessions;
  - a Mod's own ask under YOLO, AUTO_EDIT, DEFAULT and AUTO, and its headless denial with the Mod's reason;
  - a Mod's own ask surviving a PermissionRequest allow;
  - the real-QuickJS ownership cases: asks made, reworded, passed up, written owners dropped, and owners kept or replaced across two plugins.
- CLI Mod services, headless session, non-interactive CLI and error-reporting suites: 366 passed, 1 skipped.
- Also run: the full workspace typecheck including integration types, and ESLint, Prettier and whitespace checks on the changed files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Built bundle under Node 24.21.0; strict OpenTUI under Bun 1.3.13 with renderer fallback disabled; tmux 3.4 PTYs; loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture. The E2E report is posted as a separate comment.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff:
  - Users of YOLO and AUTO will now see dialogs for asks that Mods make, and headless runs will deny them. This is intended: the Mod asked for a person.
  - A Mod that wants the old behavior can pass Qwen Code's own ask up unchanged or answer `allow`. A native ask still cannot be relaxed.
  - A PermissionRequest hook cannot approve such an ask, which is stricter than Claude Code.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - Excluding a Mod's ask from sibling approval comes from the existing PreToolUse ask handling and is not exercised by a new E2E.
  - The MCP read-only hint is covered through the tool kind, not with a live MCP server.
  - Subagents still do not inherit Mod middleware.
  - macOS, Windows and hosted CI are separate from this local validation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes:
  - Mods that relied on YOLO approving their own asks will now prompt, or be denied in headless runs.
  - The result of `tool.check` may now include a host-set `plugin` field.

Design: #15270, which is being updated to cite the declarations above.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749. Follows #15273.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

当 Mod 在 `tool.check` 中返回自己发出或改写过的 `ask` 时，现在必须由用户来回答。此前这类 ask 与 Qwen Code 自己的 ask 同样处理：YOLO 会批准它，AUTO 分类器可以批准它，对话框还提供"总是允许"。

现在 Mod 的 ask 沿用经典 PreToolUse ask 的现有规则：

- 审批模式、分类器、同批其他调用的批准、PermissionRequest 的 allow 都不能代为决定。
- 对话框显示 Mod 的名字和理由，并隐藏"总是允许"。
- 无法询问任何人的 headless 运行会拒绝该调用。模型收到 Mod 的理由，stderr 也显示这一理由，而不再建议使用并无帮助的 `-y`。

Mod 只是原样上传的 ask，保持审批模式当前的处理方式。

事件还新增两项由宿主设置、Mod 不能修改的字段：

- `isReadOnly: true`：工具报告该调用为只读时设置。包括读取、搜索和抓取类工具，服务端标记为只读的 MCP 工具，以及通过现有只读检查的 shell 命令。
- `approver`：能弹对话框询问用户时为 `person`，由 stream-json 宿主回答权限请求时为 `host`，没人能回答时不设置。

宿主还会在结果上标出发出 ask 的插件名，即 `plugin` 字段。Mod 可以从内层插件的答复中读到它，但不能写它。

这是 #15270 所提兼容基线中的第二项改动。

## 修改原因

在 Claude Code 2.1.308 中，Mod hook 发出的 ask 交给人来回答。只有对话框、宿主的权限回调或 PermissionRequest hook 能回答它，分类器的 allow 不算数，没人能问时直接拒绝。

2.1.308 的插件 API 声明写明了这些。Claude Code 加载 Mod 时会把声明写到 Mod 旁边的 `.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts`：

- `tool.check` 输入上的 `approver` 与 `isReadOnly` 由引擎设置。
- hook 答复的 ask 上的 `plugin` 也由引擎设置。
- 2.1.304 引入的答复字段 `decider: "person"` 已不再被接受。

在 Qwen Code 中，请求确认的 Mod 恰恰在用户最依赖它的模式下被静默覆盖。例如，一个写入前要求确认的守卫 Mod，在 YOLO 下根本得不到确认。

此外，Mod 以前无法分辨读与写，也无法知道是否有人能回答 ask。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方式

- 安装一个 Mod：它的 `tool.check` hook 对只读调用返回 `next(e)`，对其他 shell 调用返回 `{decision: 'ask', reason: 'Confirm this write'}`。让模型发起 `ls` 和 `touch <file>`，分别检查以下情况：
  - **终端，YOLO（Ink 或 OpenTUI）。** `ls` 应直接运行，Mod 为它记录的日志行显示 `isReadOnly=true approver=person`。`touch` 应弹出确认框，显示 `⚠ Mod <name>: Confirm this write`，只提供"Yes, allow once"和"No"两个选项。批准后执行。
  - **headless，`-p --approval-mode yolo`。** `ls` 应运行。`touch` 不应运行；模型收到 `Qwen Code could not ask the user to confirm "run_shell_command" in non-interactive mode, so it was not run. Mod <name>: Confirm this write`，stderr 显示同样的理由。
  - **同一个 Mod 对所有调用都返回 `next(e)`。** YOLO 下 `touch` 应仍然自动运行，因为原样上传的 ask 保持原生行为。
- 在 AUTO_EDIT 和 AUTO 下，Mod 自己的 ask 应进入对话框或交给 stream-json 宿主，绝不自动批准。允许它的 PermissionRequest hook 不应单独让工具运行。

### 修改前后证据

Linux，Node 24.21.0；严格 OpenTUI 使用 Bun 1.3.13；PTY 使用 tmux 3.4。修改前是精确基线 `bf66a26c97`，修改后是本 PR 的 head，两个 bundle 都在本地构建。

每次运行的设置：

- 隔离的 home、工作区和设置；
- YOLO；
- 本地回环模型在同一轮中发起 `ls` 和 `touch ran-<nonce>`，之后给出答复；
- 每次运行 3 个模型请求。

| 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| headless 文本 | Mod 看不到 `isReadOnly`/`approver`；YOLO 批准了它的 ask，`touch` 被执行（文件被创建） | `ls` 带 `isReadOnly=true` 并被执行。`touch` 被拒绝：模型收到上述句子和 `Mod a2-mod: Confirm this write`，stderr 显示 `Warning: Tool "run_shell_command" was not run: …` 及同样的理由，文件未被创建 |
| headless，Mod 原样上传 Qwen 的 ask | — | YOLO 下 `touch` 照常运行 |
| Ink PTY | 无对话框，`touch` 被执行 | `approver=person`。对话框显示 `⚠ Mod a2-mod: Confirm this write`、`Allow execution of: 'touch'?`、`1. Yes, allow once`、`2. No, suggest changes (esc)`；按 Enter 后执行 |
| 严格 OpenTUI PTY | 与基线 Ink 相同 | 与 head Ink 相同 |

自动化检查：

- core 测试：862 个通过、1 个跳过，覆盖调度器（530）、权限流、非交互执行器、Mod 工具检查（35）和全部 Mod 运行时测试。
- 15 个新增或修改的用例在基线源码上失败、在本 PR 上通过：
  - 文本、stream-json 和终端会话中的审批方与只读信息；
  - Mod 自己的 ask 在 YOLO、AUTO_EDIT、DEFAULT 和 AUTO 下的表现，以及它在 headless 下带 Mod 理由的拒绝；
  - Mod 自己的 ask 在 PermissionRequest allow 之后依然保留；
  - 真实 QuickJS 的归属用例：自发、改写、原样上传的 ask，hook 写入的归属被丢弃，以及跨两个插件时归属的保留或替换。
- CLI 的 Mod 服务、headless 会话、非交互 CLI 和错误报告测试：366 个通过、1 个跳过。
- 另外运行了：包含集成测试类型在内的完整类型检查，以及对改动文件的 ESLint、Prettier 和空白检查。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

在 Node 24.21.0 下运行构建好的 bundle；严格 OpenTUI 运行在 Bun 1.3.13 上，并关闭了渲染器回退；PTY 使用 tmux 3.4；使用本地回环的 OpenAI 兼容 fixture。E2E 报告另以评论发布。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：
  - YOLO 与 AUTO 用户会看到 Mod 自己发出的 ask 的对话框，headless 运行则会拒绝这些 ask。这是有意为之：Mod 要求由人来确认。
  - 想要旧行为的 Mod 可以把 Qwen Code 自己的 ask 原样上传，或者答 `allow`；原生的 ask 仍然不能被放宽。
  - PermissionRequest hook 不能批准这类 ask，这比 Claude Code 更严格。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - Mod ask 不随同批调用一起被批准，这一点沿用现有的 PreToolUse ask 处理，没有用新的 E2E 覆盖。
  - MCP 只读标记通过工具类型覆盖，没有连接真实的 MCP 服务端测试。
  - 子代理仍不继承 Mod 中间件。
  - macOS、Windows 和托管 CI 都不在本次本地验证之内。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：
  - 依赖 YOLO 批准自己 ask 的 Mod 现在会弹出确认，或在 headless 运行中被拒绝。
  - `tool.check` 的结果现在可能带有由宿主设置的 `plugin` 字段。

设计：#15270，正在更新以引用上述声明。

## 关联 Issue

属于 #13749。前一项为 #15273。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): pause requests offline and recover automatically
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Unifies Web Shell's native HTTP calls through the SDK and adds shared availability control for each active service connection. After a transport failure, business requests and reconnect loops pause while one bounded recovery probe runs. Successful health and authenticated capability checks automatically resume reads and session attachment.

The UI shows a localized connection warning with Retry, including fullscreen and modal artifact views. Cached reads and unsent drafts survive disconnection; terminal and local-file connections wait for recovery. Prompt submissions, uploads and other writes are not replayed automatically. User-facing connection messages use “service / 服务”.

<!-- review-fixes-84c64bf0cc -->
### Review fixes and latest UI evidence (`84c64bf0cc`)

Recovery now preserves the result of an already-issued settings update, expires cached live activity after 90 seconds offline without business requests, and keeps cold diagnostics, session lists and Managed views informative. Local host-handled commands remain usable; voice errors retain their localized service-unavailable reason. No write is replayed. Latest `origin/main` (`32b4234b84`) is merged; the only manual conflict joined two independently added regression tests, preserving both.

Full local build, typecheck (8 GiB Node heap) and CLI bundle passed, together with all **13,224 Web Shell tests across 492 files**, **81 export tests**, changed-file lint/format and **4 SDK request tests**. The fixed commit passed **10 selected Chromium checks** using the actual App and Managed provider with **mock HTTP/SSE backends**. Screenshots were visually checked. Diagnostic recovery used **manual Retry**; the narrow Managed case used a controlled DOM click on the actual button behind the artifact modal, verifying rendering conditions rather than ordinary pointer navigation. This round does not verify a real service restart, model, Java backend or Git operation. There were zero JavaScript errors; six expected mock resource errors are recorded. New-head remote CI is pending; older evidence below belongs to its stated commits.

| Cold offline diagnostics: reason and repair form | Managed view: warning remains after drawer hides |
| --- | --- |
| ![Actual App cold diagnostics with mock service offline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-cold-offline-mock.png) | ![Actual narrow Managed App with service warning, mocked backends](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/managed-narrow-offline-banner-mock.png) |

[After manual recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-recovered-mock.png) · [Checks and screenshot hashes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/verification.json) · [Bilingual scope notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/README.md)

<details>
<summary>中文：本轮修复与最新界面证据</summary>

恢复连接后保留已发出设置写入的结果；持续离线 90 秒后在本地使实时活动状态失效，不增加业务请求；首次打开诊断页、会话列表和 Managed 视图仍显示明确提示。本地宿主命令保持可用，语音保留本地化的服务不可用原因，写操作绝不重放。已合入最新 `origin/main`（`32b4234b84`）；唯一人工冲突是两边在同处新增测试，均已保留。

完整构建、类型检查（Node 堆上限 8 GiB）、CLI 打包、492 个文件中的 **13,224 项 Web Shell 测试**、**81 项导出测试**、变更文件静态检查，以及 **4 项 SDK 请求测试**均通过。固定提交上的真实 App 和 Managed Provider 通过 **10 项 Chromium 检查**，HTTP/SSE 后端为模拟，截图已目视检查。诊断恢复使用**手动重试**；窄屏 Managed 使用实际按钮的受控 DOM 点击，按钮当时被 artifact 模态层遮挡，仅证明显示条件，不声称普通指针可穿过遮挡导航。本轮不代表验证真实服务重启、模型、Java 后端或 Git 操作。JavaScript 错误为零，6 条预期 mock 资源错误已如实记录。新提交远端 CI 待出；下方旧证据保留各自提交归属。

[离线诊断](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-cold-offline-mock.png) · [手动恢复](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/diagnostic-recovered-mock.png) · [窄屏 Managed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/managed-narrow-offline-banner-mock.png) · [检查记录](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/verification.json) · [双语范围说明](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5cdd000a24733849aceee8de8e7fdc19242fc5ff/daemon-recovery/latest-main-merge/README.md)

</details>

## Why it's needed

A page waiting for its first prompt can keep showing a connected state after its service stops. Independent polling then continues to fail without an explanation in the UI and can distort business API success rates. A shared gate stops subsequent business traffic instead of merely slowing each poller independently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open the welcome page without submitting a prompt, enter a draft and browse a workspace directory. Stop the service: a persistent connection warning should appear and the draft should remain.
2. Observe network traffic after in-flight requests settle: business calls should stop, leaving one shared health probe sequence with 5/15/30-second delays. Requests rejected locally should not become HTTP requests.
3. Restart at the same address and credential without reloading or clicking Retry. The warning should disappear, reads and directory browsing should resume, and the draft should remain editable. No prompt or write should be replayed.
4. Check authentication rejection and explicit Retry, caller cancellation/timeouts, old responses after recovery, provider unmounts, and fullscreen/modal warning visibility. Deterministic regression tests cover these boundaries; the browser run below covers one real no-session provider.

### Historical evidence (Before & After)

Historical built-UI evidence (`df78833`), real test-owned service, headless Chromium; screenshots show offline → automatic recovery on the same page. All 16 browser checks passed. Stop detection: 3.473s. Offline observation: 54.056s, zero business requests after banner detection. Probe gaps: 5.004/15.002/30.002s. Same-address restart recovered automatically in 25.944s. The preserved draft remained editable, and a new directory GET returned 200. No model prompt, write request or Git mutation was performed; there were no browser page errors.

| Before recovery: offline warning and retained draft | After automatic recovery: warning removed and draft retained |

| [Historical screenshot: Service offline, draft retained](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/offline-after-backoff.png) | [Historical screenshot: Service automatically recovered, draft retained](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/92a3da81845a86e2db973dc11a406dc61bf259c8/daemon-recovery/recovered-draft.png) |

prs.title: fix(ci): scope the sdk-java test job lock to the cache write-back (#15278)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted Java test job now resolves Maven dependencies from a job-local repository seeded from the host cache, runs the sdk-java and managed-agent suites without the per-host lock, and takes that lock only for the optional cache write-back. A write-back lock that cannot be acquired within its budget now warns and skips the copy instead of failing a step whose suite already passed; the same rule applies to the MariaDB integration lane's write-back.

## Why it's needed

The Managed Agent gate failed on main commit `6fb149d6d8fd` before any Java test ran. Both attempts of the fast-tier job were head of the sdk-java host-lock queue and waited the full 5400 s — tickets 239 and 257, on two different hosts — and the annotations name `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`. The test job held the lock across the 925 s suite, so a long sibling hold starved the fast tier and the gate then failed with the suite. The lock queue is shared across the ECS pool, so raising the wait again would only lower the probability.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Inspect the two lock-bearing steps: every Maven command is above the acquisition; the step seeds `${RUNNER_TEMP}/m2-repo` with `cp -aln` and passes `-Dmaven.repo.local`; the write-back follows the suite and closes fd 9 on its children.
- Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. The new skip tests fail if either best-effort guard or either bare-lock fallback assignment is removed.
- On the ECS pool, a fast-tier job should start Maven immediately; a busy or stale host lock should only produce `Maven cache write-back skipped`, with the job green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 257 (fast)` — no Maven ran. After (pinned by tests): the suite runs unlocked from the job-local repository; a failed write-back acquisition logs `Maven cache write-back skipped` and exits 0. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox with Node 22. No Java/MySQL toolchain is available, so the ECS pool path is pending CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the seed adds a hardlink copy to each self-hosted leg; the MariaDB lane already uses the same pattern. Under contention the write-back can be skipped, so the next job re-resolves some artifacts.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS host-lock queue and the Java/MySQL suites; no Java toolchain here, so CI is the final gate. The 5400 s budget and the `lock not acquired within` substring are unchanged.

prs.title: fix(ci): reuse open workflow failure issues
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Main CI failures reuse bot-owned `Main CI failed: <workflow>` issues, including legacy ` on <sha>` and ` — <test>` suffixes. Open issues are preferred, with a hidden workflow marker identifying retitled aggregates. If no open match exists, the reporter reopens a matching closed issue; otherwise it creates a fixed-title triage issue. Recurrences add comments with the existing failure summary and run attempt. After recording the comment, adoption best-effort appends the workflow marker to an unmarked issue body, preserving existing text; already-marked bodies are not edited.

Lookup and writing share a per-workflow concurrency group with `queue: max`. GitHub supports this option, but actionlint 1.7.12 does not recognize it, so the lint config ignores only that exact diagnostic for this workflow. New aggregates are not automatically assigned for repair. Only reusing a legacy-title issue removes `status/ready-for-agent` and `autofix/approved`, leaving assignments, active-repair labels, existing prose, and other labels unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Commit-based fallback deduplication creates another issue on each commit when a standing failure has no test identifier. Workflow aggregation prevents this proliferation without treating every notification as a separate repair task. This addresses #15166 through workflow aggregation rather than more error signatures.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

A failure should comment on a bot-owned open fixed-title issue or either legacy title form, selecting the oldest match in the listing. Other authors and PRs must not match. A retitled open bot issue should be recognized by its workflow marker. Without an open match, a matching closed issue should be reopened before commenting. Transient open lookups retry three times; exhausted open lookups abort without writing. A failed closed lookup falls back to creation. Only legacy-title issues lose old repair-eligibility labels; exact-title and marker-matched aggregates retain their labels. New issue creation must succeed even when adding triage labels fails.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI. The actual writer shell was exercised with a stubbed GitHub CLI and real jq. Passed: 75 focused workflow tests, 62 parser/renderer tests, repository-pinned actionlint 1.7.12 across the workflows, Prettier, ESLint, and `git diff --check`. Mutation checks confirmed that removing the author predicate or legacy-label gate makes the corresponding regression test fail.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ focused tests and lint |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ hosted workflow not executed |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node.js, Bash, jq, and repository test dependencies. GitHub writes were stubbed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: aggregates can contain unrelated failures and require triage. The GitHub queue is bounded to 100 pending jobs, not an unlimited delivery guarantee.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live failure was generated to test GitHub writes/scheduling; already-running repairs are not cancelled; replaying the same reporter can add a duplicate comment. No historical cleanup or changes to other reporters. Full application build/typecheck were not run for this workflow-only change. The local Qwen 0.25.3 full review gate is unverified: read-only plan mode blocked its skill/agent tools, so that attempt was stopped.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: new aggregates no longer automatically enter the repair queue; old eligibility labels are removed only when legacy-title issues are reused. Closed matching issues are reopened. Title lookups inspect up to 3000 open and 1000 recent closed issues; missing older closed matches or a failed closed lookup creates a fresh aggregate. Closed lookup is title-only, so any retitled closed issue can produce a fresh aggregate, even if its body already has the workflow marker.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15166

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

Main CI 失败复用由报告 bot 创建的 `Main CI failed: <workflow>` issue，兼容旧标题的 ` on <sha>` 和 ` — <test>` 后缀。优先使用 open issue，并通过隐藏 workflow 标记识别改过标题的汇总单。没有 open 匹配时重新打开匹配的 closed issue；仍无匹配时才创建固定标题的待分诊单。复发使用已有失败摘要追加评论，并注明运行 attempt。记录评论后，会尝试向被复用且缺少标记的 issue 正文追加 workflow 标记，保留原文；已有标记时不编辑正文。

查找和写入使用同一个按 workflow 分组的并发组，启用 `queue: max`。GitHub 已支持这个选项，但 actionlint 1.7.12 尚不识别，因此 lint 配置只忽略该工作流中这一条精确诊断。新汇总单不自动指派修复。仅复用旧格式标题单时移除 `status/ready-for-agent` 和 `autofix/approved`，保留指派、进行中标签、原正文和其他标签。

## 为什么需要

无法识别测试时，现有按 commit 去重会在持续失败期间为每个 commit 新建一单。按 workflow 汇总避免报警不断增加，也不再把每次通知当成独立修复任务。这里通过 workflow 汇总解决 #15166，不增加错误签名规则。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

有 bot 创建的固定标题或任一种旧标题 open issue 时应追加评论；多个匹配时选择列表中最早创建的。其他作者及 PR 不应匹配。改过标题的 open bot 汇总单应通过 workflow 标记识别。没有 open 匹配时，应先重开匹配的 closed issue 再评论。open 查找最多重试三次，全失败则不写入；closed 查找失败则降级为创建新单。仅旧格式标题单移除旧修复资格标签，固定标题和标记匹配的汇总单保留标签。新增分诊标签失败不能影响新单记录。

### 前后证据

UI 不适用。测试执行实际 writer shell，使用替代 GitHub CLI 和真实 jq。通过：75 个定向工作流测试、62 个解析/渲染测试、仓库固定版本 actionlint 1.7.12 对所有工作流的检查、Prettier、ESLint 和 `git diff --check`。变异检查确认：移除作者条件或旧标签清理门控后，相应回归测试会失败。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 定向测试及 lint |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未执行托管工作流 |

### 环境

本地 Node.js、Bash、jq 和仓库测试依赖。测试替代了真实 GitHub 写入。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：汇总单可能包含不同根因，需要分诊。GitHub 队列最多保留 100 个待执行任务，不保证无限排队。
- 未验证/范围外：未主动制造真实失败验证 GitHub 写入及调度；不取消已经开始的修复；重复执行同一次 reporter 可能再追加评论。不清理历史单，不修改其他报警入口。本次仅修改工作流，未运行完整应用 build/typecheck。本地 Qwen 0.25.3 完整评审引擎未验证：只读 plan 模式阻止了它调用 skill/agent，已停止该次尝试。
- 迁移说明：新汇总单不自动进入修复队列；仅旧格式标题单复用时移除旧修复资格标签。会重新打开匹配的 closed issue。标题查找最多检查 3000 个 open issue 和最近 1000 个 closed issue；更早的 closed 单未命中或 closed 查找失败时创建新汇总单。closed 查找仅按标题进行，因此任何已关闭且改名的 issue 都可能导致创建新汇总单，即使其正文已经有 workflow 标记。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15166

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite outside the host lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java test lane now seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache and runs the sdk-java suite, the SDK install, and the managed-agent H2 suite from that copy without the per-host lock. It takes the ticketed host lock only for the final cache write-back. A write-back lock that cannot be acquired within its budget now warns and skips the copy instead of failing a step whose suite already passed.

## Why it's needed

The Managed Agent gate failed on main commit `28c53fb50291` before any Java test ran. Both attempts of the fast-tier job were head of the sdk-java host-lock queue and waited the full 5400 seconds (tickets 258 and 271, on two different hosts), with the annotations naming `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes`. The test step held the lock across a ~925-second suite, so one sibling hold could exhaust the fast tier's entire budget. The MariaDB lane already scopes the same lock to its write-back; this applies that established pattern to the remaining lock site, so the suite starts immediately and only the optional cache copy can be delayed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step: the seed and every `mvn` command come before the lock acquisition, and the acquisition plus the `timeout 300 find … -links 1 -exec cp` write-back follow it. The write-back's `mkdir` and `find` children close fd 9 so a cancelled job's survivor cannot retain the lock.

Stub `sdk_java_lock_acquire` to return 1 (the focused workflow test does this in a scratch HOME) and confirm the step logs `Maven cache write-back skipped`, exits 0, and never creates `~/.m2/repository`. The focused Vitest files under Verification pin the new ordering, the skip guard, and the workflow size baseline.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI plumbing, not user-visible.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Sandboxed Linux checkout; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and focused Vitest only. There is no Java/Maven toolchain locally, so the Java lanes were not executed; CI is the final validation.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: every self-hosted Java leg now seeds from the host cache into a job-local repository and publishes only its nlink-1 delta; a missed write-back leaves the host cache slightly staler for the next job, which re-resolves it. This is the same tradeoff the MariaDB lane has used since #15128.
- Not validated / out of scope: the ECS pool and its shared lock queue are not available locally, and the full Java/MySQL suites were not run here. The MariaDB write-back site keeps its existing fail-closed behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15285

prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java test lane now seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache, runs the SDK suite, the SDK install, and the Managed Agent suite from that copy without the per-host lock, and takes the ticketed host lock only for the final cache write-back. The write-back's `mkdir` and bounded `find`/`cp` children close fd 9 so a cancelled job's survivor cannot retain the lock. Both lock sites in the workflow now follow the same write-back-only rule, and the cache loop is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Run 39771949573's fast-tier job failed in `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` on both attempts, each time after exactly 5400 seconds, with the annotation `sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes as queue ticket 223 (fast)`. The job was waiting, not testing: the full-tier Java 21 leg of run 39754414693 ran for 89 minutes on the same host range, and the fast job failed five seconds after that leg ended. #15128 scoped the MariaDB lane's lock to its cache write-back, but the test job still serialized its whole suite on the same lock. A loaded host can therefore consume the entire fast-tier budget before Maven starts. This change removes that failure mode for the fast tier and shortens the test job's own hold to the write-back.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Inspect the self-hosted test step: the job-local repository seed and every Maven command should appear before the `source .../sdk-java-lock.sh` acquisition, and the write-back should follow it with `mkdir ... 9>&-` and the bounded `find ... 9>&-` copy. Run `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts sdk-java-workflow workflow-size` from the repository root and expect 351 passed, 1 skipped. On the next ECS pool run, the `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step should start Maven without a `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; any lock wait is now limited to the final write-back.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI-only change; no user-visible interface.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.2 on Linux. Java and Maven are not installed in the sandbox, so the Java suites were not run locally; the workflow and its Node pins were verified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the test job's Maven suites now run concurrently with other pool jobs instead of serializing on the host lock. This follows #15128's write-back-only scoping for the MariaDB lane; the host-shared Maven cache is still protected by the seed/write-back lock, and the write-back children close fd 9.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Maven suites themselves on a real ECS host (CI owns that), and any change to the 5400 s budget or the job ceilings.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The `lock not acquired within` signature, the bare-lock fallback for older release tags, and the tier priority are unchanged.
- Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md).

prs.title: fix(core): recover outer XML calls with quoted call content
prs.body:
## Summary

Recover a complete outer XML tool call whose parameter value quotes other calls, while keeping the quoted markup inert. An ambiguous or malformed block is now rejected on its own and the scan resumes past it, so one bad envelope no longer costs the genuine calls beside it.

## What this changes

- Closes the reported gap in #13492: a `write_file` whose `content` contains an unfenced example call is recovered exactly once with the complete content, and the quoted call never dispatches.
- Rejects ambiguity per block instead of per turn. The whole-text opener pre-scan, the unclosed-opener veto and the fence-disagreement pass that used to return no calls for the whole turn are gone; a rejected block resumes at its own next open tag.
- Reads a depth-paired value's complete extent when the value documents a nested parameter element, instead of stopping at the flat match.
- Treats HTML comments and CommonMark indented code blocks as documentation, like fences and `<example>`. A value that quotes a call used to let a commented-out shell command dispatch while stripping its own markup from the visible turn.
- Rejects a block whose parameter names repeat, because the quote advance can otherwise pull a stray element into the block and silently overwrite an argument.
- Keeps a value that only mentions a bare closing tag on the flat path, so that block is rejected rather than dispatched with a truncated write.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Return a document write whose content quotes a harmless call, followed by an independent control-file read. Expect the write executed once with exact bytes, the quoted call inert, and the read executed.

Then vary the shape: a trailing parameter behind the quoted value, a documented parameter element inside the value, the same shape inside a fence, an `<example>`, an HTML comment and an indented block, a malformed block before an intact call, and a prose mention of `<!--` before a live call. Expect documentation to stay inert and the intact calls to recover.

## Evidence

- `packages/core`: `xml-tool-call-fallback.test.ts` 138/138, `llm-chat.test.ts` 567/567; typecheck, ESLint and Prettier clean on both changed files.
- 6000-case seeded fuzz over tag/fence/comment fragments: no exception, no hang, max 2.8 ms; `recovered: false` never changes `remainingText`.
- Cost after deleting the whole-turn pre-scan: 1000 malformed openers inside a fence ~1 ms (was ~2.2 s at the reviewed head), 64 KB example body ~13 ms (was ~420 ms).
- No CLI/tmux end-to-end run this round. The production call site is unchanged; the earlier CLI evidence covered the whole-turn decline, which this version removes.

## Risk & Scope

The contract changes from turn-wide decline to per-block rejection. That is what #13492 asks for, and it restores the three witnesses the branch had inverted. It also means a complete call inside a rejected block's unclosed value is recovered again, as on the merge base.

Known limitation: a value that only mentions a bare closing tag, without quoting a complete call, still rejects its block. Accepting it would dispatch the truncated value pinned by `preserves malformed blocks instead of dispatching partial calls`, so this keeps `Refs` rather than `Fixes`.

Performance #13787 stays open: the remaining per-value fence scans are quadratic in the number of value-quoting blocks. Windows and macOS were not run locally.

## Linked issues

Refs #13492. Follow-up to #13515.

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

外层调用在参数值里引用其它调用（例如 `write_file` 的 content 里写了一段示例 call）时，现在只恢复一次外层调用、保留完整 content，被引用的调用保持为数据；参数、example 或围栏归属有歧义时，只拒绝出问题的那个 block 并从它自己的下一个 open tag 继续扫描，不再让整轮失败。

同时把 HTML 注释与 CommonMark 缩进代码块当作文档区（此前值里引用调用会让被注释掉的 shell 命令被执行，且标记从可见文本中消失），并拒绝参数名重复的 block（quote advance 可能把游离元素拉进 block 并覆盖前面的参数）。

验证：`xml-tool-call-fallback.test.ts` 138/138、`llm-chat.test.ts` 567/567，两个改动文件 typecheck/ESLint/Prettier 干净；6000 例种子 fuzz 无异常、无挂起；1000 个围栏内畸形 opener 约 1ms（此前约 2.2s），64KB example 约 13ms（此前约 420ms）。本轮未跑 CLI/tmux 端到端，生产调用点未变。

已知限制：值里只提及裸结束标记（没有引用完整调用）时仍拒绝该 block，因为接受它会派发被 `preserves malformed blocks instead of dispatching partial calls` 钉住的截断值，因此尾注保持 `Refs`。性能 #13787 继续跟进。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add filtered session title queries
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds literal, case-insensitive title queries to the public and WebShell Session lists, with filtering before pagination and cursors bound to the selected title query and archive state. The public list also gains archive filtering and the `include_archived` compatibility alias; omitting filters preserves the existing all-Sessions default.

The Java WebShell provider advertises title-search support and renders an independent, localized title input capped at 512 characters. A new query resets the loaded page and cancels the previous request; the first page and every subsequent page carry the same `titleQuery`. Existing navigation search remains responsible for Session IDs and Workspace names. While a title query is active, navigation is limited to the server-returned Sessions so a selected Session summary that does not match cannot reappear; lifecycle actions retain their full summary set.

This PR is stacked on #15100 and targets its branch. Merge #15100 first, then retarget this PR to main. It reuses that PR's archive filtering and leaves its lifecycle UI and export work intact.

## Why it's needed

#15077 needs server-side filtering across the full readable history. Filtering a loaded page can hide matches on later pages. The WebShell also needs a title-specific control so title filtering is explicit without changing the existing Session ID and Workspace navigation search semantics.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-query/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-session-query.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-session-query/docs/design/2026-10-22-managed-session-query.zh-CN.md).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Search for a mixed-case title containing literal `%` and `_` across archived and unarchived Sessions. Both APIs should filter before taking the page limit, return each matching Session once in unchanged history, and reject a cursor reused with a different title query or archive filter. In WebShell, the Java provider should show the localized title input, send the query on the initial list and Load more requests, clear stale rows when the query changes, and keep the existing navigation search behavior for IDs and Workspace names. A selected Session whose title does not match must not be injected into title-filtered navigation. Omitted filters should retain all readable, undeleted Sessions. Conflicting explicit archive filters should return 400, and another tenant must not see the Sessions.

A focused contract regression was added but not executed. Source review covered SQL parameter ordering, tenant/Workspace predicates, cursor compatibility, provider forwarding, query reset/cancellation, the 512-character input limit, and the filtered navigation candidate set. At the user's request, no local tests, builds, typechecks, lint, formatting, installs or CI waits were performed for this PR.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the public API could not apply archive filters, neither API could filter by title before pagination, and the WebShell had no explicit title-search control. After: both APIs accept the documented filters and bind query cursors to them; the Java WebShell provider exposes the localized title input and forwards it through every page; filtered navigation uses only returned Sessions. These are source-level findings; runtime behavior remains unverified. No screenshots were captured.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not run |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not run |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not run |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: substring matching can scan authorized candidates; database case-folding behavior applies. No performance claim.
- Not validated / follow-up: local and database-specific execution, CI results, runtime qualification, and any future combined-search contract. Concurrent renames/archive changes are not snapshot-isolated.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive contract version 1.85.0; no schema migration. Existing unfiltered cursors remain valid for `all`, and existing archive cursors retain their filter binding. A changed title query requires a new cursor.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15077, #15084. Depends on #15100. #15077 remains open for runtime qualification and any future combined-search decision.

为公共和 WebShell Session 列表加入不区分大小写的字面标题查询，在分页之前过滤，并将游标绑定到标题查询和归档状态。公共列表同时支持归档过滤和 `include_archived` 兼容别名；省略过滤条件保留现有全部 Session 的默认值。

### 前后证据

prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and rejection of an oversized direct text resource before the daemon peer echo. Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and daemon pre-echo rejection. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are rejected before live echo. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. A direct ACP prompt above the new text-resource replay limit now returns invalid parameters.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将有大小上限的原始 ACP 嵌入式文本 `resource` 块与所属用户 Prompt 一同持久化，并在回放时恢复为带类型的用户消息块。Daemon UI SDK 将其与 `resource_link`、原生附件区分，并支持离线 transcript 投影。原生附件展开结果按输入位置识别，因此即使另一个直接资源与它使用相同 URI，也仍可独立回放。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 已能把嵌入式资源用作模型上下文，但刷新或重启后此前只恢复 Prompt 文字。客户端因此丢失原始上下文引用，尽管助手回复仍可见。本 PR 修复 #12538 的持久化与回放缺口；它不同于 #12088 的 `resource_link` 修复。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

依次发送包含文字和文本资源的 ACP Prompt、纯资源 Prompt、以及后续纯文字 Prompt。检查保存的用户记录与加载后的 transcript：每个资源都应作为带类型的用户消息块保留在原轮次，包含 URI、MIME 类型、文本、元数据、Prompt ID 和来源记录身份；不得迁移到后续轮次，也不得根据 URI 抓取内容。另需检查 rewind/有效分支回放、超过 256 KiB 的原生附件、与原生附件同 URI 的直接资源，以及超限直接文本资源在 Daemon 向其他客户端回显前被拒绝。定向桥接、CLI、持久化和 SDK 测试覆盖这些场景。

### 前后证据

修复前：新增的录制与回放回归测试在旧源码上失败，类型化资源在回放后缺失。修复后：定向测试通过，包括纯资源、同 URI 并存和 Daemon 回显前拒绝。本 PR 未声称完成运行中 Daemon 或浏览器录屏。

### 已测试系统

| :----------: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint 与测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.1；包级测试脚本与打包后的 `dist/cli.js` 基础检查。未运行真实 ACP Daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：直接提供的嵌入式文本资源会作为有界的用户内容进入持久 transcript；每个 Prompt 的序列化资源回放预算为 256 KiB。超限直接文本资源在实时回显前被拒绝。原生附件沿用独立存储路径；新 Daemon 请求按来源排除。缺少位置字段的旧元数据只排除 URI 唯一对应的块；歧义块会保留，也可能触及内联限额。
- 未验证／范围外：运行中 Daemon 的 JSONL 与重启后 `session/load` 回读、浏览器刷新验收、内联 blob 资源持久化，以及从未保存资源的旧记录恢复。下游客户端需要渲染新的类型化 SDK 字段才能显示卡片。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无需记录迁移，旧记录继续可读。超过新文本资源回放上限的直接 ACP Prompt 现在返回参数错误。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(cli): harden serve token resolution against project env injection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Hardens how `qwen serve` resolves its daemon bearer token. The token is now accepted only from operator-controlled sources: the `--token` flag, an exported `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN` environment variable, or a home-scoped `.env` file. Repository-controlled configuration — a project `.env` or `.qwen/.env`, or workspace `settings.env` — can no longer preset the daemon bearer before startup, regardless of workspace trust state. When the operator supplies no token through those channels, startup falls back to the documented one-time random bearer generation, so serving on a non-loopback address inside a freshly cloned repository always produces a fresh credential instead of inheriting one from repository contents.

## Why it's needed

Values in repository-controlled env files are authored by whoever wrote the repository, not by the operator running `qwen serve`. Accepting them as the daemon bearer let cloned repository content silently preset the credential and bypassed the documented one-time random bearer behavior. Consolidating every load path behind one scope-based exclusion rule also removes drift between the serve bootstrap fast path and the full environment loader, which previously applied different tiers of the same rule to this key.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In any repository, add `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN=<some-fixed-value>` to the project `.env`.
2. Run `qwen serve --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port <port>` without exporting `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN`. Expected: the repository value is ignored, startup generates a one-time random bearer as documented, and requests authenticated with the repository-supplied value are rejected with 401. Before this change, the repository value silently became the daemon credential and no random bearer was generated.
3. Confirm operator channels still work: restart with `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN` exported in the shell (or with `--token <value>`, or with the key in a home-scoped `.env` such as `~/.qwen/.env`) — the explicitly supplied token authenticates against the daemon as before.

Unit coverage flips the relevant assertions and adds cases: repository `.env` / `.qwen/.env` / workspace `settings.env` values are rejected (including lowercase spellings and a trusted-workspace variant), each rejection paired with a positive control proving unrelated keys still load, and the home-scoped anchor case is unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — env-loading behavior, no TUI/Web surface. Targeted unit suites covering the changed rules (shared-env-keys, environment, serve fast path) all pass locally; see How to verify for the observable startup behavior.

|  🍏 macOS  |      ✅ tested       |

|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ not tested      |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

Isolated worktree build: `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and targeted `vitest` suites for the changed config/serve areas.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the serve fast path's workspace/user `settings.json` `env.QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN` channel is retired so every load path shares one rule; setups using it move to `--token`, an exported env var, or a home-scoped `.env`.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux not run locally (left to CI); no behavior change for operator-supplied tokens or for unrelated env keys.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: configurations that relied on a project `.env` or workspace `settings.env` to supply `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN` must switch to `--token`, an exported environment variable, or a home-scoped `.env`; workspace trust no longer waives this rule.

## Linked Issues

N/A — proactive hardening, no tracking issue.

N/A——环境加载行为，无 TUI/Web 界面。覆盖改动规则的定向单元套件（shared-env-keys、environment、serve fast path）本地全部通过；可观察的启动行为见"如何验证"。

macOS ✅ 已测；Windows ⚠️ 未在本地测试；Linux ⚠️ 未在本地测试（交由 CI）。

- 主要风险或取舍：serve fast path 的 workspace/user `settings.json` 中 `env.QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN` 渠道被移除，以使所有加载路径共用同一条规则；使用该渠道的设置需改为 `--token`、导出的环境变量或 home 层 `.env`。

N/A——主动加固，无跟踪 issue。

prs.title: feat(cli): ship private Bun and preserve interpreter boundaries
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes explicit OpenTUI sessions work from supported POSIX npm/npx installations without a global Bun installation. Node remains the launcher and package-manager interpreter; selected interactive sessions use the same installation’s private Bun 1.3.14 through the existing supervisor. The delivery preserves standalone interpreter selection and update boundaries, native/parser assets, executable bits and the default Ink behavior.

This is one consolidated distribution change: **49 files, +2,581/−310, 2,891 changed lines**. The local candidate is `cf0bb9d6db84594020951c88d9970ff46d357856`, based on `0d353777` and main `19d3289f`, including merged #14046 and #15067. **cf0 is the published review candidate; its GitHub CI is running/queued, not fully green.** The named local artifact/update contracts below have closed; the three separate synthetic IPC cases passed. The named local scope is validated for code review; pending CI is not merge approval or completion of the overall migration.

## Why it's needed

A user opting into OpenTUI through npm needs a working runtime and complete native/parser assets, while npm operations must continue using the original Node identity. Treating the application launcher and a JavaScript interpreter as interchangeable can also break workers or updates in standalone installations. This change carries those identities through the existing launch, supervision and update paths without replacing the package manager or supervisor, switching the renderer default, or upgrading the pinned runtime.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm an npm/npx installation with no global Bun can open a strict OpenTUI session, render highlighted output, run an actual inner PTY shell and submit/receive model messages. Verify the observed chain is Node 22 → that installation’s private Bun → that installation’s CLI. Repeat with normal, global/npx and ignore-scripts layouts; omission or damage of required runtime/assets must produce the documented fallback or strict refusal.

Confirm headless/protocol/help/version commands retain their invoking runtime, including headless commands when private Bun is present. Verify first foreground SIGINT leaves the session usable, confirmed interruption exits, and parent-only termination does not leave the Bun child behind. Review managed/manual update activation, failure preservation and original Node npm identity. Confirm the same real wrapper restarts on exit44 while preserving arguments, cwd, Unicode environment, relative npm configuration and hooks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the main `19d3289f` npm-package producer does not declare an installation-owned pinned Bun; this comparison is against source, not a newly inspected published package. After: the fresh cf0 package installed in five owned layouts, and strict installed sessions exercised the actual Node/private-Bun/CLI chain and native/parser resources. Detailed current-artifact E2E evidence will be posted separately from the historical checkpoints.

| Current cf0 evidence | Result and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| Fresh bundle, prepared package, executable bits and actual tarball | Passed; five installations: local, global, npx, ignore-scripts and omit-optional. Tar SHA256 `f6429e3c0b1159860f5df97089e46962ab4467dc05e182baaef07ce7a67b072a`; unpacked size **152,173,439 bytes**, below 160 MiB. Optional Bun installation size is separate. |
| JSON18; inner PTY2; installed Vim3 | JSON18: **16 functional passes + two characterized Ink deny gaps**; two real inner PTY cases passed; three Vim paste/undo cases passed through the real launcher handoff. |
| Core11; available-private-Bun headless2 | Core11: **seven functional passes + four expected startup rejections**. Its internal forced cleanup does not prove natural exit. Headless2 passed with finite fresh Node process observations and exit0; no universal zero-spawn claim. |
| Lifecycle1+8; modes8 and omit2 | Passed their named assertions, including actual product identities gone before fixture cleanup and five required terminal restorations. Preserve the Ink direct-owner SIGKILL terminal-restoration exception. Keeper cleanup/unknown exit numbers and the ACP termination branch are not relabeled natural exits. |
| Compatibility5; resources2 | Compatibility: four functional passes + one expected refusal. Resources successor cases passed with actual exit130 and the expected startup exit1; the original exit-observer failure remains recorded. |
| Managed activation1 | Passed with two model requests, two quit0 exits, npm installation exit0 and observed original-Node smoke. Worker numeric exit was not observed; this uses owned synthetic 0.0.0 metadata and the candidate package, not two released versions. |
| Managed 503 rollback1 | Passed: npm installation exit1; active pin absent and versions directory empty; the old session/pin still completed one model request and quit0. Smoke was NOT_REACHED and worker numeric exit NOT_OBSERVED. Receipt SHA256 `5444dedb84d4e54c0ffd50061faa8371b763de897be8ecc929fd41067a91ff7f`. |
| Manual updates2 | Both passed: each made two model requests, npm install0, observed the current target pin and smoke, preserved arguments/cwd/Unicode environment/relative npm configuration/hooks, restarted the same real wrapper and naturally closed its final PTY with exit0. Ink had no Bun handoff and original Node exit-event44. OpenTUI observed the actual Bun child close44/signalnull and original Node exit-event44, then the target installation’s private Bun path/SHA/mode and new Node chain. Worker numeric exit remains NOT_OBSERVED. |
| Separate synthetic IPC3 | **3 passed**, each exit0/signalnull,26.092s. Independent synthetic wrapper/module protocol fixtures are separate from actual41-product contracts; standalone producer remains NOT_RUN. Closing SHA256 `6bc7a8398946eb1f80a373ceb358befe6b0c57a33589981c7586255b66bddd5d`. |

Build/typecheck and focused core130, CLI320 and scripts289 results belong to `0d353777`. A verified mode/blob comparison across 12,664 tracked entries found only the four bilingual document changes in cf0; that exact production/dependency equivalence supports reuse of the named source checks. **Twelve Windows-only script cases remain LOCAL_NOT_RUN.** Bundle, tarball and installed-product evidence above were executed freshly for cf0. These groups overlap in purpose and include refusals/gaps; they are not added into one undifferentiated pass count.

The original41-case contract ledger is closed, retaining five explicit startup-refusal cases and the separately described Ink deny/lifecycle exceptions; this is not41 unconditional functional passes. Original FAIL, GAP, NOT_RUN and corrected-harness results remain attributed to their original source/artifact. Manual receipts: Ink `648ceb424d6d6cc01176e262ec2df81a186b69f7d0c4dd592151c0cd1e103232`; OpenTUI `037c3c08209a2a1b1773548b0c9752e70f48114b221b249c6d0905729ea8eedb`. The original Ink collection failure `21435ccc` executed zero product/npm/HTTP operations and remains preserved. See the [review transfer and recorded deferrals](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14959#issuecomment-6308836534) and [historical installed checkpoint](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14959#issuecomment-6338251880); neither substitutes for current evidence.

Current exact-cf0 CI snapshot: [native-boundary workflow](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39837476575) has Native Linux/x64/arm64 jobs SUCCESS and Native Windows settings/streams IN_PROGRESS; [TUI parity/no-flicker](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39837476597) is IN_PROGRESS; [Managed Agent gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39837476758) is QUEUED. No failure was present at this snapshot; skipped jobs are not passes. Hosted job status does not establish installed-package acceptance on another platform.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | Actual cf0 npm package and named installed/runtime/update cases on arm64; the three separate synthetic IPC cases passed. |
| 🪟 Windows | Installed Qwen/private-Bun handoff not accepted. Separate ConPTY diagnostics are not this product’s acceptance. |
| 🐧 Linux | Linux installed-package/native-kernel acceptance remains separate; macOS execution and hosted source checks do not establish it. |

### Environment (optional)

Owned macOS arm64 HOME/QWEN_HOME, npm prefixes/caches and workspaces; actual npm tarball, Node22 and installation-owned Bun1.3.14, with Node/Ink, Bun/Ink and strict OpenTUI legs where named. Controlled model HTTP and real PTYs provide the declared product evidence. No production Bun/OpenTUI upgrade or default-renderer switch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: runtime handoff, signal/IPC ownership and updates must preserve the original Node npm identity. Core/config/auth and cross-package interpreter consumers require explicit maintainer review during formal CR.
- Not validated / out of scope: this is **POSIX opt-in npm distribution review**, not completed all-TUI migration. Windows/Linux installed acceptance, the standalone target matrix, signed/released-version upgrades, the shared historical serve-shutdown failure and real terminal-resize acceptance remain tracked. Windows/musl private handoff is excluded. 
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no renderer/default-runtime change, startup runtime download, new backend or dependency upgrade. Existing Node/Ink, headless/protocol and standalone runtime/update contracts remain the compatibility boundary.

Synchronized designs at cf0: [npm distribution — English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cf0bb9d6db84594020951c88d9970ff46d357856/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-npm-distribution.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cf0bb9d6db84594020951c88d9970ff46d357856/docs/design/2026-10-21-opentui-npm-distribution.zh-CN.md); [runtime boundary — English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cf0bb9d6db84594020951c88d9970ff46d357856/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.md), [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cf0bb9d6db84594020951c88d9970ff46d357856/docs/design/bun-runtime-boundary.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Related to #11607. Incorporates accepted #14046/#15067 and consolidates the existing distribution/update work; this PR does not close the overall runtime or Ink-parity migration umbrella.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

让受支持的 POSIX npm/npx 安装在没有全局 Bun 时也能显式启动 OpenTUI。Node 继续负责启动器与包管理；被选中的交互会话经既有 supervisor 使用同一安装的私有 Bun 1.3.14。保留 standalone 解释器选择和更新边界、native/parser 资产、执行权限与默认 Ink 行为。

这是一个整合的分发批次：**49 文件，+2,581/−310，共 2,891 行变更**。本地候选为 `cf0bb9d6db84594020951c88d9970ff46d357856`，基于 `0d353777` 和 main `19d3289f`，包含已合并 #14046、#15067。**cf0现已发布为审查候选；GitHub CI仍在运行/排队，不能称全部绿色。** 下列具名本地产物/更新合同已闭合；另三个独立synthetic IPC用例通过。具名本地范围已验证，可进入代码审查；pending CI不代表可合并或整体迁移完成。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认没有全局 Bun 的 npm/npx 安装可进入 strict OpenTUI，渲染语法高亮、运行真实内部 PTY shell，并提交/接收模型消息。观察真实链为 Node22 → 此安装的私有 Bun → 此安装的 CLI。覆盖普通、global/npx 和 ignore-scripts 布局；省略或损坏必要运行时/资产时，必须出现约定 fallback 或 strict 拒绝。

| 🪟 Windows | 安装版 Qwen/private-Bun handoff 未验收；独立 ConPTY 诊断不代表本产品通过。 |

prs.title: test(managed-agent): retry the team-lead boot past the harness port race
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the team-lead Hosted MySQL integration test's boot resilient to the harness losing its reserved port. The test reserves its three ports up front, but the Node harness binds its port only after Spring has finished booting. When a busy runner reassigns that port in the gap, `qwen serve` advances to the next port instead of failing, so the test's `/capabilities` poll waits on the stale port until it times out. The boot now retries the whole attempt with fresh ports when the harness reports that move, matching the existing retry that already covered Spring and the embedded broker.

## Why it's needed

`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT.teamCallsAskWithTheirInputInDefaultMode` failed in the Managed Agent hosted MySQL lane and blocked the gate. Main's gate has passed repeatedly on the same code, so this is a timing-dependent boot race rather than a product regression. Leaving it unfixed means the class can fail again whenever the runner is contended.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` in the hosted MySQL lane. All three tests should pass, including the approval test's four action cards, their input previews, the agent launch answer and the member report. Running the class repeatedly under load exercises the new retry path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only stability change with no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: build, typecheck, lint and the focused serve port-retry Vitest passed. The Java/MySQL integration test could not run in this sandbox.

### Environment (optional)

Node 22 sandbox without a JDK, Maven or MySQL; CI's hosted MySQL lane is the final witness for the Java test.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a bind conflict now also restarts Spring and the harness with fresh ports. The retry is bounded to three attempts and only runs when a port is lost, so a genuine startup failure still surfaces.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Java integration test and its mutation probe could not run here; they are covered by the hosted MySQL lane.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test-only.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15205
