prs.title: test(cli): budget hosted approval waits for slow runners (#15176)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change budgets the two hosted approval test suites through the repository's existing slow-host policy instead of a fixed wait. The continuation suite and the inline-limit suite both wait for a Turn's serial chain of fsync-backed durable writes; on a shared or saturated runner that chain now gets a 45 s wait under a 60 s per-test ceiling, while fast hosts keep their current 10 s wait and 20 s / 30 s ceilings. The polling assertions and inputs are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The post-merge `Qwen Code CI` run at `15f3226db5` failed three cases in these suites: two `allow` continuations at round 0 and the 62,000-byte inline-limit `allow` case. Both suites pass locally and the next main commit passed, so the failure is a contention flake rather than a deterministic product break.

The wait covers a serial run of fsync-backed publishes and journal commits. A delayed-write probe reproduces the exact CI signature: adding 11 s to the options publish makes the fast path fail after 10 s with `expected 'before_model' to be 'await_action'`. Sibling approval tests have already been widened twice for the same reason; this change applies the same slow-host policy to these two suites without weakening any assertion.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the suites still pass on the fast path:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/test-utils/slow-test-host.test.ts src/serve/hosted-approval-continuation.test.ts src/serve/hosted-approval-inline-limit.test.ts
```

To reproduce the original failure and the fix, temporarily delay the `managed-action-options` publish by 11 s inside the continuation test. Without `RUNNER_NAME` the case fails at the 10 s fast budget with `before_model` instead of `await_action`; with `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-probe` the same case passes in about 11.5 s. The temporary probe is not part of the commit.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change with no user-visible behavior. The delayed-write probe above shows the before (10 s fast budget times out on an 11 s durable publish) and after (slow-host budget passes the same publish).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux sandbox, Node 22, Vitest with v8 coverage. The first `npm run build` failed before compiling because the sandbox denied writes to the default corepack cache; rerunning with `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` passed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: on a slow non-ECS host the wait can now reach 45 s, so a genuine hang takes longer to surface. The 60 s per-test ceiling still keeps it inside the runner timeout, and a real stall fails on the assertion.
- Not validated / out of scope: the exact failing runner was not available locally; the delayed-write probe reproduces the failure signature and the fix is verified against it. No production code changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15176

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本变更通过仓库已有的慢主机策略为两个托管审批测试套件分配预算，而不是使用固定等待。continuation 套件和 inline-limit 套件都在等待一轮 Turn 的串行 fsync 持久化写入链；在共享或饱和的 runner 上，这条链现在会在 60 秒单测试上限内获得 45 秒等待，而快速主机保留当前的 10 秒等待和 20 秒 / 30 秒上限。轮询断言和输入均未改变。

## 为什么需要

合并后的 `Qwen Code CI` 在 `15f3226db5` 上失败，涉及这些套件中的三个用例：两个 round 0 的 `allow` continuation，以及 62,000 字节的 inline-limit `allow` 用例。两个套件在本地都能通过，且 main 上的下一个提交也通过了，因此这是资源竞争导致的偶发失败，而不是确定性的产品故障。

该等待覆盖一串 fsync 持久化发布和日志提交。延迟写入探针可以精确复现 CI 的失败特征：将选项发布增加 11 秒后，快速路径在 10 秒时失败并输出 `expected 'before_model' to be 'await_action'`。同类的审批测试已经因相同原因被放宽过两次；本变更在不削弱任何断言的前提下，对这两个套件应用相同的慢主机策略。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认套件在快速路径上仍然通过：

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/test-utils/slow-test-host.test.ts src/serve/hosted-approval-continuation.test.ts src/serve/hosted-approval-inline-limit.test.ts
```

要复现原始失败和修复，可在 continuation 测试中临时将 `managed-action-options` 发布延迟 11 秒。未设置 `RUNNER_NAME` 时，该用例会在 10 秒快速预算处失败，输出 `before_model` 而不是 `await_action`；设置 `RUNNER_NAME=ecs-qwen-probe` 后，同一用例约 11.5 秒通过。临时探针不属于提交内容。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用 —— 仅测试变更，无用户可见行为。上述延迟写入探针展示了修复前（10 秒快速预算在 11 秒持久化发布上超时）和修复后（慢主机预算让同一发布通过）。

### 测试环境

| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux 沙箱，Node 22，启用 v8 覆盖率的 Vitest。首次 `npm run build` 在编译前失败，因为沙箱不允许写入默认 corepack 缓存；使用 `COREPACK_HOME=/tmp/corepack-home` 重跑后通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：在慢速非 ECS 主机上，等待现在可达 45 秒，因此真正的卡死需要更久才会暴露。60 秒单测试上限仍将其限制在 runner 超时之内，真正的卡死会因断言失败而暴露。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本地无法使用确切的失败 runner；延迟写入探针复现了失败特征，并已针对该特征验证修复。无生产代码变更。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

prs.title: feat(serve): bind reviewed PR when a /review prompt is admitted
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a Web Shell session runs `/review <PR number or URL>`, the daemon now binds that PR to the session as soon as it admits the prompt. The session sidebar shows the PR badge after the normal catalog refresh, and session search matches the PR number. The binding reuses the existing session PR pipeline — the same command grammar, repository checks, URL resolution, provenance ranking, sidecar writer, and cap — and only adds a live entry point in front of it. Two review rounds tightened that entry point: a new review now joins the cap plan so it can replace the oldest review when the session is full, and the commit re-checks the session's location and liveness under the archive lane so it never resurrects a deleted session or strands an archived one's binding in the active directory.

## Why it's needed

The sidebar could already show which PR a session belongs to, but only through an on-demand backfill of stored transcripts. That backfill was never triggered by the normal Web Shell flow, and a brand-new session can bind before its transcript file exists. As a result, a user running several `/review` rounds could not tell which session reviewed which PR. Binding at admission closes both gaps without adding a second parser or a second writer. The review fixes close the two failure modes that admission introduced: a full session could never replace an old review, and an archive/delete that completed between the snapshot and the lane could write metadata into the wrong directory.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `/review <PR number>` in a Web Shell session on a trusted workspace, then wait for the normal session catalog refresh. Expected: the session row shows `#<PR number>`, and searching for that number finds the session. Run an ordinary prompt and `/review <file path>` in another session. Expected: no PR badge appears for either.

To verify the two review fixes directly, run the three regression tests in `packages/cli`:

- `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts -t "evicts the oldest review when a live /review reaches the cap"` — a session pre-filled with ten `source: 'review'` bindings and then `/review 11` must end at `[2..11]`, not stay frozen at `[1..10]`.
- `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts -t "writes a live bind into the archived sidecar"` — an archive completed between the snapshot read and the lane must put #77 in the archived sidecar and leave the active sidecar absent.
- `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts -t "does not resurrect a deleted live session sidecar"` — a delete in the same window must leave both sidecars absent.

### Evidence and mutation table

Each mutation below was applied temporarily to the fixed code, run, and then reverted. The mutation result is the real assertion message and exit code; the fixed result is the same test after the revert. All rows were measured at commit `8a0a6cae66d23614699bcd6521069afb9ba8dbb6`.

| Check | Test | Mutation applied | Mutation result (measured) | Fixed result (measured) | Commit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cap eviction | `evicts the oldest review when a live /review reaches the cap` | set `liveReviewOccupants = []` | `AssertionError: expected { …(9) } to match object { bound: 1, overLimit: 1 }` with `bound: 0`; `EXIT:1`; `Tests 1 failed, 109 skipped` | `bound: 1`, sidecar `[2..11]`; `EXIT:0`; `Tests 1 passed, 109 skipped` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| Archive race | `writes a live bind into the archived sidecar when the session is archived before the lane` | force the pre-lane path after re-resolution | `AssertionError: expected null to match object [ { number: 77 } ]`; `EXIT:1`; `Tests 1 failed, 109 skipped` | archived sidecar `[77]`, active `null`; `EXIT:0`; `Tests 1 passed, 109 skipped` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| Delete race | `does not resurrect a deleted live session sidecar` | bypass the bridge liveness check | `AssertionError: expected { …(9) } to match object { bound: +0, written: +0 }` with `bound: 1, written: 1`; `EXIT:1`; `Tests 1 failed, 109 skipped` | `bound: 0, written: 0`; `EXIT:0`; `Tests 1 passed, 109 skipped` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| Baseline | full backfill suite | none | — | `Tests 110 passed (110)`; `EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| Prompt route | `server.test.ts -t "POST /session/:id/prompt"` | none | — | `Tests 43 passed, 1345 skipped`; `EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| Full server suite | `server.test.ts --retry=2` | none | — | `Tests 1388 passed (1388)`; `EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| Build | `npm run build` | none | — | `EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| Typecheck | `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npm run typecheck` | none | — | `EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |

The full server suite needs `--retry=2` in this environment. Some runs show one or two transient failures in unrelated tests; each passes in isolation. This behavior predates the review fixes and is recorded as an environment flake.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only. `npm run build` was run first in the checkout; `packages/cli` typecheck, ESLint, and Prettier pass.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: each `/review` prompt now issues one background PR-resolution query (`gh pr list` on GitHub, `mr view` on Aone). The work is idempotent and best-effort, and a failed bind never affects the turn. When `gh` is unavailable, a GitHub number falls back to the workspace remote URL, the same fallback the sweep uses; a fork checkout can therefore produce a non-canonical link.
- Cap behavior: a live bind can evict an older `source: 'review'` binding when the sidecar is full. `create`, `worktree`, and pre-provenance entries keep their slots. The sweep's cap plan is unchanged.
- Lifecycle behavior: a live bind re-resolves the session location inside the archive lane. An archived session writes the archived sidecar; a deleted session is skipped; an unresolvable location fails closed. A missing transcript is allowed only when the bridge still owns the session (a brand-new turn). The sweep keeps its pre-lane path: a session that moves mid-scan is re-bound by a later sweep from its new transcript, and the write does not leave a stray sidecar.
- Not validated / out of scope: the change covers the REST prompt route used by Web Shell. The TUI and other ACP clients still rely on the on-demand sweep. No browser-level Web Shell E2E was run.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/x6/docs/design/2026-10-22-review-prompt-pr-binding.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/x6/docs/design/2026-10-22-review-prompt-pr-binding.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

## Review fixes (Round 3)

The automated review at `8a0a6cae66` raised one Critical and 15 Suggestions. This round fixes the Critical, the security/correctness issues, and the test gaps; three design/perf Suggestions are deferred with follow-ups.

### Fixed

- **Critical: quadratic regex on the prompt path.** The grammar now refuses to scan any prompt longer than 16 KiB before `REVIEW_COMMAND_PATTERN`; the cap covers the live hook and the sweep. Test: `does not scan an oversized review prompt` (200 KB, elapsed < 1 s). Mutation (cap removed): `AssertionError: expected 2181 to be less than 1000`; `EXIT:1`; `Tests 1 failed, 116 skipped`.
- **Channel-relayed prompts.** The hook keys on the raw channel marker and skips channel-relayed turns. Test: `does not bind a channel-relayed /review prompt`.
- **Dead store.** `commitTranscriptPath` removed; the non-live guard reads the pre-lane `transcriptPath`.
- **Required bridge member.** The liveness probe calls `runtime.bridge.getSessionSummary` directly inside the `try`; the optional cast and fail-open branch are gone.
- **Diagnostics.** The wrapper returns the backfill result; the route logs rejected binds and zero-write runs with `writeErrors`/`unresolved`; generation/draining errors stay quiet.
- **Live transcript read.** `liveCandidate` is computed before the read; the live path skips `fs.readFile`.
- **Comment placement.** The transcript-record rationale sits above `collectReviewedPrNumbers`; the command-position rationale stays with `parseReviewCommand`.
- **Coverage:** repeat review at the cap (list/createdAt/catalog unchanged; mutation of `!numbers.includes` gives `alreadyBound: 2`, `overLimit: 1`, `written: 1`; `EXIT:1`; `Tests 1 failed, 116 skipped`), conflict fail-closed, trusted-wrapper target-only and non-review, route binder rejection/hang, coordinator hand-off assertion.

### Deferred (follow-ups)

- **Queued prompt that never dispatches (R1-16):** binding is defined at the 202 admission point; a dispatch-time hook needs a queue-admission signal the REST route does not have.
- **Per-prompt platform query / coalescing (R1-17):** the per-`/review` query is disclosed and user-initiated; workspace-level coalescing and an already-bound short-circuit need the fork-parent page-key handling.
- **Lane contention retry (R1-24):** declining while an exclusive archive/delete holds the lane is correct; a bounded retry after release is a follow-up. The new diagnostic logs the miss.

### Evidence (measured at `8c02cd8611`)

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Backfill suite | 117 passed; `EXIT:0` |
| Prompt-route suite | 46 passed, 1345 skipped; `EXIT:0` |
| Full server suite (`--retry=2`) | 1391 passed; `EXIT:0` |
| Typecheck (8 GB heap), ESLint, Prettier | pass |
| Critical mutation (cap removed) | `expected 2181 to be less than 1000`; `EXIT:1`; `1 failed, 116 skipped` |
| R1-9 mutation (`!numbers.includes` removed) | `alreadyBound: 2`, `overLimit: 1`, `written: 1`; `EXIT:1`; `1 failed, 116 skipped` |

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 会话执行 `/review <PR 号或 URL>` 时，daemon 会在接纳该提示词的瞬间把这个 PR 绑定到会话。侧栏在正常的 catalog 刷新后显示 PR 徽标，会话搜索也能匹配 PR 号。绑定复用现有的会话 PR 管线——同一套命令语法、仓库校验、URL 解析、来源等级、sidecar 写入与上限裁剪——只在前面增加一个实时入口。两轮评审收紧了该入口：满额时新 review 现在会加入上限计划并替换最旧的 review；提交时会在 archive lane 内重新检查会话位置与存活状态，因此不会复活已删除会话的 sidecar，也不会把已归档会话的绑定留在 active 目录。

## 为什么需要

侧栏已经能显示会话对应的 PR，但只能通过按需回填已存 transcript 得到。正常的 Web Shell 流程从未触发这个回填，而新会话可能在 transcript 文件存在之前就完成绑定。结果是：连续跑多轮 `/review` 的用户无法判断哪个会话审的是哪个 PR。在接纳时绑定同时补上这两个缺口，且不引入第二套解析器或第二个写入方。评审修复补上了实时入口引入的两个失效模式：满额会话无法替换旧 review；在快照与 lane 之间完成的归档/删除会把元数据写进错误目录。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在 trusted workspace 的 Web Shell 会话里执行 `/review <PR 号>`，等正常的会话 catalog 刷新。预期：会话行出现 `#<PR 号>`，按该号搜索能找到会话。另起一个会话，执行普通提示词和 `/review <文件路径>`。预期：两者都不出现 PR 徽标。

直接验证两条评审修复，在 `packages/cli` 下跑三条回归用例：

- `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts -t "evicts the oldest review when a live /review reaches the cap"`——预置 10 条 `source: 'review'` 绑定后执行 `/review 11`，结果必须是 `[2..11]`，不能停在 `[1..10]`。
- `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts -t "writes a live bind into the archived sidecar"`——在快照读取与 lane 之间完成归档，#77 必须写进 archived sidecar，active sidecar 保持不存在。
- `npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-pr-backfill.test.ts -t "does not resurrect a deleted live session sidecar"`——同一窗口内删除会话，两个状态的 sidecar 都必须不存在。

### 证据与变异表

下表每一行都先对修复后的代码施加临时变异、运行、再恢复。变异列是真实的断言消息与退出码；修复列是恢复后的同一用例结果。所有行均在 commit `8a0a6cae66d23614699bcd6521069afb9ba8dbb6` 上测得。

| 检查 | 用例 | 施加的变异 | 变异结果（实测） | 修复结果（实测） | Commit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 满额淘汰 | `evicts the oldest review when a live /review reaches the cap` | 置 `liveReviewOccupants = []` | `AssertionError: expected { …(9) } to match object { bound: 1, overLimit: 1 }`，实际 `bound: 0`；`EXIT:1`；`Tests 1 failed, 109 skipped` | `bound: 1`，sidecar `[2..11]`；`EXIT:0`；`Tests 1 passed, 109 skipped` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| 归档竞争 | `writes a live bind into the archived sidecar when the session is archived before the lane` | 重定位后强制回退到 pre-lane 路径 | `AssertionError: expected null to match object [ { number: 77 } ]`；`EXIT:1`；`Tests 1 failed, 109 skipped` | archived sidecar `[77]`，active `null`；`EXIT:0`；`Tests 1 passed, 109 skipped` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| 删除竞争 | `does not resurrect a deleted live session sidecar` | 放行 bridge 存活检查 | `AssertionError: expected { …(9) } to match object { bound: +0, written: +0 }`，实际 `bound: 1, written: 1`；`EXIT:1`；`Tests 1 failed, 109 skipped` | `bound: 0, written: 0`；`EXIT:0`；`Tests 1 passed, 109 skipped` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| 基线 | 全量回填 suite | 无 | — | `Tests 110 passed (110)`；`EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| 提示路由 | `server.test.ts -t "POST /session/:id/prompt"` | 无 | — | `Tests 43 passed, 1345 skipped`；`EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| 完整 server suite | `server.test.ts --retry=2` | 无 | — | `Tests 1388 passed (1388)`；`EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| 构建 | `npm run build` | 无 | — | `EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |
| 类型检查 | `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npm run typecheck` | 无 | — | `EXIT:0` | `8a0a6cae66` |

本环境下完整 server suite 需要 `--retry=2`。部分运行会出现一两条无关用例的瞬时失败，隔离复跑均通过。该现象早于本次评审修复，已记录为环境型 flake。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境说明

仅运行单元测试。checkout 内先执行了 `npm run build`；`packages/cli` 的 typecheck、ESLint、Prettier 均通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：每个 `/review` 提示词现在会在后台发起一次 PR 解析查询（GitHub 走 `gh pr list`，Aone 走 `mr view`）。该工作幂等且 best-effort，绑定失败不影响该轮对话。`gh` 不可用时，GitHub 号回退到 workspace remote URL，与回填使用同一兜底；因此 fork checkout 可能得到非规范的链接。
- 上限行为：满额时 live 绑定可以淘汰较旧的 `source: 'review'` 绑定。`create`、`worktree` 与无 provenance 条目保留槽位。回填的 cap 计划不变。
- 生命周期行为：live 绑定在 archive lane 内重新解析会话位置。已归档会话写 archived sidecar；已删除会话跳过；位置无法确定时 fail closed。只有 bridge 仍持有会话（新会话）时才允许 transcript 缺失。回填保持 pre-lane 路径：扫描中移动的会话由后续回填从新 transcript 重绑，不会留下 stray sidecar。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本次覆盖 Web Shell 使用的 REST 提示路由。TUI 与其它 ACP 客户端仍依赖按需回填。未运行浏览器级 Web Shell E2E。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。
- 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/x6/docs/design/2026-10-22-review-prompt-pr-binding.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/x6/docs/design/2026-10-22-review-prompt-pr-binding.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

无。


## 评审修复（第 3 轮）

`8a0a6cae66` 的自动评审提出 1 个 Critical 与 15 条 Suggestion。本轮修复 Critical、安全/正确性问题与测试缺口；3 条设计/性能建议明确降级为后续项。

### 已修复

- **Critical：提示词路径上的二次方正则。** 语法在进入 `REVIEW_COMMAND_PATTERN` 前拒绝扫描超过 16 KiB 的提示词；上限同时覆盖 live 钩子与回填扫描。用例：`does not scan an oversized review prompt`（200 KB，耗时 < 1s）。变异（去掉上限）：`AssertionError: expected 2181 to be less than 1000`；`EXIT:1`；`Tests 1 failed, 116 skipped`。
- **渠道转发的提示词。** 钩子基于原始渠道标记跳过渠道轮次。用例：`does not bind a channel-relayed /review prompt`。
- **死存储。** 删除 `commitTranscriptPath`；非 live 守卫读取 lane 前的 `transcriptPath`。
- **必需的 bridge 成员。** 存活探测在 `try` 内直接调用 `runtime.bridge.getSessionSummary`；去掉可选 cast 与 fail-open 分支。
- **诊断。** wrapper 返回回填结果；路由记录被拒绝的绑定与 `writeErrors`/`unresolved` 非零的零写入运行；generation/draining 错误保持安静。
- **live transcript 读取。** `liveCandidate` 在读取前计算；live 路径跳过 `fs.readFile`。
- **注释归位。** transcript 记录筛选说明移到 `collectReviewedPrNumbers` 上方；命令位置说明留在 `parseReviewCommand`。
- **覆盖：** 满额重复审查（列表/createdAt/catalog 不变；删除 `!numbers.includes` 的变异得到 `alreadyBound: 2`、`overLimit: 1`、`written: 1`；`EXIT:1`；`Tests 1 failed, 116 skipped`）、conflict fail-closed、trusted wrapper 仅目标会话/非 review、路由 binder 拒绝/挂起、coordinator 交接断言。

### 降级为后续项

- **排队但从未派发的提示词（R1-16）：** 绑定定义在 202 受理点；改为派发时钩子需要 REST 路由没有的队列接纳信号。
- **每提示词的平台查询/合流（R1-17）：** 每个 `/review` 一次的查询已披露且由用户触发；workspace 级合流与已绑定短路需要处理 fork 父仓库的 page key。
- **lane 竞争重试（R1-24）：** 独占归档/删除持锁时拒绝写入是正确的；释放后做有界重试是后续项。新的诊断日志会记录这次未命中。

### 证据（在 `8c02cd8611` 测得）

| 回填 suite | 117 passed；`EXIT:0` |
| 提示路由 suite | 46 passed, 1345 skipped；`EXIT:0` |

prs.title: fix(hosted): preserve primary MySQL isolation failures
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves the original truncation error when Hosted MySQL test isolation also fails to restore foreign-key checks. The restoration error is retained as a suppressed exception; a restoration failure on its own still fails setup. Cleanup continues to use the same connection and closes its JDBC resources normally.

Adds deterministic regression coverage for double failure, truncation-only failure, restoration-only failure, and successful cleanup, including exception identity, managed-table-only truncation, and resource-close ordering.

## Why it's needed

When both operations fail, the previous cleanup path replaces the first SQL error with the secondary restoration error. This loses the failure that started the problem and makes Hosted CI failures harder to diagnose. This addresses only item 3 of the follow-up issue and changes test infrastructure only.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Inject a truncation failure and a restoration failure through the actual isolation setup entry point. Setup must fail with the original truncation exception and expose the restoration exception as suppressed.
- Fail each operation separately and run the successful path. A restoration-only error must still propagate; all paths must attempt restoration after truncation and close the enumeration result, both statements, and the same connection.
- Run the existing isolation regression against an exclusively owned disposable MySQL database. Managed rows should be cleared, unrelated tables and migration history should remain intact, and the next Spring context should start successfully.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: the new focused regression ran 10 tests with exactly one expected failure: the double-failure path returned the restoration exception instead of the original truncation exception.
- After: all 11 focused exception and activation tests passed with no failures, errors, or skips on JDK 21.
- The existing Hosted isolation regression passed 1/1 against a dedicated disposable MySQL 8.4 container, with no skips. Both Checkstyle gates and SpotBugs passed.
- An independent JDK 21 probe verified all 16 combinations of truncation, restoration, statement-close, and connection-close failures, including primary/suppressed exception identity and close order. These injected failures are separate from the real-MySQL isolation regression.
- Complete module verification with the MySQL profile passed: the unit/H2 suite reported 5,320 tests, zero failures/errors, and 125 conditional skips; the selected real-MySQL schema regressions passed 2/2 without skips. The skips include 107 tests requiring Git >=2.40 (this machine has Apple Git 2.39.5), plus optional environment/profile/platform checks. Both Checkstyle gates and SpotBugs passed. The repository build also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | JDK 21 tests, static gates, and real MySQL in a disposable Docker container |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Full Linux/cgroup Hosted fault acceptance not run locally |

### Environment (optional)

Temurin JDK 21.0.13+9, Maven 3.10.0, Node 24.7.0, Apple Git 2.39.5, and a dedicated MySQL 8.4.11 container. No model API calls were needed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: setup failures now preserve the original error and expose cleanup failures as suppressed exceptions. Setup still fails before Spring/recovery starts.
- Not validated / out of scope: full Linux/cgroup Hosted fault acceptance, the complete MySQL integration matrix, and the other follow-ups in the linked issue. SQL double failures are injected in deterministic tests, not induced in a live database.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; production code, SQL statements, activation guards, and schema validation are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14948 (item 3 only).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

当 Hosted MySQL 测试隔离的表截断与外键检查恢复同时失败时，保留原始截断异常，将恢复异常保留为 suppressed exception；仅恢复失败时仍使初始化失败。清理继续使用同一连接，并正常关闭 JDBC 资源。

新增确定性回归测试，覆盖双失败、仅截断失败、仅恢复失败和成功四种情况，同时断言异常对象身份、只截断管理表及资源关闭顺序。

## 为什么需要

此前两步同时失败时，清理流程会用后发生的恢复异常覆盖最初的 SQL 异常，丢失最先触发问题的原因，增加 Hosted CI 故障定位成本。本次仅处理关联 issue 的第 3 项，改动仅涉及测试基础设施。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 通过实际隔离初始化入口注入截断失败和恢复失败。初始化应抛出原始截断异常，且恢复异常应出现在 suppressed 列表中。
- 分别使两步单独失败，再运行成功路径。仅恢复失败时异常仍应向外抛出；所有路径在截断后都应尝试恢复，并关闭表枚举结果、两个 statement 和同一 connection。
- 在本次运行独占的一次性 MySQL 数据库上执行既有隔离回归。管理表数据应清空，非管理表与迁移历史应保留，后续 Spring context 应正常启动。

### 修复前后证据

- 修复前：新增定向回归运行 10 项测试，仅双失败用例按预期失败，实际返回恢复异常而非原始截断异常。
- 修复后：JDK 21 下异常与激活测试全部 11 项通过，无失败、错误或跳过。
- 既有 Hosted 隔离回归在专用一次性 MySQL 8.4 容器上 1/1 通过，无跳过。两套 Checkstyle 门禁及 SpotBugs 通过。
- 独立 JDK 21 探针验证了截断、恢复、statement 关闭与 connection 关闭失败的全部 16 种组合，包含主异常与 suppressed 异常对象身份及关闭顺序。这些故障注入验证与真实 MySQL 隔离回归分别记录。
- 启用 MySQL profile 的完整模块验收通过：单元/H2 套件报告 5,320 项测试，零失败、零错误，125 项条件跳过；选定的真实 MySQL schema 回归 2/2 通过，无跳过。其中 107 项因要求 Git >=2.40 而跳过（本机为 Apple Git 2.39.5），其余为可选环境、profile 或平台检查。两套 Checkstyle 门禁及 SpotBugs 通过，仓库构建也已通过。

### 验证平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | JDK 21 测试、静态门禁，以及一次性 Docker 容器中的真实 MySQL |
| Windows | 未在本地验证 |
| Linux | 未在本地运行完整 Linux/cgroup Hosted 故障验收 |

### 环境

Temurin JDK 21.0.13+9、Maven 3.10.0、Node 24.7.0、Apple Git 2.39.5，以及专用 MySQL 8.4.11 容器。无需模型 API 调用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：初始化失败现在保留原始异常，并通过 suppressed exceptions 暴露清理异常。初始化仍会在 Spring/recovery 启动前失败。
- 未验证或范围之外：完整 Linux/cgroup Hosted 故障验收、完整 MySQL 集成矩阵，以及关联 issue 的其他后续项。SQL 双失败由确定性测试注入，没有在真实数据库中制造双重故障。
- 不兼容变更或迁移说明：无；生产代码、SQL 语句、激活保护和 schema 校验均未改变。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14948（仅第 3 项）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): bind session PRs when gh is outside PATH
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Session PR badges, the Pull requests panel, and the daemon's PR snapshots all ask `gh` about a branch from the Qwen process itself. On macOS that process is frequently a daemon started by launchd or a desktop launcher, which inherits a PATH without the package-manager bin directory, so a bare `gh` lookup fails with ENOENT even though the user's own shell runs it fine. This change falls back to a known `gh` install when PATH cannot resolve one, resolves relative and empty PATH entries against the directory the child actually runs in, carries the resolved fallback binary on failed results so the route can redact that exact value (a HOME with spaces included), logs the raw failure server-side, sweeps glued absolute-path shapes out of the wire body before truncation, and names every binding decline in the debug log.

## Why it's needed

A real session created its PR successfully through an absolute `gh` path, yet its sidebar entry kept no PR badge. The attribution gate re-checks the branch through a bare `gh`, got ENOENT, treated the pre-state as unproven, and returned without writing the binding. Backfill cannot recover that case by design — it only recognises `/review <N>` and `--worktree=#N` conventions — so the session stays unbound permanently. Round one raised four findings (relative-PATH bypass, absolute-path leak into the 502 body, a log that paraphrased one cause, mutation-blind tests). Round two raised one Critical and nine suggestions: a half-redacted space-bearing HOME path and glued shapes still leaked; the drive-letter/UNC arms and the create-route sweep were untested; the sweep deleted the only copy of the failure text; the new comment misattributed merged/closed PRs; six of eight binding exits stayed silent; the `status:'pr'` payload and pre-run log were unpinned; fallback precedence, the empty-HOME guard, the create site's forwarding, and the fallback choice had no test or log.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm five behaviours. First, a machine that resolves `gh` on PATH behaves exactly as before, including the "gh unavailable" result when no install exists. Second, a process whose PATH cannot resolve `gh` but has a known install resolves the branch's PR, and a relative or empty PATH entry is honoured when the child's directory differs from the daemon's. Third, a spawn failure whose message carries the resolved fallback binary — including a HOME containing spaces — reaches the client as `spawn <path> EACCES`, as do paths glued after `=`, a backtick, a drive letter, or a UNC share, while `https://` URLs and the `<workspace>` label survive. Fourth, the raw failure text appears in the server-side debug log, never in the body. Fifth, each declined binding logs its own cause (`none`/`error`/merged state, pre-run snapshot, same PR, repo mismatch, branch mismatch, missing URL, already bound, thrown error), and a fallback binary is named when one is chosen.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Measured at 499ab5816a with the daemon's own PATH (`/Users/wenshao/.local/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`), against the checkout whose branch owns PR #15085.

Before — the gate's bare lookup:
```
bare gh under daemon PATH -> ENOENT
```

After — the same branch resolves again:
```
binary -> /opt/homebrew/bin/gh
branch PR -> {"status":"pr","number":15085,"url":"https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15085","state":"open","headRefName":"feat/15075-capability-parity"}
repo keys -> {"resolved":"github.com/qwenlm/qwen-code"}
relative PATH vs spawn cwd -> gh
relative PATH vs process cwd -> /opt/homebrew/bin/gh
```

Each fix was mutation-checked at 499ab5816a in isolation, with the tree restored from a snapshot whose hashes matched before and after.

| Mutation | Observed |
| --- | --- |
| M1. drop the route's exact binary redaction | 1 failed / 24 skipped (25), exit 1 — `expected 'spawn <path> Smith/.local/bin/gh EACC…' to be 'spawn <path> EACCES'` |
| M2. revert the sweep to the old leading boundary | 1 failed / 24 skipped (25), exit 1 — `expected 'open=/Users/alice/.config/gh/hosts.ym…' not to contain '/Users/alice'` |
| M3. delete the drive-letter/UNC alternatives | 1 failed / 24 skipped (25), exit 1 — `expected 'could not open C:\Users\alice\hosts.y…' not to contain 'alice'` |
| M4. remove the list-route raw log | 2 failed / 23 passed (25), exit 1 — `expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ 'GitHub PR list failed', { …(3) } ]` |
| M5. remove the create-route sweep wrapper | same run — `expected 'spawn /Users/alice/.local/bin/gh EACC…' to be 'spawn <path> EACCES'` |
| M6. R1-5 comment reword | comment-only, no behaviour to flip |
| M7. remove the pre-run decline log | 3 failed (374) — `expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ Array(1) ]` |
| M8. remove the post-run `state` spread | same run — `expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ …(2) ]` (merged-PR case) |
| M9. remove the branch-mismatch log | same run — `expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ …(2) ]` (switched-branch case) |
| M10. invert the fallback candidate order | 3 failed / 2 passed (5), exit 1 — `expected '/usr/local/bin/gh' to be '/Users/alice/.local/bin/gh'` |
| M11. weaken the absolute-HOME guard | same run — `expected '.local/bin/gh' to be 'gh'` |
| M12. remove the fallback-choice log | same run — `expected "spy" to be called with arguments: [ …(2) ]` |
| M13. drop the resolver's spawn directory at one site | `tsc --noEmit` exit 2 — `src/utils/github-prs.ts(323,7): error TS2554: Expected 2 arguments, but got 1.` |

Green at 499ab5816a: `github-prs`, `github-pr-issues`, `github-prs.gh-binary`, and `shell` — 462 passed; `workspace-github-prs` — 25 passed; typecheck, ESLint, and Prettier pass.

prs.title: fix(ci): run the sdk-java suite before taking the host lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The self-hosted SDK Java test job no longer holds the per-host Maven lock while it runs the SDK and Managed Agent suites. It seeds a job-local Maven repository from the host cache, runs every Maven command from that job-local copy without the lock, and takes the ticketed host lock only for the cache write-back. The write-back is the only remaining host-shared mutation; it is bounded at 300 seconds, and its children close the lock fd so a cancelled job's survivor cannot retain the lock.

The workflow pins, the fair-lock design document in English and Chinese, and the recorded workflow size move with the mechanism.

## Why it's needed

Run 39755183699's full-tier Java 11 leg waited its entire 5,400-second lock budget as queue ticket 249 and failed before running a test: "sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes". The queue was working — the ticket was promoted to the fast class after 20 minutes — but the hold in front of it outlasted the budget. The MariaDB lane was already scoped to its cache write-back by #15128; the test job was the remaining site that held the host lock across a long Maven suite, so one suite could serialize every other Java lane on the same host. Moving the suite to a job-local repository removes that last long hold and makes the 90-minute wait far larger than any hold it protects.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`. Confirm the workflow meta-tests pass, including the assertion that every Maven command in the test job runs before the lock acquisition and that the suite leaves the host lock free. Inspect the `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` step: the seed, the suite, and the `sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400 "${TIER}"` call should appear in that order, and the write-back should close fd 9. A full CI run on Linux then exercises the real Java lanes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (CI workflow change, not user-visible). Before: the Java 11 leg timed out with the lock annotation after exactly 90 minutes. After: the static and runtime meta-tests show the suite runs before the lock and the lock is free when the suite finishes.

### Tested on

|     OS     |          Status           |
| :--------: | :-----------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |       ⚠️ not tested       |
| 🪟 Windows |       ⚠️ not tested       |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (meta-tests, build, typecheck, lint) |

### Environment (optional)

Local checkout with Node 22; no JDK or Maven in this environment, so the Java suite itself is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Maven suites on the same host can now run concurrently instead of serializing. They resolve from separate job-local repositories seeded with read-only hardlinks, and the only host-shared mutation (the cache write-back) still takes the lock; this is the same model #15128 established for the MariaDB lane.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Java and Maven lanes were not executed locally because this environment has no JDK or Maven. The full Linux Java lanes in CI are the final verification. The 90-minute budget and the job ceilings are unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The release-tag fallback to the bare lock is preserved.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15264

Design docs: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

自托管的 SDK Java test job 不再在运行 SDK 和 Managed Agent 套件期间持有每台宿主机上的 Maven 锁。它从宿主机缓存播种一个 job 本地 Maven 仓库，从该 job 本地副本运行所有 Maven 命令且不持有锁，只在缓存写回时获取票据化的宿主机锁。写回是最后一个宿主机共享的变更；它被限制在 300 秒内，并且其子进程会关闭锁 fd，因此被取消 job 的残留进程无法继续持有锁。

工作流的 pin、英文和中文的公平锁设计文档，以及记录的工作流大小都随机制一起更新。

## 为什么需要

运行 39755183699 的 full 档 Java 11 通道以队列 ticket 249 的身份等满了 5,400 秒锁预算，在运行任何测试之前就失败了："sdk-java host lock not acquired within 90 minutes"。队列本身工作正常——该 ticket 在 20 分钟后被提升到 fast 类——但排在它前面的持锁时间超过了预算。MariaDB 通道已由 #15128 限定为只在缓存写回时取锁；test job 是最后一个仍在长时间 Maven 套件期间持有宿主机锁的站点，因此一个套件就能把同一宿主机上的其他 Java 通道串行化。把套件移到 job 本地仓库消除了最后一个长持锁，使 90 分钟的等待远大于它所保护的任何一次持锁。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

运行 `npx vitest run scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`。确认工作流元测试通过，包括：test job 中的每个 Maven 命令都在取锁之前运行，并且套件结束时宿主机锁是空闲的。检查 `Run Java SDK tests (self-hosted)` 步骤：播种、套件、`sdk_java_lock_acquire 5400 "${TIER}"` 调用应按此顺序出现，写回应关闭 fd 9。随后在 Linux 上运行完整的 CI 即可验证真实 Java 通道。

### 证据（修改前与修改后）

不适用（CI 工作流改动，非用户可见）。修改前：Java 11 通道在整整 90 分钟后带着锁注解超时。修改后：静态和运行时元测试表明套件在取锁之前运行，且套件结束时锁是空闲的。

### 测试平台

|    操作系统    |             状态              |
| :------------: | :---------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |          ⚠️ 未测试           |
| 🪟 Windows |          ⚠️ 未测试           |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试（元测试、构建、类型检查、lint） |

### 环境（可选）

本地 checkout，Node 22；此环境没有 JDK 或 Maven，因此 Java 套件本身留给 CI 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：同一宿主机上的 Maven 套件现在可以并发运行，而不是串行化。它们从各自独立的 job 本地仓库解析，这些仓库用只读硬链接播种；唯一的宿主机共享变更（缓存写回）仍然取锁；这与 #15128 为 MariaDB 通道建立的模型相同。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：本地未执行 Java 和 Maven 通道，因为此环境没有 JDK 或 Maven。CI 中完整的 Linux Java 通道是最终验证。90 分钟预算和 job 上限保持不变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。release tag 回退到裸锁的路径保留。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15264

prs.title: fix(core): stop a failed queued memory extract escaping as an unhandled rejection
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`MemoryManager.runExtract` starts the trailing queued extraction from its `finally` block with `void this.startQueuedExtract(params.projectRoot)`. `startQueuedExtract` awaits the queued run through `this.track(...)`, so when that run rejects, the returned promise rejects with no handler attached anywhere.

By the time that rejection is produced, `runExtract` has already:

- marked the task `failed` with the error message, and
- emitted the `MemoryExtractEvent` with `status: 'failed'`.

So nothing consumes the rejection — it just escapes as an unhandled rejection. This PR attaches a sink that logs it at debug level, which keeps the queued failure observable without turning it into a process-level error.

## Why it's needed

An unhandled rejection inside a vitest worker fails the whole lane even when every test passes:

```
⎯⎯⎯⎯ Unhandled Rejection ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
Error: atomicWriteFile("…/project/.qwen/extract-cursor.json"): ENOENT … chmod '…/extract-cursor.json.…tmp'
 ❯ writeExtractCursor src/memory/extract.ts:91
 ❯ runAutoMemoryExtract src/memory/extract.ts:250
 ❯ MemoryManager.runExtract src/memory/manager.ts:1284
This error originated in "src/memory/memoryLifecycle.integration.test.ts" test file.
```

That is the `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` failure on #15159 (head `698b7991bd`): `Tests 38330 passed`, `Errors 1 error`, exit code 1, on a PR that only touched `scripts/`, `ci.yml` and docs. The host load average was 41.

The sequence is entirely mechanical:

1. The test schedules one extraction and queues a trailing one, then calls `mgr.drain({ timeoutMs: 1_000 })` and expects `true`.
2. On a loaded runner the drain times out while the trailing extraction is still running, so the attempt fails and vitest retries it (`--retry=2`). The retry passes.
3. `afterEach` deletes the temp directory while the first attempt's trailing extraction is still writing. That write fails with `ENOENT`.
4. The trailing extraction was started by the `void` in `runExtract`'s `finally`, so its rejection has no sink.

The failure mode is therefore random and environment-dependent: it needs a slow runner, and it reports an unrelated PR as red while the code under test is fine.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/memory/manager.test.ts -t 'does not leak an unhandled rejection'`.

The added case queues a trailing extract behind an in-flight one, resolves the first, makes the trailing one reject, and asserts that the rejection never appears on `process.on('unhandledRejection')` — while also asserting that the trailing extract really ran (`runAutoMemoryExtract` called twice), so the case cannot pass by simply never starting it.

**Red/green:** drop the `.catch(...)` from the `finally` and the new case fails — the probe rejection is delivered to the handler. Restore it and the case passes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the queued run's rejection reaches `process.on('unhandledRejection')`; vitest reports `Errors 1 error` and the lane exits 1 despite a green test list.

After: the rejection is consumed; the failure stays on the task record (`status: 'failed'`, error message) and in the extract event log, where it already was.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ covered by CI |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ covered by CI |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ covered by CI |

`tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` and `prettier --check` pass locally on both files.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit test only, no external services.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a queued extraction that fails is now silent at the default log level (a `debugLogger.warn`, same channel as the surrounding memory-pressure messages). The failure was already recorded on the task and in the extract event, so no diagnostic information is lost; only the process-level crash report goes away.
- Not validated / out of scope: the drain timeout itself. A queued extract that outlives `drain()` still runs to completion (or failure) after the caller returns — that is the existing contract of `drain` (`Promise.race` with a timeout), and changing it would alter shutdown semantics. This PR only stops the resulting rejection from escaping.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15269

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

`MemoryManager.runExtract` 在 `finally` 里用 `void this.startQueuedExtract(params.projectRoot)` 启动排队中的尾部抽取，而 `startQueuedExtract` 内部会 `await` 这次抽取（经由 `this.track(...)`）。因此排队抽取失败时，这个 promise 会 reject，但没有任何地方挂处理器。

在 rejection 产生之前，`runExtract` 已经把任务标成 `failed` 并写入了错误信息，也已经发出了 `status: 'failed'` 的 `MemoryExtractEvent`。也就是说这个 rejection 不携带任何调用方还能处理的信息，只会变成未处理的 rejection。

本 PR 给它挂一个 sink，在 debug 级别记录，让排队失败仍然可见，但不再表现为进程级错误。

## 为什么需要

vitest worker 里的未处理 rejection 会让整条车道失败，哪怕所有用例都是绿的。#15159 在 `Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)` 上就是这样红的：`Tests 38330 passed`、`Errors 1 error`、退出码 1，而那个 PR 只改了 `scripts/`、`ci.yml` 和文档。

触发链条完全机械：drain 在负载 41 的 runner 上超时 → 该次尝试失败并被 vitest 重试（重试通过）→ `afterEach` 在尾部抽取仍在写盘时删除临时目录 → 写入报 `ENOENT` → 这个 rejection 来自 `finally` 里那个 `void`，最终无人接管。

## 如何验证

`packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/memory/manager.test.ts -t 'does not leak an unhandled rejection'`。

新增用例先排队一次尾部抽取、让第一次成功、让尾部这次失败，然后断言该 rejection 没有出现在 `process.on('unhandledRejection')` 上；同时断言尾部抽取确实执行过（`runAutoMemoryExtract` 被调用两次），避免"根本没启动"也能通过。

**红绿验证**：把 `finally` 里的 `.catch(...)` 去掉，新用例会红；加回来则绿。

## 风险与范围

- 主要代价：排队抽取失败在默认日志级别下不再抛出（走 `debugLogger.warn`，与周围内存压力日志同一通道）。任务记录和抽取事件里仍保留失败状态，诊断信息没有丢失。
- 不在本 PR 范围：drain 超时本身。尾部抽取超出 `drain()` 时限仍会跑完（或跑失败），这是 `drain` 既有契约（带超时的 `Promise.race`），改动它会改变关闭语义。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): reject malformed hosted shell Unicode before admission
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reject unpaired UTF-16 surrogates in Hosted Shell `command` and `description` before a fresh model-generated batch reaches permissions, argument-bearing hooks, or Workspace execution admission. Persist an ordered error for every tool call in the refused batch, including valid siblings that were not executed, so the model can correct its request and continue.

Apply the same validation to permission and PreToolUse rewrites. Sequential hooks stop at the first malformed effective input, including during cold recovery; a later hook cannot repair an input that should already have been rejected. Once the refusal is durably established, live completion and cold resume skip post-tool callbacks for that refusal. If a hook has already acquired an owner, retain it until normal settlement; uncertain persistence stays recovery-blocked.

Forward valid Unicode unchanged, including Chinese text, emoji, combining characters, control characters, and the literal six-character sequence `\ud800`. Cover local capture and O2 publication with a deterministic real-process E2E that checks durable history, correction within the same prompt turn, and a second Session on the same Workspace.

This branch also delivers the documents that the Chinese design and this description link: the English design at `docs/design/managed-agents/2026-10-08-hosted-shell-unicode-admission.md` and the guide at `HOSTED_SHELL_UNICODE_E2E.md`. Both links used to resolve to nothing.

## Why it's needed

Malformed Unicode could reach Hosted Shell execution admission and leave a prompt unable to complete. The local baseline reached acquire/prepare/start and remained active after 30 seconds. The report linked from #13010 describes a longer Workspace busy failure on both capture paths. An actionable, durable refusal lets the model correct malformed arguments without executing sibling tools or occupying a fresh Workspace execution slot.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Use Node.js 22+, JDK 21, and Maven 3.8.9+. Run every command from the repository root. These commands were executed on the current head; the commands previously listed here did not run.

Build the CLI and install the one Java module the server depends on:

```bash
npm run build
npm run bundle
mvn -q -f packages/sdk-java/qwencode/pom.xml -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true install
```

Compile the server tests, then run the single gateway test:

```bash
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -DskipTests test-compile
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml \
  -Phosted-workspace-tools \
  -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" \
  -Dqwen.cli.entry="$PWD/dist/cli.js" \
  -Dit.test='HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT#malformedShellUnicodeIsCorrectableBeforeAcquisition' \
  failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify
```

Two traps in the old instructions are real, and neither works today: `packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/pom.xml` no longer exists, and `-Dtest=none` stops the build at surefire with `No tests were executed!` because the module sets `failIfNoTests` to `true`.

1. For both local and O2, confirm that isolated high/low surrogates, emoji followed by an isolated surrogate, and reversed surrogate pairs in either Shell field produce ordered, paired tool errors. The eight standalone malformed batches must make no acquire, publication reservation, prepare, or start request, and neither the malformed command nor its valid Write sibling may create a file. Prior runtime warming is allowed.
2. Confirm that Session detach/load preserves original arguments and paired errors. A corrected command must execute within the same prompt turn, preserve Chinese text, emoji, combining characters, and literal `\ud800`, and leave exactly one execution in the original Session. A second Session on the same Workspace must execute successfully; neither path may become `recoveryBlocked`. Expect two passing Java parameters and Maven `BUILD SUCCESS`.
3. Run the focused unit tests below from `packages/cli`. Confirm that permission and PreToolUse rewrites refuse the whole batch before native execution, a malformed sequential-hook prefix prevents the next hook from being admitted in both live and cold paths, and a durable Unicode refusal does not run post-tool callbacks. Persistence faults must retain any existing owner and block recovery when the outcome is uncertain. Valid Unicode and existing digest behavior must remain compatible.

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run \
  src/serve/hosted-shell-input.test.ts \
  src/serve/hosted-hook-session.test.ts \
  src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts \
  --coverage.enabled=false
cd ../..
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `.qwen/e2e-tests/issue-13010/baseline-real-stack-summary.json` records a local `command` containing U+D800 reaching acquire/prepare/start, with `hasActivePrompt: true` after 30 seconds and only one model request. The early O2 baseline had a missing publication endpoint, so its recovery block does not establish Unicode causality. The historical eight-minute Workspace busy report was not independently reproduced.

After: measured by the maintainer takeover on 2026-10-23 at head `1739acfbea`, on merge commit `3db968f578` that brings in `main` `ce8a94706b` (no conflicts). The earlier saved numbers in this description were taken at `190537d19` and are superseded.

| Gate | Result at `3db968f578` / `1739acfbea` |
|---|---|
| `npm run build` + `npm run bundle` | exit 0 |
| `npm run typecheck` | exit 0 |
| `vitest run` on the three serve files | **614/614 passed** (3 files) |
| `vitest run` relay headers | **4/4 passed** |
| Real-process E2E, `local` + `o2` (H2, Embedded Broker, bundled `dist/cli.js`) | **2/2 passed**, 11.79 s, `BUILD SUCCESS` |

```text
HOSTED_SHELL_UNICODE_OK: local, 9 refusals per capture, durable reload, Unicode correction, second Session
HOSTED_SHELL_UNICODE_OK: o2, 9 refusals per capture, durable reload, Unicode correction, second Session
[INFO] Tests run: 2, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 11.79 s -- in com.alibaba.qwen.code.managedagent.HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS
```

Mutation M1 was re-run at this head because the branch merged `main`. Changing `/[\uD800-\uDFFF]/u` to the never-matching `/$^/u` in `hostedShellInputError` turned the gates red; the tree was then restored and both gates re-run green:

| Arm | Focused suite | Real-process E2E |
|---|---|---|
| Head (unmodified) | 614/614 passed, exit 0 | 2/2 passed, 11.67 s, `BUILD SUCCESS` |
| Head + M1 (scan disabled) | **109 failed / 505 passed**, exit 1 | **2/2 failed**, exit 1; `Runtime Broker returned HTTP 400 (runtime_payload_invalid)`, turn `recoveryBlocked` |

The mutant's failure is the exact class this PR exists to remove. After restore, `git status` is clean, the focused suite is 614/614, and the E2E is 2/2 again.

Logs are local ignored artifacts: `.qwen/e2e-tests/issue-13010/` and `/tmp/pr13678-*.log`. They were not published with this PR.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 22.23.3, JDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.9.9. The E2E uses the bundled CLI, a deterministic OpenAI fixture, real Java Session Store services backed by temporary H2, an Embedded Broker, and a Node worker with a temporary local Workspace. O2 uses the real Java publication controller and SQL grant/data services with an in-memory object-store adapter. No model API key or OSS account is required.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: refusal recognition must remain consistent across live execution and cold resume. It relies on complete, matching persisted assistant/tool/hook records and the absence of native execution intents; incomplete or contradictory history stays recovery-blocked. A malformed batch also refuses valid siblings, and hook-time rejection may retain an already acquired owner until normal settlement.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows, Linux, production MySQL/OSS, and a real-process `hosted-workspace-shell/2` run were not validated; `/2` has unit coverage, while the Java E2E uses `hosted-workspace-shell/1`. Ordinary CLI, Monitor, MCP, other file-tool text, recovery of previously stuck Sessions, and new background execution enablement are outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: malformed Hosted Shell arguments now produce durable tool errors earlier. No schema, protocol, or digest change was identified in the reviewed code; valid Unicode is forwarded unchanged. The [English design](docs/design/managed-agents/2026-10-08-hosted-shell-unicode-admission.md), the [Chinese design](docs/design/managed-agents/2026-10-08-hosted-shell-unicode-admission.zh-CN.md), and the [local E2E guide](HOSTED_SHELL_UNICODE_E2E.md) are part of this PR.

## Linked Issues
Closes #13010

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

在新鲜的模型工具批次进入权限检查、携带参数的 Hook 或 Workspace 执行准入之前，拒绝 Hosted Shell `command` 和 `description` 中的孤立 UTF-16 代理项。为拒绝批次中的每个工具调用按原顺序持久化错误，包括未执行的合法 sibling，让模型能够纠正请求并继续运行。

对权限和 PreToolUse 改写应用同样的校验。顺序 Hook 在首次出现非法有效输入时停止，冷恢复也遵循这一规则；后续 Hook 不能修复一个本应已经被拒绝的输入。拒绝结果确认持久化后，实时完成路径和冷恢复均跳过该拒绝的 post-tool callbacks。如果早期 Hook 已取得 owner，则保留到正常 settlement；持久化结果不确定时保持恢复阻塞。

合法 Unicode 原样传递，包括中文、emoji、组合字符、控制字符以及由六个字符组成的字面序列 `\ud800`。使用确定性的真实进程 E2E 覆盖 local capture 和 O2 publication，检查持久化历史、同一个 prompt turn 内的纠正，以及同 Workspace 的第二个 Session。

本分支同时交付中文设计和本描述所链接的文档：英文设计 `docs/design/managed-agents/2026-10-08-hosted-shell-unicode-admission.md` 与指南 `HOSTED_SHELL_UNICODE_E2E.md`。这两个链接此前都指向不存在的文件。

### How to verify

需要 Node.js 22+、JDK 21、Maven 3.8.9+，并从仓库根目录执行。以下命令在当前 head 上实际执行过；此前列出的命令跑不起来。

```bash
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml -DskipTests test-compile
mvn -f packages/managed-agent-server/pom.xml \
  -Phosted-workspace-tools \
  -Dnode.executable="$(command -v node)" \
  -Dqwen.cli.entry="$PWD/dist/cli.js" \
  -Dit.test='HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT#malformedShellUnicodeIsCorrectableBeforeAcquisition' \
  failsafe:integration-test failsafe:verify
```

旧说明里的两个陷阱都真实存在，且都已不适用：`packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker/pom.xml` 已不存在；`-Dtest=none` 会让 surefire 以 `No tests were executed!` 中止，因为该模块把 `failIfNoTests` 设为 `true`。

1. 在 local 和 O2 中，确认任一 Shell 字段包含孤立高/低代理项、emoji 后接孤立代理项、逆序代理对时，都会得到按原顺序配对的工具错误。8 个独立非法批次不能发出 acquire、publication reservation、prepare 或 start 请求；非法命令和同批合法 Write sibling 均不能创建文件。允许此前发生的 runtime warming。

3. 从 `packages/cli` 运行下列定向单测。确认权限和 PreToolUse 改写在 native execution 之前拒绝整个批次，顺序 Hook 的非法前缀在实时及冷恢复路径中均阻止后继 Hook 准入，持久化的 Unicode 拒绝不会运行 post-tool callbacks。持久化故障必须保留已有 owner，并在结果不确定时阻塞恢复。合法 Unicode 和既有 digest 行为必须保持兼容。

| Gate | 在 `3db968f578` / `1739acfbea` 的结果 |
|---|---|
| `npm run build` + `npm run bundle` | exit 0 |
| `npm run typecheck` | exit 0 |

### Tested on

| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |

auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(cli): reject malformed hosted shell Unicode before admission

Prevent lone UTF-16 surrogates from reaching Workspace acquisition
or execution while preserving valid Unicode and durable history.

- Refuse whole batches before Hooks and native tool admission
- Stop malformed sequential Hook rewrites and restore safe refusals
- Suppress post-tool callbacks for live and replayed Unicode refusals
- Cover local/O2 persistence, same-turn correction, and Session reuse
- Document the admission design and local acceptance evidence

* fix(cli): preserve durable hosted shell Unicode refusals

Keep malformed Shell input refusals bounded and recoverable after
Hook rewrites without losing policy denials or the original store error.

- Normalize optional arguments and validate reduced refusal evidence
- Fold nested permission rewrites and bound assembled Hook receipts
- Read recovery resources concurrently while preserving event order
- Cover MCP and background guards, sibling denials and failed writes
- Stabilize Hook admission waits and verify the second Session alone

* fix(cli): keep hosted Unicode refusals replayable and batch-wide

Keep durable Unicode refusals correctable across terminal Hook
recovery and bounded receipts, without admitting sibling tools.

- Accept proven-unstarted Hooks while rejecting blocked evidence
- Preserve a fixed Unicode reason in byte-bounded Hook refusals
- Retain each sibling's own argument validation error
- Pin MCP admission, Hook handoff and continuation regression cases

* fix(cli): recover cancelled size-refused hook plans

Treat cancelled Hook plans as terminal when their durable evidence
proves a result or no dispatch, so Unicode batch refusals can replay.

- Preserve failure-closed checks for unresolved or contradictory evidence
- Cover bounded permission refusals and independent recovery guard failures
- Assert Java capture lanes and single successful dispatch in both sessions

* test(sdk-java): scope Unicode publication checks per session

Shared publication rows made the local gate depend on invocation order.
A global positive count also hid a missing secondary-session capture.

- Filter publication counts by the current tenant and each session
- Preserve local zero and o2 positive checks for both sessions

* test(sdk-java): verify hosted Unicode capture completion

Make local publication checks run against an available service,
and distinguish completed o2 captures from reservation rows.

- Register publication fixtures for both capture modes
- Require referenced and complete results in each o2 session

* test(sdk-java): align Unicode gate with managed schema

Keep the hosted Unicode oracle runnable after schema consolidation.
Use canonical tables without changing the per-session completion
and single-dispatch assertions.

- Query captures from ma_output_capture
- Query dispatch evidence from ma_tool_execution

* test(managed-agent): align Unicode gate with main contracts

Keep the hosted Unicode gate compatible with the server's updated
Checkstyle rules and object-store contract after the module move.

- Add braces around the missing-object fixture refusal
- Add braces around the local-mode empty-capture assertion
- Align the fixture with the current object-store validation method

* test(managed-agent): register native macOS workspace fixtures

The Hosted tool-turn fixture registered guarded workspaces only on
Linux, leaving corrected Shell calls unavailable on supported macOS
hosts after malformed input had been refused.

- Match fixture registration to the native storage guard platforms
- Exercise the existing physical checks for both supported host systems

Native macOS local/O2 tests and the non-Unicode workspace control pass
with the original assertions, physical guards and execution deadlines.

prs.title: ci(sdk-java): preserve failure reports and SQL causes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Retain Maven plain-text reports when the SDK Java test matrix or the Managed Agent MySQL job fails. The matrix retains Surefire reports; the MySQL job retains both Surefire unit-test reports and Failsafe integration-test reports. Artifacts have distinct names, are retained for seven days, and ignore missing reports.

Preserve the original exception when the channel ownership race test receives an unexpected error. The test still requires the same ownership-conflict exception and message, and now cleans up its binder thread even when an early SQL query fails.

## Why it's needed

#14595 has recurred in both lanes, but the original upload covered only the matrix. A controlled failure confirmed that the existing AssertJ type assertion discards the nested SQL exception before Surefire writes its report. Uploading that report alone cannot recover the cause; the updated assertion preserves it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Both affected lanes should retain available text reports after test failure, using distinct artifact names. Successful jobs should not upload these artifacts, and absent reports should be ignored.

The channel race must still reject an ownership change after the competing bind. An unexpected SQL error must fail the test while retaining its original cause, and the binder thread must exit after that failure.

### Evidence (Before & After)

With the old assertion, a controlled unexpected SQL exception lost its cause in the actual Surefire report. Injecting a real missing-column query into the updated race fixture retains the JUnit → Spring JDBC → H2 exception chain and vendor code 42122 in the text report. SQLState 42S22 is captured in stdout/XML; the binder is terminated. This deliberate failure verifies diagnostics, not reproduction of the CI flake.

### Tested on

macOS, JDK 21: the full affected class passes all 20 tests; both Checkstyle checks and SpotBugs pass. The latest workflow verification passed all nine consumer test files (538 tests passed, 11 skipped) under `LC_ALL=C LANG=C`; yamllint, Prettier, ESLint and diff checks also pass. Java code is unchanged in the Failsafe-path follow-up.

## Risk & Scope

This changes diagnostics and test cleanup, not production SQL or channel ownership rules. The schema-aware JDBC helper was already merged in #15100 and is included through the main sync.

The intermittent CI SQL failure remains unconfirmed locally. This PR does not claim to fix its root cause or close #14595. Actual Actions artifact upload remains unobserved. Reports may contain test diagnostics; uploads stay limited to text with seven-day retention.

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): Remove pre-release compatibility paths
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Managed Agent now uses one first-release contract across Server, Broker, Harness, the Java SDK and WebShell. This removes unused Runtime Provider wrappers, historical tool-result backfills, mixed-version authorization fallbacks, old checkpoint and digest formats, and obsolete frontend provider representations. Turn submission and cancellation always expose their persisted operation; Session pagination uses one cursor format bound to its filters.

The database uses one complete shared V1 baseline. SQL comments, contributor instructions and the bilingual design explicitly require editing V1 in place without adding V2+ migrations or increasing the database schema version until the first formal Managed Agent release. Existing development catalogs must be recreated after baseline changes. The matching-build initialization, ownership, idempotency, writer fencing and unknown-outcome recovery checks remain enforced.

## Why it's needed

Managed Agent has not had a formal release, so historical development formats do not need a supported upgrade path. Removing those branches makes the first supported contract smaller and easier to reason about while preserving the safety checks required by current producers. This also keeps future pre-release schema work from recreating a migration chain.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Confirm that fresh installations initialize successfully in either Server-first or Broker-first order, restart without changing committed data, and reject partial or foreign catalogs. Verify that bound Session creation retains model and initial approval selections, submit/cancel retries return the original durable operation, cancellation stays attached to its original Turn after refresh, and changing archive/title filters invalidates an old cursor. Check that current-format checkpoint recovery and MCP close still require the original writer and cleanup evidence, and that tool cards remain distinct by item identity.

### How to verify

Local validation passed the root build and typecheck, focused Core/CLI/WebShell suites, Java SDK and Server contract/store suites, real MySQL integration checks, and Chromium browser scenarios. Core passed 548 tests, CLI 222, reference-package scripts 19, Java SDK 233, Server H2/API 626, real MySQL 15, WebShell focused 683 plus 33 App tests, and 23 browser scenarios. The final dead-field frontend cleanup additionally passed 145 direct component tests and package build/typecheck. After synchronizing with main, the root build/typecheck passed again, along with 84 focused Java local-startup/model/API/schema tests, 500 frontend integration tests, 23 browser scenarios and Checkstyle. The separate test report comment distinguishes reused evidence from checks repeated on the synchronized revision.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — contract and compatibility refactoring with no intended visual layout change. Browser checks exercise the actual page against mocked control-plane responses; they do not establish a real-model Hosted run.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node 22.22.3, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, JDK 21 and MySQL 8.4.11. Maven used an isolated task repository with the current sibling SDK installed from source. MySQL checks used a disposable isolated instance with a 128 MiB maximum packet size and binary logging disabled.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Matching Managed component builds and fresh current-format state are required. Ownership, writer fencing, receipt verification and unknown-effect recovery remain enforced. The SQL baseline is mutable before the first formal release, so development catalogs are disposable.
- Not validated / out of scope: Full CI/SpotBugs, default-parallel full coverage, real-model Hosted recovery and fault injection, and Linux/Windows execution remain pending. An initial Core run timed out in one existing 15-second scale test; the identical 21-file selection passed with two workers and coverage disabled without changing assertions or timeouts. This supports resource contention but does not isolate parallelism from coverage.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: Earlier development catalogs, checkpoint shapes, noncanonical digests, admission-profile selection, the WebShell creation `environmentId` field, the archive compatibility alias and legacy cursors are unsupported. Use fresh state rather than repairing Flyway history. Keep the database at V1 until the first formal release; the OpenAPI information version remains a separate API-contract identifier. Ordinary daemon execution and current file/Shell/MCP/CSI/lifecycle modes remain supported.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-first-release-cleanup/docs/design/2026-10-23-managed-first-release-contract.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-first-release-cleanup/docs/design/2026-10-23-managed-first-release-contract.zh-CN.md). Both versions contain matching decisions, boundaries and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

N/A

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

Managed Agent 在 Server、Broker、Harness、Java SDK 和 WebShell 之间统一为一套首发契约。删除无调用者的 Runtime Provider 包装、历史工具结果回填、混合版本授权回退、旧 checkpoint 与 digest 格式，以及过时的前端 provider 表示。Turn 提交与取消始终暴露已持久化的 operation；Session 分页使用一种绑定筛选条件的游标格式。

数据库只保留一份完整的共享 V1 基线。SQL 注释、贡献者规范和双语设计明确要求：Managed Agent 首次正式发布前直接修改 V1，不新增 V2+ 迁移，也不递增数据库 schema 版本。基线变化后重建开发数据库。继续强制校验匹配制品的初始化、归属、幂等性、writer fencing 和未知结果恢复证明。

## Why it's needed

Managed Agent 尚未正式发布，历史开发格式无需提供受支持的升级路径。删除这些分支可以减小首个受支持契约的规模，降低理解成本，同时保留现役生产者必需的安全检查。这也避免后续首发前的 schema 开发重新累积迁移链。

## Reviewer Test Plan

确认全新安装能按 Server 先启动或 Broker 先启动的两种顺序完成初始化，重启不会改变已提交数据，并会拒绝部分初始化或外来数据库。验证绑定 Session 创建时保留模型与初始审批选择，提交/取消重试返回原持久化 operation，刷新后取消仍绑定原 Turn，改变归档或标题筛选后旧游标失效。检查当前格式的 checkpoint 恢复与 MCP close 仍要求原 writer 和清理证明，工具卡片按 item 身份保持独立。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — 本次属于契约与兼容逻辑重构，不计划改变视觉布局。浏览器检查运行真实页面并模拟控制面响应，不代表完成真实模型 Hosted 整链路验证。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### Environment (optional)

macOS、Node 22.22.3、仓库固定的 pnpm 11.24.0、JDK 21 和 MySQL 8.4.11。Maven 使用本任务隔离的仓库，并从当前源码安装 sibling SDK。MySQL 检查使用可丢弃的隔离实例，最大包大小为 128 MiB，关闭 binary log。

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: 必须使用相互匹配的 Managed 组件制品及全新的当前格式状态。继续强制执行归属、writer fencing、receipt 验证和未知副作用恢复。首个正式版本前 SQL 基线可以直接修改，因此开发数据库需要可重建。
- Not validated / out of scope: 完整 CI/SpotBugs、默认并发全量 coverage、真实模型 Hosted 恢复与故障注入，以及 Linux/Windows 执行仍待完成。Core 初次运行有一个既有规模测试超过原 15 秒上限；同样 21 个文件限制为两个 worker 并关闭 coverage 后全部通过，没有修改断言或超时。这支持资源争用的解释，但不能单独区分并发与 coverage 的影响。
- Breaking changes / migration notes: 不再支持早期开发数据库、旧 checkpoint 结构、非 canonical digest、admission profile 选择、WebShell 创建的 `environmentId` 字段、归档兼容别名及旧游标。使用全新状态，不修改 Flyway 历史绕过拒绝。首次正式发布前数据库固定 V1；OpenAPI 信息版本仍是独立的 API 契约标识。普通 daemon 执行和现役 file/Shell/MCP/CSI/lifecycle 模式继续受支持。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-first-release-cleanup/docs/design/2026-10-23-managed-first-release-contract.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/refactor/managed-first-release-cleanup/docs/design/2026-10-23-managed-first-release-contract.zh-CN.md)。两个版本的决策、边界与验收标准完整对应。

prs.title: fix(cli): accept explicitly named Local Control addresses outside RFC 1918/3927
prs.body:
## What this PR does

An explicitly passed `--local-control-address` is now treated as operator intent: Local Control accepts any non-internal, non-loopback IPv4 the host actually has — including addresses outside RFC 1918/3927 space (some enterprise intranets number their LANs from public ranges) and addresses on VPN/tunnel interfaces (phone and laptop on the same corporate VPN). Automatic advertisement stays RFC 1918/3927-only and untouched; the escape hatch opens only when the operator names the address, and out-of-private-space picks are logged with a loud warning on enable. The explicit pick is also resolved before the no-candidate failure, so a host with zero automatic candidates can still opt in.

## Why it's needed

On a host whose only non-loopback IPv4 is a public-range corporate-intranet address, Local Control was completely unusable: `qwen serve --local-control` exited with "No private IPv4 address is available", and `--local-control-address` could not help because it only disambiguated among candidates that had already passed the RFC 1918 filter. The same dead end hit hosts whose only usable address sits on a VPN/tunnel interface. Refuse-by-default remains the right posture for automatic advertising — the missing piece was a way for an operator to say "yes, this one, I mean it."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On a host whose address is outside RFC 1918/3927 (or on a VPN/tunnel interface), run `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <that-address>`. Expected: a WARNING that the address is outside private/link-local space, then the pairing QR/URL bound to that address; the LAN listener enforces the pairing token (401 without it, 200 with it). Naming an address the host does not have still fails with `unknown_lan_interface`; naming loopback still fails. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged: automatic selection stays RFC 1918/3927-only, and multiple candidates still surface the explicit-choice error. Unit tests cover the full selection matrix (public-range, tunnel interface, loopback, unknown address, ambiguity, no-candidate ordering).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (released 0.25.1, host's only address on a public-range corporate intranet):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control
qwen serve: No private IPv4 address is available. Local Control needs the host to be on a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet).
(exit code 1)
```

After (this branch, same host):

```
$ qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <public-range-address> --port 4399
qwen serve: WARNING: Local Control address <public-range-address> is outside RFC 1918 private / RFC 3927 link-local space. It was accepted only because it was named explicitly — advertise it only on a network you trust.

Local Control is on. Scan this QR code from the same network:
en0: http://<public-range-address>:4399/#token=<pairing-token>
```

LAN listener auth boundary on that address: `GET /` → 200 (Web Shell), `GET /capabilities` → 401 without the pairing token, 200 with it.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Dev CLI (`npm run dev`) on the affected host; `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, ESLint, and Prettier all pass on the change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the explicit opt-in deliberately widens what `--local-control-address` accepts; automatic (no-flag) behavior is unchanged, and out-of-private-space picks always log a warning. Acceptance requires the address to exist on a live interface, so wildcards, multicast, and typos stay refused.
- Not validated / out of scope: adding CGNAT (100.64/10) to the default allowlist, and a Web Shell settings-card affordance for the opt-in — both deliberately deferred.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14136

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

显式传入的 `--local-control-address` 现在被视为操作员意图：只要主机真实持有该地址，Local Control 就接受任意非 internal、非 loopback 的 IPv4——包括 RFC 1918/3927 范围之外的地址（一些企业内网用公网段给内网编号），以及 VPN/隧道接口上的地址（手机与电脑同挂一个企业 VPN 的场景）。自动 advertise 路径保持 RFC 1918/3927-only 不变；逃生舱只在操作员显式点名地址时开启，且超出私有段的选取会在 enable 时打出醒目警告。显式选取还先于"无候选"报错解析，因此一个没有任何自动候选的主机也能通过显式指定完成配对。

## 为什么需要

当主机唯一的非 loopback IPv4 是企业内网的公网段地址时，Local Control 完全不可用：`qwen serve --local-control` 直接以 "No private IPv4 address is available" 退出，而 `--local-control-address` 也帮不上忙——它此前只能在已通过 RFC 1918 过滤的候选里消歧。唯一可用地址在 VPN/隧道接口上的主机同样无路可走。对自动 advertise 保持默认拒绝仍是正确姿态，缺的是一条让操作员明确表达"就要这个"的通道。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在地址超出 RFC 1918/3927（或位于 VPN/隧道接口）的主机上运行 `qwen serve --local-control --local-control-address <该地址>`。预期：先打印地址超出私有段的 WARNING，然后输出绑定该地址的配对二维码/URL；LAN listener 强制 pairing token（无 token 401，有 token 200）。指定主机没有的地址仍以 `unknown_lan_interface` 失败；指定 loopback 仍然失败。不带该 flag 时行为不变：自动选取保持 RFC 1918/3927-only，多候选仍然报"需要显式选择"。单元测试覆盖完整选取矩阵（公网段、隧道接口、loopback、未知地址、歧义、无候选顺序）。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before（已发布 0.25.1，主机唯一地址在企业内网公网段）：`qwen serve --local-control` 以 exit 1 退出，报 "No private IPv4 address is available"。After（本分支，同主机）：WARNING 之后正常打印二维码与 URL，LAN listener 鉴权边界实测通过（无 token 401 / 有 token 200）。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅；Windows / Linux ⚠️ 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：显式 opt-in 是有意放宽 `--local-control-address` 的接受范围；无 flag 的自动行为完全不变，超出私有段的选取必打警告。接受以"主机真实持有该地址"为前提，通配、组播、笔误依旧拒绝。
- 未覆盖/刻意排除：CGNAT（100.64/10）进默认白名单、Web Shell 设置卡片的 opt-in 入口——均有意延后。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

## Current delivery — FEAT-031 merged in PR #7009

**[PR #7009](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/pull/7009) was squash-merged into `main` by Hmbown on 2026-10-22 at 21:20:50 UTC**, as [`6c2b1d83bea9`](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/commit/6c2b1d83bea985e13ed05295f35defe132678a52), final PR head `c0b0c5226`.

The complete **13-command core navigation slice** now uses portable Shapes in place. The actual production root and owned helpers compile independently of App/TUI; concrete I/O and voice capture remain host-owned. The `core` frontier remains pending; the other 27 registrations in the original inventory, registry enforcement and physical movement are outside this delivery. WORKSPACE per-operation anchor authority remains an acknowledged maintainer follow-up.

**Merged delivery is confirmed; final-head full verification and release remain separate.** [CI run 39853629910](https://github.com/codewhale-hq/Codewhale/actions/runs/39853629910) was still in progress when checked: Windows tests, Lint, Safety, MSRV and extension-host jobs succeeded; Ubuntu tests were running, and skipped jobs are not passes. The prior APPROVED review was explicitly AI-authored through the maintainer account and reviewed an earlier input. Historical full checks/coverage and the October 21 scoped integration retain their original source identities; no new final-head coverage or completely green CI claim. Latest published release observed is v0.10.1; no released tag containing FEAT-031 was verified.

EPIC-006 now has **15/32 active deliveries merged**: Stage A **2/2**, Stage B **13/17**; **17 remain unmerged**. FEAT-030 remains absorbed. **Next: FEAT-032**, whose FEAT-031 delivery dependency is satisfied, then FEAT-033–035. FEAT-046 physical core movement and FEAT-017 final acceptance remain. [Draft PR #6832](https://github.com/Hmbown/Codewhale/pull/6832) adopts shared command Shapes for `/permissions` (including compatibility routes) and `/status`. Eight hosted fork workflows await administrator approval; the contributor approval attempt returned HTTP 403. GitGuardian/contribution gate passed. - EPIC-006: **12/32 implemented, 11/32 merged**, one open PR delivery, 20 unimplemented. Stage B **10/17 implemented, 9/17 merged**.
